  const load = ()=>{cart=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]');render();};

  window.addToCart = id => {
    if(!products.length) return toastMsg("Loading products...");
    const p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(!p)return toastMsg('Item not found');
    const ex=cart.find(x=>x.id===id);
    ex?ex.qty++:cart.push({...p,qty:1});
    save();render();toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty=(id,delta)=>{
    const item=cart.find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(!item)return;
    item.qty+=delta;
    if(item.qty<=0)cart=cart.filter(x=>x.id!==id);
    save();render();
  };

  // CLEAR BUTTON LOGIC
  clearBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(confirm("Are you sure you want to clear your cart?")) {
          cart = []; save(); render();
      }
  };

  const render=()=>{
    itemsEl.innerHTML='';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.price*i.qty,0);
    totalEl.textContent='$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length===0){
        emptyEl.style.display='block';
        checkoutBtn.style.display='none';
        clearBtn.style.display='none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display='none';
        clearBtn.style.display='block';
        if(!checkoutOpen) checkoutBtn.style.display='block';
        
        cart.forEach(i=>{
            itemsEl.innerHTML+=`
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{products=p;load();});

  // --- CHECKOUT HANDLERS ---
  
  // 1. Proceed to Checkout
  checkoutBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display='none';
      payContainer.style.display='block';
      
      const ppContainer = document.getElementById('paypalgo');
      if(!ppContainer.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL, // <--- FORCES ONLY PAYPAL
                style: { layout:'vertical', color:'black', shape:'rect', label:'pay' },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calculatedTotal = 0;
                   const paypalItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let catLabel = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let finalName = `[${catLabel}] ${item.name}`; 
                       if(finalName.length > 127) finalName = finalName.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const unitPrice = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calculatedTotal += parseFloat(unitPrice) * item.qty;
                       return { name: finalName, description: catLabel, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: unitPrice }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calculatedTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:paypalItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const buyerName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const buyerEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + buyerName + '\nEmail to contact: ' + buyerEmail + '\n\nWe will send your files to this email!');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal failed to render", e); }
      }
  });

  // 2. Back Button Logic
  backBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      resetCheckoutView();
  });

  document.getElementById('stripego').onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => {
        if(!item.stripe_price_id) { alert(`Error: Item "${item.name}" is missing a Stripe Price ID.`); throw new Error("Missing Price ID"); }
        return { price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty };
    });
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();

You have great taste. That "traveling light" effect (often called a "shimmer" or "scanline" effect) is a staple of high-end cyberpunk UI. It brings the interface to life.

Here is the updated code with the following changes:

Clear Button: Moved to the left by adding margin, so it doesn't touch the "X".

Stripe Logo: Replaced the text with the official Stripe logo in white.

Double Borders: The "Add to Cart" and "View Cart" buttons now have the Cyan accent line on both the left and right sides.

The "LED" Animations:

The Line: Now has a permanent, glowing blue pulse that travels back and forth endlessly.

The Buttons: When you hover over "Add to Cart", "View Cart", or "Proceed to Checkout", a high-speed light sweep shoots across the button.

The Toast: When a notification pops up, it does a "scan" sweep to grab attention.

split it into two parts - it is past the carrd character limit

JavaScript
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  const stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY);

  // --- ELEMENT SELECTORS ---
  const modal     = document.getElementById('cruxcart');
  const itemsEl   = document.getElementById('cruxitems');
  const emptyEl   = document.getElementById('cruxempty');
  const totalEl   = document.getElementById('cruxtotal');
  const checkoutBtn  = document.getElementById('cruxcheckout');
  const payContainer = document.getElementById('cruxpay');
  const toast     = document.getElementById('cruxtoast');
  const clearBtn  = document.getElementById('cruxclear');
  const backBtn   = document.getElementById('cruxback');

  // --- LOGIC FUNCTIONS ---
  window.openCartModal = () => { modal.style.display='flex'; render(); };
  window.closeCruxCart = () => { modal.style.display='none'; resetCheckoutView(); };
  
  const resetCheckoutView = () => {
      payContainer.style.display='none'; 
      checkoutBtn.style.display='block';
      checkoutOpen=false; 
  }

  const toastMsg = msg => {
    const t=document.createElement('div');
    t.className='crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML=msg;
    toast.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = ()=>localStorage.setItem('crux2025',JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = ()=>{cart=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]');render();};

  window.addToCart = id => {
    if(!products.length) return toastMsg("Loading products...");
    const p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(!p)return toastMsg('Item not found');
    const ex=cart.find(x=>x.id===id);
    ex?ex.qty++:cart.push({...p,qty:1});
    save();render();toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty=(id,delta)=>{
    const item=cart.find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(!item)return;
    item.qty+=delta;
    if(item.qty<=0)cart=cart.filter(x=>x.id!==id);
    save();render();
  };

  clearBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(confirm("Are you sure you want to clear your cart?")) {
          cart = []; save(); render();
      }
  };

  const render=()=>{
    itemsEl.innerHTML='';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.price*i.qty,0);
    totalEl.textContent='$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length===0){
        emptyEl.style.display='block';
        checkoutBtn.style.display='none';
        clearBtn.style.display='none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display='none';
        clearBtn.style.display='block';
        if(!checkoutOpen) checkoutBtn.style.display='block';
        
        cart.forEach(i=>{
            itemsEl.innerHTML+=`
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{products=p;load();});

  // --- CHECKOUT LOGIC ---
  checkoutBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display='none';
      payContainer.style.display='block';
      
      const ppContainer = document.getElementById('paypalgo');
      if(!ppContainer.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL, 
                style: { layout:'vertical', color:'black', shape:'rect', label:'pay' },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calculatedTotal = 0;
                   const paypalItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let catLabel = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let finalName = `[${catLabel}] ${item.name}`; 
                       if(finalName.length > 127) finalName = finalName.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const unitPrice = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calculatedTotal += parseFloat(unitPrice) * item.qty;
                       return { name: finalName, description: catLabel, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: unitPrice }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calculatedTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:paypalItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const buyerName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const buyerEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + buyerName + '\nEmail to contact: ' + buyerEmail + '\n\nWe will send your files to this email!');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal failed to render", e); }
      }
  });

  backBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      resetCheckoutView();
  });

  document.getElementById('stripego').onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => {
        if(!item.stripe_price_id) { alert(`Error: Item "${item.name}" is missing a Stripe Price ID.`); throw new Error("Missing Price ID"); }
        return { price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty };
    });
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>

This is a great direction. The center-split animation is a classic sci-fi HUD effect, and fixing the Stripe logo to be the actual white text on purple will make it look official.

Here is the updated code split into two parts.

Changes Made:
Stripe Button Fixed: I replaced the broken SVG with the official Stripe Wordmark (Text) SVG. It is now white text on the correct Blurple background.

Toaster Flash on Buttons: I took the exact shine-sweep animation from the toast and applied it to the Add to Cart and View Cart buttons. It now triggers a high-speed "scan" every time you hover over them.

Cyberpunk Light Bar: I completely rewrote the CSS for the line. It now has two separate beams (led-left and led-right). They start at the center (bright white/blue), split apart to the edges (diverging), and then crash back into the center to flash bright again.

PART 1: Visuals (Paste into Embed Element #1)
Contains: Styles, Animations, and HTML Structure.

HTML
<script src="https://js.stripe.com/v3/"></script>
<script src="https://www.paypal.com/sdk/js?client-id=AUvRiSi6edPOgFdzxWGHQ-nXM6bCXwNWbi5ctTB8P03cfEieNiBRDtAAvJeRaZQYlMdiG9Eggj8MMOLf&currency=USD&intent=capture&components=buttons&enable-funding=paypal&disable-funding=card,credit"></script>

<style>
  :root {
      --c-accent: #40c4ff;
      --c-accent-glow: rgba(64,196,255,0.6);
      --c-bg: #121212;
      --c-surface: #1e1e1e;
      --c-text: #ffffff;
      --font-stack: 'Myriad Pro', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  }

  /* --- ANIMATIONS --- */
  
  /* 1. The "Toast" Flash (Now on Buttons too) */
  @keyframes shine-sweep { 
      0% { left: -100%; opacity: 0; } 
      20% { opacity: 1; } 
      100% { left: 200%; opacity: 0; } 
  }

  /* 2. The Center-Split Diverging Light */
  @keyframes diverge-loop-left {
      0% { transform: translateX(0) scaleX(1); opacity: 1; filter: brightness(2); }   /* Center Flash */
      45% { transform: translateX(-180%) scaleX(0.5); opacity: 0.3; }                 /* Move Left */
      55% { transform: translateX(-180%) scaleX(0.5); opacity: 0.3; }                 /* Pause */

PART 2: Logic (Paste into Embed Element #2)
Contains: Scripts, Cart Logic, PayPal/Stripe Handlers.

JavaScript
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  const stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY);

  // --- ELEMENT SELECTORS ---
  const modal     = document.getElementById('cruxcart');
  const itemsEl   = document.getElementById('cruxitems');
  const emptyEl   = document.getElementById('cruxempty');
  const totalEl   = document.getElementById('cruxtotal');
  const checkoutBtn  = document.getElementById('cruxcheckout');
  const payContainer = document.getElementById('cruxpay');
  const toast     = document.getElementById('cruxtoast');
  const clearBtn  = document.getElementById('cruxclear');
  const backBtn   = document.getElementById('cruxback');

  // --- LOGIC FUNCTIONS ---
  window.openCartModal = () => { modal.style.display='flex'; render(); };
  window.closeCruxCart = () => { modal.style.display='none'; resetCheckoutView(); };
  
  const resetCheckoutView = () => {
      payContainer.style.display='none'; 
      checkoutBtn.style.display='block';
      checkoutOpen=false; 
  }

  const toastMsg = msg => {
    const t=document.createElement('div');
    t.className='crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML=msg;
    toast.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = ()=>localStorage.setItem('crux2025',JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = ()=>{cart=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]');render();};

  window.addToCart = id => {
    if(!products.length) return toastMsg("Loading products...");
    const p=products.find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(!p)return toastMsg('Item not found');
    const ex=cart.find(x=>x.id===id);
    ex?ex.qty++:cart.push({...p,qty:1});
    save();render();toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty=(id,delta)=>{
    const item=cart.find(x=>x.id===id);
    if(!item)return;
    item.qty+=delta;
    if(item.qty<=0)cart=cart.filter(x=>x.id!==id);
    save();render();
  };

  clearBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(confirm("Are you sure you want to clear your cart?")) {
          cart = []; save(); render();
      }
  };

  const render=()=>{
    itemsEl.innerHTML='';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.price*i.qty,0);
    totalEl.textContent='$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length===0){
        emptyEl.style.display='block';
        checkoutBtn.style.display='none';
        clearBtn.style.display='none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display='none';
        clearBtn.style.display='block';
        if(!checkoutOpen) checkoutBtn.style.display='block';
        
        cart.forEach(i=>{
            itemsEl.innerHTML+=`
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{products=p;load();});

  // --- CHECKOUT LOGIC ---
  checkoutBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display='none';
      payContainer.style.display='block';
      
      const ppContainer = document.getElementById('paypalgo');
      if(!ppContainer.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL, 
                style: { layout:'vertical', color:'black', shape:'rect', label:'pay' },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calculatedTotal = 0;
                   const paypalItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let catLabel = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let finalName = `[${catLabel}] ${item.name}`; 
                       if(finalName.length > 127) finalName = finalName.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const unitPrice = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calculatedTotal += parseFloat(unitPrice) * item.qty;
                       return { name: finalName, description: catLabel, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: unitPrice }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calculatedTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:paypalItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const buyerName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const buyerEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + buyerName + '\nEmail to contact: ' + buyerEmail + '\n\nWe will send your files to this email!');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal failed to render", e); }
      }
  });

  backBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      resetCheckoutView();
  });

  document.getElementById('stripego').onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => {
        if(!item.stripe_price_id) { alert(`Error: Item "${item.name}" is missing a Stripe Price ID.`); throw new Error("Missing Price ID"); }
        return { price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty };
    });
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>
it looks like nothing changed

If "nothing changed," it is because your website currently has two copies of the cart code running at the same time: the old one (which loads first) and the new one (which loads second). Because they have the same ID (cruxcart), the browser is ignoring the new one and showing you the old one.

I have updated the code below to force-delete any old versions automatically before loading the new one. I also fixed the Stripe logo and the light-bar animations.

INSTRUCTIONS (CRITICAL)
Delete your old Cart Embeds if you can find them.

Create Embed Element #1 and paste PART 1.

Create Embed Element #2 and paste PART 2.

Publish your site.

Refresh your live site twice to clear the cache.

uhh it's broken or has timing errors or something - when clicking "add to cart" the toaster says "loading products" also "view cart" does nothing

This is a timing issue. The script is loading, but the product data (the JSON file) hasn't finished downloading before you click the button. That is why it says "Loading products."

Also, "View Cart" doing nothing means the button on your page doesn't know how to talk to the script yet.

I have rewritten the Logic (Part 2) to fix this:

Auto-Fix "View Cart": The script will now automatically find any link on your site that ends in #cart and make it open the cart.

Fix "Loading Products": If you click "Add to Cart" too fast, the script will now pause, fetch the data, and THEN add the item automatically, instead of giving you an error.

Fix "Broken": I added a safety check to ensure the code doesn't crash if it runs twice.

Leave PART 1 (Visuals) exactly as it is. You only need to update PART 2.

PART 2: LOGIC (Paste this into Embed Element #2)
Replace your current Part 2 with this fixed version.

JavaScript
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- 1. SETUP & CLEANUP ---
  // Remove old modal if it exists to prevent "ghost" carts
  const oldCart = document.getElementById('cruxcart');
  if(oldCart) oldCart.remove();

  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';
  
  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;

  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe failed to load", e); }

  // --- 2. ELEMENT SELECTORS ---
  // We grab these dynamically later to ensure they exist
  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- 3. CORE FUNCTIONS ---
  
  // Open Modal
  window.openCartModal = () => { 
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) { modal.style.display='flex'; render(); }
  };

  // Close Modal
  window.closeCruxCart = () => { 
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display='none'; 
          resetCheckoutView();
      }
  };
  
  // Reset View
  const resetCheckoutView = () => {
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(pay) pay.style.display='none'; 
      if(btn) btn.style.display='block';
      checkoutOpen=false; 
  }

  // Toast Notification
  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  // Save/Load
  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  // --- 4. SMART ADD TO CART (Fixes Timing Errors) ---
  window.addToCart = async (id) => {
    // If products haven't loaded yet, fetch them NOW and wait
    if(!products || products.length === 0) {
        toastMsg("Initializing store...");
        try {
            const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
            products = await res.json();
        } catch(e) {
            return toastMsg("Error loading products. Refresh page.");
        }
    }

    const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
    if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');
    
    const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
    ex ? ex.qty++ : cart.push({...p, qty:1});
    
    save();
    render();
    toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty = (id, delta) => {
    const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
    if(!item) return;
    item.qty += delta;
    if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
    save();
    render();
  };

  // --- 5. RENDER LOGIC ---
  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; // Safety check

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen && checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  // --- 6. INITIALIZATION & EVENTS ---
  
  // Fetch Data Immediately
  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Error", e));

  // EVENT: Clear Button
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      if(e.target && e.target.id === 'cruxclear'){
          if(confirm("Clear cart?")) { cart=[]; save(); render(); }
      }
      // EVENT: Back Button
      if(e.target && e.target.id === 'cruxback'){
          resetCheckoutView();
      }
      // EVENT: View Cart Link Fix (Any link ending in #cart opens modal)
      if(e.target.tagName === 'A' && e.target.href.includes('#cart')) {
          e.preventDefault();
          window.openCartModal();
      }
  });

  // EVENT: Checkout
  const bindCheckout = () => {
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(!btn) return setTimeout(bindCheckout, 500); // Wait if DOM not ready
      
      btn.onclick = () => {
          if(cart.length === 0) return;
          checkoutOpen = true;
          btn.style.display = 'none';
          getEl('cruxpay').style.display = 'block';

          // Initialize PayPal
          const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
          if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
              try {
                 paypal.Buttons({
                    fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                    style: { layout:'vertical', color:'black', shape:'rect', label:'pay' },
                    createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                       let calcTotal = 0;
                       const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                           let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                           let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`; 
                           if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                           const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                           calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                           return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                       });
                       const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                       return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                    },
                    onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                        return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                            const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                            const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                            alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                            cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                        });
                    },
                    onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
                 }).render('#paypalgo');
              } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Render Error", e); }
          }
      };
      
      // Initialize Stripe
      const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
      if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
        if(cart.length === 0) return;
        const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
        const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
        if(error) alert(error.message);
      };
  };

  // Start binding events
  bindCheckout();

  // Check for Stripe Success Return
  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();

INSTRUCTIONS:

Replace Embed #2 (Logic) with this code below.

JavaScript
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- 1. CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  // Remove old cart to prevent duplicates
  const oldCart = document.getElementById('cruxcart');
  if(oldCart) oldCart.remove();

  // --- 2. GLOBAL VARIABLES ---
  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  
  // Initialize Stripe
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  // --- 3. HELPER: Select Elements safely ---
  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- 4. CORE FUNCTIONS (Attached to window immediately) ---

  // Function to Open Modal (Fixes "View Cart" button)
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'flex';
          render(); // Refresh the view
      } else {
          console.error("Cart modal not found");
      }
  };

  // Function to Close Modal
  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
          const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
          if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
          if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
          checkoutOpen = false;
      }
  };

  // Function to Add Item (Fixes "Loading Products" timing)
  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      // If products aren't loaded, force load them now
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products. Refresh page.");
          }
      }

      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');

      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) {
          ex.qty++;
      } else {
          cart.push({...p, qty:1});
      }
      
      save();
      render();
      toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  // Function to Change Quantity
  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save();
      render();
  };

  // --- 5. INTERNAL UTILITIES ---
  
  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    // Remove after 3 seconds
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  // Render the Cart HTML
  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen && checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  // --- 6. EVENT LISTENERS ---

  // Load Products Immediately
  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  // Handle Clear Button
  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(confirm("Are you sure you want to clear your cart?")) {
          cart = []; save(); render();
      }
  };
  
  // Handle Back Button
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => {
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(pay) pay.style.display='none'; 
      if(btn) btn.style.display='block';
      checkoutOpen=false;
  };

  // Handle Checkout Button
  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display = 'none';
      getEl('cruxpay').style.display = 'block';

      // Initialize PayPal (Single Button, Category Info Fix)
      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { layout:'vertical', color:'black', shape:'rect', label:'pay' },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  // Handle Stripe Button
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  // Check for success return from Stripe
  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>

JavaScript
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  // --- CLEANUP GHOST ELEMENTS ---
  const oldCart = document.getElementById('cruxcart');
  if(oldCart) oldCart.remove();

  // --- GLOBAL VARIABLES ---
  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  // --- HELPER: Select Elements safely ---
  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS (Attached to window) ---

  // 1. OPEN MODAL
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'flex';
          render(); 
      } else {
          console.error("Cart HTML missing. Re-check Part 1.");
      }
  };

  // 2. CLOSE MODAL
  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
          const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
          if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
          if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
          checkoutOpen = false;
      }
  };

  // 3. ADD TO CART
  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }

      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');

      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  // 4. CHANGE QUANTITY
  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  // --- CUSTOM CONFIRM LOGIC ---
  window.closeConfirm = function() {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }
  window.confirmClear = function() {
      cart = []; save(); render();
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }

  // --- INTERNAL UTILITIES ---
  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  // Render Cart
  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen && checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  // --- EVENT LISTENERS ---
  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  // Clear Button Trigger
  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
  };
  
  // Back Button
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => {
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(pay) pay.style.display='none'; 
      if(btn) btn.style.display='block';
      checkoutOpen=false;
  };

  // Checkout Button
  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display = 'none';
      getEl('cruxpay').style.display = 'block';

      // Initialize PayPal (Height 45 to match Stripe)
      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'pay',
                    height: 45  /* MATCHING STRIPE HEIGHT */
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  // Stripe Button
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>
view cart doesn't work again

You are exactly right. The reason "View Cart" stopped working is that my previous code included a line to "clean up old carts," but because we split the code into two parts, Part 2 was deleting Part 1 the moment the page loaded.

Since the cart HTML was deleted by the script, there was nothing for the button to open.

Here is the fixed code. I have also:

Fixed the Stripe Logo: Used a cleaner SVG path so the white logo appears correctly on the purple button.

Matched Button Heights: Forced the Stripe button to be exactly 45px high to match the standard PayPal button.

Refined LED Animation: The light beam now starts bright in the center, splits apart to the edges, and slams back into the center.

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  // --- GLOBAL VARIABLES ---
  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  // --- HELPER: Select Elements safely ---
  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS (Attached to window) ---

  // 1. OPEN MODAL
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'flex';
          render(); 
      } else {
          console.error("Cart modal not found.");
      }
  };

  // 2. CLOSE MODAL
  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          resetCheckoutView();
      }
  };
  
  const resetCheckoutView = () => {
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
      if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
      checkoutOpen = false;
  }

  // 3. ADD TO CART
  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }

      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');

      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  // 4. CHANGE QUANTITY
  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  // --- CUSTOM CONFIRM LOGIC ---
  window.closeConfirm = function() {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }
  window.confirmClear = function() {
      cart = []; save(); render();
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }

  // --- INTERNAL UTILITIES ---
  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  // Render Cart
  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen && checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  // --- EVENT LISTENERS ---
  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
  };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => {
      resetCheckoutView();
  };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display = 'none';
      getEl('cruxpay').style.display = 'block';

      // Initialize PayPal
      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'pay',
                    height: 45 
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>

I hear you loud and clear. The previous LED animation was too "smooth" and lacked that aggressive, cyberpunk "energy" you want. And the Stripe logo needs to be crisp, not a jumble of paths.

I have completely re-engineered the visuals.

What Is Fixed/Changed:
Stripe Button: I stripped out the complex SVG and replaced it with a single, verified path for the Stripe wordmark. It is now perfectly centered, white on purple, with no "piling."

Cyberpunk LED Bar 2.0:

The Clump: I added a specific "Center Flare" element. When the lights hit the middle, it explodes into a bright intense blue ball for a split second.

The Comet Trails: I switched from solid lines to directional gradients. As the light moves right, the "head" is bright blue and the "tail" fades out behind it (feathering).

The Timing: I added a "dwell" time. It sits in the center, pulsing aggressively, then shoots out and snaps back.

Toaster & Buttons: The specific "gradient flash" you liked on the toaster is now applied to the Add/View Cart buttons.

<script>
(function () {

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---

  // --- CLEANUP GHOST ELEMENTS ---
  // We check if there are TWO carts. If so, delete the first one.
  const allCarts = document.querySelectorAll('#cruxcart');
  if(allCarts.length > 1) { allCarts[0].remove(); }

  // --- GLOBAL VARIABLES ---
  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  // --- HELPER: Select Elements safely ---
  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS (Attached to window) ---

  // 1. OPEN MODAL
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'flex';
          render(); 
      } else {
          console.error("Cart HTML missing. Re-check Part 1.");
      }
  };

  // 2. CLOSE MODAL
  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
          const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
          if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
          if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
          checkoutOpen = false;
      }
  };

  // 3. ADD TO CART
  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }

      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');

      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  // 4. CHANGE QUANTITY
  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  // --- CUSTOM CONFIRM LOGIC ---
  window.closeConfirm = function() {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }
  window.confirmClear = function() {
      cart = []; save(); render();
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }

  // --- INTERNAL UTILITIES ---
  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  // Render Cart
  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen && checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  // --- EVENT LISTENERS ---
  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
  };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => {
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(pay) pay.style.display='none'; 
      if(btn) btn.style.display='block';
      checkoutOpen=false;
  };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display = 'none';
      getEl('cruxpay').style.display = 'block';

      // Initialize PayPal
      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'pay',
                    height: 45 
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {

    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);

})();

PART 2: LOGIC (Embed Element #2)
Keeps the cart alive (no ghost deleting) and enables all functions.

JavaScript
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  // --- GLOBAL VARIABLES ---
  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  // --- HELPER ---
  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS (Global) ---

  // 1. OPEN MODAL
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'flex';
          render(); 
      } else {
          console.error("Cart not found.");
      }
  };

  // 2. CLOSE MODAL
  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          resetCheckoutView();
      }
  };
  
  const resetCheckoutView = () => {
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
      if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
      checkoutOpen = false;
  }

  // 3. ADD TO CART
  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }

      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');

      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  // 4. CHANGE QUANTITY
  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  // --- CONFIRM LOGIC ---
  window.closeConfirm = function() {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }
  window.confirmClear = function() {
      cart = []; save(); render();
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }

  // --- INTERNAL UTILITIES ---
  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  // Render Logic
  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen && checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  // --- LISTENERS ---
  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
  };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => {
      resetCheckoutView();
  };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display = 'none';
      getEl('cruxpay').style.display = 'block';

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { layout:'vertical', color:'black', shape:'rect', label:'pay', height: 45 },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>
as the L-E-D strip goes off it needs to start OFF too - you have it restarting like clipping in even though the animation shows the tip go off. Stripe still looks the damn same dude do something different!

I hear you. The clipping happens because the animation loop doesn't have a "dead zone" of silence at the end before it restarts, so it snaps back to the beginning visibly. I have fixed the math so it fades to 0% opacity before it resets positions.

For Stripe, I am removing the SVG path entirely and using a high-resolution image of the logo. This guarantees it looks exactly like the official logo with no weird path distortion.

PART 1: VISUALS (Paste into Embed Element #1)
Changes: Fixed LED loop (no clipping), Image-based Stripe Logo, Glitch effect forced on all buttons.

HTML
<script src="https://js.stripe.com/v3/"></script>
<script src="https://www.paypal.com/sdk/js?client-id=AUvRiSi6edPOgFdzxWGHQ-nXM6bCXwNWbi5ctTB8P03cfEieNiBRDtAAvJeRaZQYlMdiG9Eggj8MMOLf&currency=USD&intent=capture&components=buttons&enable-funding=paypal&disable-funding=card,credit"></script>

<style>
  :root {
      --c-accent: #40c4ff;
      --c-accent-glow: rgba(64,196,255,0.8);
      --c-bg: #121212;
      --c-surface: #1e1e1e;
      --c-text: #ffffff;
      --font-stack: 'Myriad Pro', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  }

  /* --- ANIMATIONS --- */
  
  /* 1. Glitch Sweep (For Buttons) */
  @keyframes shine-sweep { 
      0% { left: -100%; opacity: 0; } 
      20% { opacity: 1; } 
      100% { left: 200%; opacity: 0; } 
  }

  /* 2. LED Center Flare (Explosion) */
  @keyframes center-explode {
      0%, 10% { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0; }
      15% { transform: scale(1.5); opacity: 1; box-shadow: 0 0 25px white; background: white; }
      25% { transform: scale(0.5); opacity: 0.5; background: var(--c-accent); }
      100% { transform: scale(0); opacity: 0; }
  }

  /* 3. LED Comets (Seamless Loop - NO CLIPPING) */
  /* Logic: Start Center -> Move Out -> Fade to 0 -> Wait -> Restart */
  @keyframes comet-out-left {
      0% { right: 50%; width: 0%; opacity: 0; }
      10% { opacity: 1; width: 5%; }
      60% { right: 95%; width: 30%; opacity: 0; } /* Faded out before end */
      100% { right: 95%; width: 0%; opacity: 0; } /* Dead zone */
  }
  @keyframes comet-out-right {
