<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  // --- CLEANUP GHOST ELEMENTS ---
  const oldCart = document.querySelectorAll('#cruxcart');
  if(oldCart.length > 1) oldCart[0].remove();

  // --- GLOBAL VARIABLES ---
  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  // --- HELPER: Select Elements safely ---
  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS (Attached to window) ---

  // 1. OPEN MODAL
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'flex';
          render(); 
      } else {
          console.error("Cart HTML missing. Re-check Part 1.");
      }
  };

  // 2. CLOSE MODAL
  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          resetCheckoutView();
      }
  };
  
  const resetCheckoutView = () => {
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
      if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
      checkoutOpen = false;
  }

  // 3. ADD TO CART
  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }

      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');

      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  // 4. CHANGE QUANTITY
  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  // --- CUSTOM CONFIRM LOGIC ---
  window.closeConfirm = function() {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }
  window.confirmClear = function() {
      cart = []; save(); render();
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }

  // --- INTERNAL UTILITIES ---
  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  // Render Cart
  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen && checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  // --- LISTENERS ---
  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
  };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => {
      resetCheckoutView();
  };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display = 'none';
      getEl('cruxpay').style.display = 'block';

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { layout:'vertical', color:'black', shape:'rect', label:'pay', height: 45 },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>
can we remove the "pay with" on the paypal button and center the word "paypal"? the stripe button finally looks good. I dunno what you did with the L-E-D but it looks the opposite of what I asked still.

This is a tricky one. The PayPal SDK is very strict about modifying their buttons. You cannot simply edit the text with CSS.

However, I found the specific configuration setting in their API that changes the label from "Pay with PayPal" to just the PayPal logo.

For the LEDs, I am abandoning the "moving comet" approach because it inherently leads to clipping issues when it resets. I am switching to a "Center Reactor" model. There is now a permanent bright energy source in the center, and two beams that are anchored to it and pulse outwards. This creates the "bright center, fading edges" look without anything physically moving and clipping.

Here is the updated code in two parts.

PART 1: VISUALS (Paste into Embed Element #1)
Changes: New "Reactor" style LED animation, plus previous visuals.

JavaScript
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  // --- CLEANUP GHOST ELEMENTS ---
  const allCarts = document.querySelectorAll('#cruxcart');
  if(allCarts.length > 1) allCarts[0].remove();

  // --- GLOBAL VARIABLES ---
  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  // --- HELPER ---
  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS (Global) ---

  // 1. OPEN MODAL
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'flex';
          render(); 
      } else {
          console.error("Cart not found.");
      }
  };

  // 2. CLOSE MODAL
  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          resetCheckoutView();
      }
  };
  
  const resetCheckoutView = () => {
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
      if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
      checkoutOpen = false;
  }

  // 3. ADD TO CART
  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }

      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');

      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  // 4. CHANGE QUANTITY
  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  // --- CONFIRM LOGIC ---
  window.closeConfirm = function() {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }
  window.confirmClear = function() {
      cart = []; save(); render();
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }

  // --- INTERNAL UTILITIES ---
  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  // Render Logic
  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen && checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  // --- LISTENERS ---
  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => {
      getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
  };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => {
      resetCheckoutView();
  };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display = 'none';
      getEl('cruxpay').style.display = 'block';

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'paypal', /* <-- CHANGED FROM 'pay' TO 'paypal' */
                    height: 45 
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>

You have a good eye for consistency.

Regarding the PayPal Button: I have to be honest with you—PayPal strictly blocks developers from applying custom CSS (like gradients or borders) to their actual buttons for security reasons (it's an iframe). We cannot force the matte gradient onto it. I have set it to "Black", which is the closest "matte" option they allow.

However, I HAVE applied your requests to everything else:

Stripe Button: Now completely matches your "Cyberpunk/Matte" theme (Dark Gradient background + Cyber Blue borders).

LED Strip: Removed the white ball. It is now just the pure diverging energy beams.

PayPal Label: Configured to show only the centered PayPal logo (removed "Pay with").

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  // --- CLEANUP ---
  const allCarts = document.querySelectorAll('#cruxcart');
  if(allCarts.length > 1) allCarts[0].remove();

  // --- GLOBALS ---
  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS ---
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) { modal.style.display = 'flex'; render(); }
  };

  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          resetCheckoutView();
      }
  };
  
  const resetCheckoutView = () => {
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
      if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
      checkoutOpen = false;
  }

  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }
      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');
      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  window.closeConfirm = function() { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }
  window.confirmClear = function() { cart = []; save(); render(); getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }

  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen && checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex'; };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => { resetCheckoutView(); };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display = 'none';
      getEl('cruxpay').style.display = 'block';

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'paypal', // <--- REMOVES "PAY WITH"
                    height: 45 
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  const allCarts = document.querySelectorAll('#cruxcart');
  if(allCarts.length > 1) allCarts[0].remove();

  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) { modal.style.display = 'flex'; render(); }
  };

  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          resetCheckoutView();
      }
  };
  
  const resetCheckoutView = () => {
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
      if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
      checkoutOpen = false;
  }

  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }
      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');
      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  window.closeConfirm = function() { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }
  window.confirmClear = function() { cart = []; save(); render(); getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }

  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen && checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex'; };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => { resetCheckoutView(); };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display = 'none';
      getEl('cruxpay').style.display = 'block';

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'paypal', /* Just the logo */
                    height: 45 
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>

This is a great set of refinements. The layering idea for Stripe to match PayPal is smart and will make the cart look much more cohesive.

Here is the updated code with all three issues addressed:

JavaScript
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  const allCarts = document.querySelectorAll('#cruxcart');
  if(allCarts.length > 1) allCarts[0].remove();

  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) { modal.style.display = 'flex'; render(); }
  };

  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          resetCheckoutView();
      }
  };
  
  const resetCheckoutView = () => {
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
      if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
      checkoutOpen = false;
  }

  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }
      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');
      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  window.closeConfirm = function() { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }
  window.confirmClear = function() { cart = []; save(); render(); getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }

  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen && checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex'; };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => { resetCheckoutView(); };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      checkoutOpen = true;
      checkoutBtn.style.display = 'none';
      getEl('cruxpay').style.display = 'block';

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'paypal',
                    height: 36 /* Match inner button height */
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  const allCarts = document.querySelectorAll('#cruxcart');
  if(allCarts.length > 1) allCarts[0].remove();

  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- VIEW SWITCHING LOGIC ---
  const toggleCheckoutView = (isCheckout) => {
      const body = getEl('main-cart-body');
      const total = getEl('main-total-row');
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      const clear = getEl('cruxclear');

      if(isCheckout) {
          // Hide Items & Total
          if(body) body.style.display = 'none';
          if(total) total.style.display = 'none';
          if(clear) clear.style.display = 'none';
          if(btn) btn.style.display = 'none';
          // Show Payment
          if(pay) pay.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
          // Show Items & Total
          if(body) body.style.display = 'block';
          if(total) total.style.display = 'flex'; // Flex for row
          if(clear) clear.style.display = 'block';
          if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
          // Hide Payment
          if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
      }
      checkoutOpen = isCheckout;
  };

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS ---
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) { modal.style.display = 'flex'; render(); }
  };

  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          toggleCheckoutView(false); // Reset to items view
      }
  };

  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }
      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');
      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  window.closeConfirm = function() { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }
  window.confirmClear = function() { cart = []; save(); render(); getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }

  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        // Only show buttons if we are NOT in checkout mode
        if(!checkoutOpen) {
            if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
            if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        }
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex'; };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => { toggleCheckoutView(false); };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      
      toggleCheckoutView(true); // Hides items, Shows payment

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'paypal',
                    height: 36
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---

  // --- CLEANUP ---

  if(allCarts.length > 1) allCarts[0].remove();

  // --- GLOBALS ---
  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- VIEW SWITCHING ---
  const toggleCheckoutView = (isCheckout) => {
      const body = getEl('main-cart-body');
      const total = getEl('main-total-row');
      const pay = getEl('cruxpay');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      const clear = getEl('cruxclear');

      if(isCheckout) {
          if(body) body.style.display = 'none';
          if(total) total.style.display = 'none';
          if(clear) clear.style.display = 'none';
          if(btn) btn.style.display = 'none';
          if(pay) pay.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
          if(body) body.style.display = 'block';
          if(total) total.style.display = 'flex';
          if(clear) clear.style.display = 'block';
          if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
          if(pay) pay.style.display = 'none';
      }
      checkoutOpen = isCheckout;
  };

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS ---
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) { modal.style.display = 'flex'; render(); }
  };

  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          toggleCheckoutView(false);
      }
  };

  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }
      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');
      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  window.closeConfirm = function() { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }
  window.confirmClear = function() { cart = []; save(); render(); getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }

  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(!checkoutOpen) {
            if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
            if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
        }
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(!checkoutOpen) {
            if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
            if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        }
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex'; };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => { toggleCheckoutView(false); };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      toggleCheckoutView(true);

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'paypal',
                    height: 36
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();

again if I press "proceed to checkout" that button ends up still being visible - which it shouldn't be. stripe and paypal look good - don't change them - when I press proceed to checkout there is no tactile button click feeling and there is no fade it's just a harsh jumpcut. the glowing L-E-D looks so much better but I think the only problem is how it lights up on the ends - the way you mate it it looks kinda like this "<_______>" right? but the glow is even the entire way "|___________|" there is no fall off on the edges like how you designed the color. The falloff needs to match the way the color looks with a point diffusion or feather but shouldn't be string since there is less light source coming from the smaller areas.

I have fixed the interactions and the visuals.

Checkout Button Visibility: I found the bug. The CSS had display: flex !important which was overpowering the JavaScript trying to hide it. I removed the !important so it now vanishes correctly.

Tactile Click: Added a :active state. When you click, the buttons now press down slightly and dim, giving a physical click feel.

Smooth Fades: Instead of a jump cut, the Items View now fades out, vanishes, and then the Payment View fades in.

LED Falloff: I removed the standard box-shadow (which creates a blocky glow) and switched to filter: drop-shadow. This forces the glow to respect the transparency of the gradient, meaning the light now fades out softly at the tips, exactly like the color does.

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  const allCarts = document.querySelectorAll('#cruxcart');
  if(allCarts.length > 1) allCarts[0].remove();

  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- SMOOTH VIEW SWITCHING ---
  const switchView = (toCheckout) => {
      const itemsView = getEl('view-items');
      const payView = getEl('view-payment');
      
      if(toCheckout) {
          // Fade Out Items
          itemsView.style.opacity = '0';
          setTimeout(() => {
              itemsView.style.display = 'none';
              // Fade In Payment
              payView.style.display = 'block';
              // Trigger reflow
              void payView.offsetWidth; 
              payView.style.opacity = '1';
          }, 200); // Wait for CSS transition
          checkoutOpen = true;
      } else {
          // Fade Out Payment
          payView.style.opacity = '0';
          setTimeout(() => {
              payView.style.display = 'none';
              // Fade In Items
              itemsView.style.display = 'block';
              void itemsView.offsetWidth; 
              itemsView.style.opacity = '1';
          }, 200);
          checkoutOpen = false;
      }
  };

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS ---
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) { 
          modal.style.display = 'flex'; 
          render(); 
          // Ensure we start on items view
          if(checkoutOpen) switchView(false);
      }
  };

  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          if(checkoutOpen) switchView(false); // Reset for next time
      }
  };

  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }
      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');
      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  window.closeConfirm = function() { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }
  window.confirmClear = function() { cart = []; save(); render(); getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }

  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex'; };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => { switchView(false); };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      
      switchView(true); // Smooth Fade Transition

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'paypal',
                    height: 36
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>

I have fixed the "Tiny Modal" issue and the "White LED" issue.

Fixing the "Tiny" Collapse: The modal was shrinking because when we hid the list of items, the modal lost all its height. I added a min-height: 350px to the modal. Now, when you switch views, it stays big and substantial, giving the buttons plenty of breathing room.

Fixing the LED Color: I removed all white from the animation. The center is now just a solid, 100% opacity Blue (#40c4ff), while the edges fade to transparent. It looks like pure energy now, not a lightbulb.

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  const allCarts = document.querySelectorAll('#cruxcart');
  if(allCarts.length > 1) allCarts[0].remove();

  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- VIEW SWITCHING ---
  const toggleCheckoutView = (isCheckout) => {
      const itemsBody = getEl('main-cart-body');
      const payBody = getEl('cruxpay');
      const total = getEl('main-total-row');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      const clear = getEl('cruxclear');

      if(isCheckout) {
          itemsBody.style.display = 'none';
          total.style.display = 'none';
          clear.style.display = 'none';
          btn.style.display = 'none';
          
          payBody.style.display = 'block';
      } else {
          payBody.style.display = 'none';
          
          itemsBody.style.display = 'block';
          total.style.display = 'flex';
          clear.style.display = 'block';
          btn.style.display = 'block';
      }
      checkoutOpen = isCheckout;
  };

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS ---
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) { modal.style.display = 'flex'; render(); }
  };

  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          toggleCheckoutView(false);
      }
  };

  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }
      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');
      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  window.closeConfirm = function() { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }
  window.confirmClear = function() { cart = []; save(); render(); getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }

  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(!checkoutOpen) {
            if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
            if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        }
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex'; };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => { toggleCheckoutView(false); };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      toggleCheckoutView(true);

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'paypal',
                    height: 36
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>

<script>

const topBarToHide = document.querySelector('.top-bar-nav');

if (topBarToHide) {

let lastScrollY = window.scrollY;

let ticking = false;

const updateVisibility = () => {

const currentScrollY = window.scrollY;

if (currentScrollY > lastScrollY && currentScrollY > 150) {

if (!topBarToHide.classList.contains('hidden')) {

topBarToHide.classList.add('hidden');

window.dispatchEvent(new Event('fixed_elements_update'));

}

} else if (currentScrollY < lastScrollY || currentScrollY <= 50) {

if (topBarToHide.classList.contains('hidden')) {

topBarToHide.classList.remove('hidden');

window.dispatchEvent(new Event('fixed_elements_update'));

}

}

lastScrollY = currentScrollY;

ticking = false;

};

const onScroll = () => {

if (!ticking) {

window.requestAnimationFrame(updateVisibility);

ticking = true;

}

};

window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });

}

</script>
