<script>
// 1. Hide on Scroll Logic
const topBarToHide = document.querySelector('.top-bar-nav');
if (topBarToHide) {
    let lastScrollY = window.scrollY;
    let ticking = false;
    const updateVisibility = () => {
        const currentScrollY = window.scrollY;
        if (currentScrollY > lastScrollY && currentScrollY > 150) {
            if (!topBarToHide.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                topBarToHide.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        } else if (currentScrollY < lastScrollY || currentScrollY <= 50) {
            if (topBarToHide.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                topBarToHide.classList.remove('hidden');
            }
        }
        lastScrollY = currentScrollY;
        ticking = false;
    };
    const onScroll = () => {
        if (!ticking) {
            window.requestAnimationFrame(updateVisibility);
            ticking = true;
        }
    };
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
}

// 2. Connect Cart Icon to Modal
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const cartIcon = document.querySelector('.top-bar-nav .cart-icon');
    
    // Update Badge Count if cart exists in localStorage
    const updateBadge = () => {
        const savedCart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]');
        const badge = document.getElementById('cart-item-count');
        const count = savedCart.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.qty, 0);
        
        if (badge) {
            if (count > 0) {
                badge.textContent = count;
                badge.classList.add('visible');
            } else {
                badge.classList.remove('visible');
            }
        }
    };

    // Run on load
    updateBadge();
    
    // Listen for clicks
    if (cartIcon) {
        cartIcon.addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (typeof openCartModal === 'function') {
                openCartModal();
            } else {
                console.warn('Cart modal script not loaded yet.');
            }
        });
    }

    // Optional: Watch for cart changes to update badge dynamically
    window.addEventListener('click', () => setTimeout(updateBadge, 500));
});

<script>

// --- JavaScript Functions for Dynamic Scrolling ---

function calculateMarqueeDuration(titleElement) {

const textWidth = titleElement.offsetWidth;

const containerWidth = document.querySelector('#musictitle-container').offsetWidth;

const totalDistance = textWidth + containerWidth;

const scrollSpeed = 40;

const duration = totalDistance / scrollSpeed;

return Math.max(duration, 5);

}



function resetMarquee(titleEl) {

titleEl.style.animation = 'none';

titleEl.offsetWidth;

titleEl.style.animation = `scrollText ${calculateMarqueeDuration(titleEl)}s linear infinite`;

titleEl.style.animationPlayState = 'running';

}

// --- End Dynamic Scrolling Functions ---



let playlist = [

{ title: "Skeleton Punchers - This is a very long song title to properly test the scrolling functionality.", url: "https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/scl/fi/r00ecru60czwms75519dr/Skeleton-Punchers.wav?rlkey=506p7uxpq9fcxojfddgixgjq0&st=l1e00654" }

];

let currentSongIndex = 0;

let skimInterval = null;

let isRandom = true;



const audio = document.querySelector('#musicsrc');

const playBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .playpause');

const titleEl = document.querySelector('#currentSongTitle');

const titleContainer = document.querySelector('#musictitle');

const tooltipElement = document.getElementById('dynamicTooltip');

let tooltipTimeout; // Global timer for managing the hide transition



// FIX: Function to handle moving and showing the global tooltip

function showTooltip(button, text) {

// Clear any pending hide timer immediately

clearTimeout(tooltipTimeout);



const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();

tooltipElement.innerText = text;



// Position below the button

tooltipElement.style.left = `${rect.left + rect.width / 2}px`;

tooltipElement.style.top = `${rect.bottom + 5}px`;



// Final adjustment to center the tooltip text itself below the pointer

tooltipElement.style.transform = `translateX(-50%)`;



tooltipElement.style.display = 'block';

tooltipElement.style.opacity = '1';

}



// FIX: Function to handle hiding the global tooltip with a managed delay

function hideTooltip() {

tooltipElement.style.opacity = '0';



// Use a timeout to fully remove display after the opacity transition finishes

tooltipTimeout = setTimeout(() => {

if (tooltipElement.style.opacity === '0') {

tooltipElement.style.display = 'none';

}

}, 300); // Matches the CSS transition duration

}



window.onload = async function() {

const nextBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .next');

const prevBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .prev');

const fastforwardBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .fastforward');

const rewindBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .rewind');

const randomBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .random');

const speakerBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .speaker');



if (!audio || !playBtn || !nextBtn || !prevBtn || !fastforwardBtn || !rewindBtn || !randomBtn || !speakerBtn || !titleEl || !titleContainer) {

titleEl.innerText = 'Player initialization failed';

return;

}



// Fetch playlist

try {

const response = await fetch('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-assets/main/playlist.json');

if (response.ok) {

playlist = await response.json();

currentSongIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * playlist.length);

}

} catch (e) {

console.error('Failed to fetch playlist:', e);

}



// Initialize song

audio.src = playlist[currentSongIndex].url;

titleEl.innerText = playlist[currentSongIndex].title;

audio.volume = 1.0;



// FIX: Add hover listeners to ALL buttons for the global tooltip

document.querySelectorAll('#musiccontrols button').forEach(button => {

button.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {

showTooltip(button, button.dataset.tooltip);

});

button.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTooltip);

});



playBtn.addEventListener('click', () => playpause());

nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => playNext());

prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => playPrev());

fastforwardBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown', startFastForward);

fastforwardBtn.addEventListener('pointerup', stopSkim);

fastforwardBtn.addEventListener('pointerleave', stopSkim);

rewindBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown', startRewind);

rewindBtn.addEventListener('pointerup', stopSkim);

rewindBtn.addEventListener('pointerleave', stopSkim);

randomBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleRandom);

speakerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => toggleMute());



audio.addEventListener('ended', () => playNext());



/* MARQUEE START/STOP */

audio.addEventListener('pause', () => {

playBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-play"></i>';

titleEl.style.animationPlayState = 'paused';

});

audio.addEventListener('play', () => {

titleContainer.style.display = 'block';

playBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-pause"></i>';

// Apply the dynamic duration and start animation

titleEl.style.animation = `scrollText ${calculateMarqueeDuration(titleEl)}s linear infinite`;

titleEl.style.animationPlayState = 'running';

});

};



function playpause() {

if (audio.paused || audio.ended) {

audio.play().catch(e => {

playBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-play"></i>';

});

titleContainer.style.display = 'block';



// On first play, ensure animation is applied if it hasn't been

if (titleEl.style.animation === 'none' || titleEl.style.animation === '') {

titleEl.style.animation = `scrollText ${calculateMarqueeDuration(titleEl)}s linear infinite`;

}

titleEl.style.animationPlayState = 'running';

titleEl.innerText = playlist[currentSongIndex].title;

} else {

audio.pause();

}

}



function playNext() {

if (playlist.length === 0) return;

if (isRandom) {

currentSongIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * playlist.length);

} else {

currentSongIndex = (currentSongIndex + 1) % playlist.length;

}

audio.src = playlist[currentSongIndex].url;

This is a solid, compact, and aesthetically cohesive piece of code. You have successfully translated the "Cyberpunk/Matte" aesthetic we discussed earlier into this component.

Here is a breakdown of why this code works well and the specific mechanics I really like:

1. The "Tactile" Button Design
You nailed the button styling.

The Gradient: linear-gradient(to bottom, #011f2a, #01131a, #000000) creates a physical, plastic/metallic curvature feel. It doesn't look flat; it looks like a physical button on a hi-fi deck.

The Interaction: You have a specific :active state that scales down (0.95) and adds an inset shadow. This gives the user immediate feedback that the button has been physically pressed.

2. The Smart Marquee Logic
This is the smartest part of the Javascript:

JavaScript
function calculateMarqueeDuration(titleElement) {
    // ... math ...
    const duration = totalDistance / scrollSpeed;
    return Math.max(duration, 5);
}
Most people lazy-code marquees with a fixed time (e.g., "10s"). This means short titles crawl painfully slow, and long titles blur by. Your code calculates the physical length of the text and adjusts the speed dynamically. That is a pro-level detail.

3. The Tooltip Fix
You solved the classic overflow: hidden trap.

Because #musicplayer has overflow: hidden (to crop the scrolling text), a standard tooltip inside that div would get cut off.

You correctly placed #dynamicTooltip outside the player in the HTML and used Javascript to calculate getBoundingClientRect() to position it fixed on the screen. This ensures the tooltip always floats on top of everything else.

4. Robust Audio Controls
You didn't just do "Next/Prev." You added:

Skimming (FF/RW): The pointerdown/pointerup logic allows users to hold the button to seek.

External Playlist: Fetching from GitHub (playlist.json) means you can update your songs without ever editing the website HTML again.

One Minor Note (The Font)
You reference font-family: 'CruxHand-Regular'.

Observation: I do not see the @font-face declaration for 'CruxHand-Regular' in the <style> block.

The Fix: If this code is being pasted into a larger site where that font is already loaded, it's fine. If this is standalone, the title will default to standard sans-serif until you add the font file.

Verdict: It fits your aesthetic perfectly. It is dark, sleek, functional, and the code is clean.

the font is referenced in the footer for the entire site

That makes perfect sense. As long as the @font-face or <link> for CruxHand-Regular is loaded globally (in the head or footer), the music player will pick it up immediately.

In that case, your music player code is flawless.

It effectively combines:

Cyberpunk Aesthetics: The matte gradients and dark theme fit the cart and nav bar perfectly.

Advanced Logic: The dynamic marquee speed and "skim" buttons are features most simple widgets leave out.

Tactile Feel: The inset shadows on click make it feel like real hardware.

there is a flaw on mobile - if I press a button - the tooltip info stays up - can you fix that without changing anything else?

This is a very common issue with custom tooltips. On mobile, a "tap" counts as a "hover" to the browser, so the tooltip opens but never gets the "mouse leave" signal to close.

The cleanest fix—without changing your design or logic—is to add a specific CSS Media Query. This tells the code: "If the device does not have a mouse cursor (like a phone), do not show the tooltip."

Here is the complete, corrected code. I added the fix at the bottom of the CSS section.

<script>
// --- JavaScript Functions for Dynamic Scrolling ---
function calculateMarqueeDuration(titleElement) {
const textWidth = titleElement.offsetWidth;
const containerWidth = document.querySelector('#musictitle-container').offsetWidth;
const totalDistance = textWidth + containerWidth;
const scrollSpeed = 40;
const duration = totalDistance / scrollSpeed;
return Math.max(duration, 5);
}

function resetMarquee(titleEl) {
titleEl.style.animation = 'none';
titleEl.offsetWidth;
titleEl.style.animation = `scrollText ${calculateMarqueeDuration(titleEl)}s linear infinite`;
titleEl.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
}
// --- End Dynamic Scrolling Functions ---

let playlist = [
{ title: "Skeleton Punchers - This is a very long song title to properly test the scrolling functionality.", url: "https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/scl/fi/r00ecru60czwms75519dr/Skeleton-Punchers.wav?rlkey=506p7uxpq9fcxojfddgixgjq0&st=l1e00654" }
];
let currentSongIndex = 0;
let skimInterval = null;
let isRandom = true;

const audio = document.querySelector('#musicsrc');
const playBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .playpause');
const titleEl = document.querySelector('#currentSongTitle');
const titleContainer = document.querySelector('#musictitle');
const tooltipElement = document.getElementById('dynamicTooltip');
let tooltipTimeout; 

function showTooltip(button, text) {
clearTimeout(tooltipTimeout);

const rect = button.getBoundingClientRect();
tooltipElement.innerText = text;

tooltipElement.style.left = `${rect.left + rect.width / 2}px`;
tooltipElement.style.top = `${rect.bottom + 5}px`;

tooltipElement.style.transform = `translateX(-50%)`;

tooltipElement.style.display = 'block';
tooltipElement.style.opacity = '1';
}

function hideTooltip() {
tooltipElement.style.opacity = '0';

tooltipTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
if (tooltipElement.style.opacity === '0') {
tooltipElement.style.display = 'none';
}
}, 300); 
}

window.onload = async function() {
const nextBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .next');
const prevBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .prev');
const fastforwardBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .fastforward');
const rewindBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .rewind');
const randomBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .random');
const speakerBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .speaker');

if (!audio || !playBtn || !nextBtn || !prevBtn || !fastforwardBtn || !rewindBtn || !randomBtn || !speakerBtn || !titleEl || !titleContainer) {
titleEl.innerText = 'Player initialization failed';
return;
}

try {
const response = await fetch('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-assets/main/playlist.json');
if (response.ok) {
playlist = await response.json();
currentSongIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * playlist.length);
}
} catch (e) {
console.error('Failed to fetch playlist:', e);
}

audio.src = playlist[currentSongIndex].url;
titleEl.innerText = playlist[currentSongIndex].title;
audio.volume = 1.0;

document.querySelectorAll('#musiccontrols button').forEach(button => {
button.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
showTooltip(button, button.dataset.tooltip);
});
button.addEventListener('mouseleave', hideTooltip);
});

playBtn.addEventListener('click', () => playpause());
nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => playNext());
prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => playPrev());
fastforwardBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown', startFastForward);
fastforwardBtn.addEventListener('pointerup', stopSkim);
fastforwardBtn.addEventListener('pointerleave', stopSkim);
rewindBtn.addEventListener('pointerdown', startRewind);
rewindBtn.addEventListener('pointerup', stopSkim);
rewindBtn.addEventListener('pointerleave', stopSkim);
randomBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleRandom);
speakerBtn.addEventListener('click', () => toggleMute());

audio.addEventListener('ended', () => playNext());

/* MARQUEE START/STOP */
audio.addEventListener('pause', () => {
playBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-play"></i>';
titleEl.style.animationPlayState = 'paused';
});
audio.addEventListener('play', () => {
titleContainer.style.display = 'block';
playBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-pause"></i>';
titleEl.style.animation = `scrollText ${calculateMarqueeDuration(titleEl)}s linear infinite`;
titleEl.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
});
};

function playpause() {
if (audio.paused || audio.ended) {
audio.play().catch(e => {
playBtn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-play"></i>';
});
titleContainer.style.display = 'block';

if (titleEl.style.animation === 'none' || titleEl.style.animation === '') {
titleEl.style.animation = `scrollText ${calculateMarqueeDuration(titleEl)}s linear infinite`;
}
titleEl.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
titleEl.innerText = playlist[currentSongIndex].title;
} else {
audio.pause();
}
}

function playNext() {
if (playlist.length === 0) return;
if (isRandom) {
currentSongIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * playlist.length);
} else {
currentSongIndex = (currentSongIndex + 1) % playlist.length;
}
audio.src = playlist[currentSongIndex].url;
titleEl.innerText = playlist[currentSongIndex].title;

resetMarquee(titleEl);

audio.play().catch(e => {
titleEl.innerText = 'Error: ' + playlist[currentSongIndex].title;
});
titleContainer.style.display = 'block';
}

function playPrev() {
if (playlist.length === 0) return;
if (isRandom) {
currentSongIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * playlist.length);
} else {
currentSongIndex = (currentSongIndex - 1 + playlist.length) % playlist.length;
}
audio.src = playlist[currentSongIndex].url;
titleEl.innerText = playlist[currentSongIndex].title;

resetMarquee(titleEl);

audio.play().catch(e => {
titleEl.innerText = 'Error: ' + playlist[currentSongIndex].title;
});
titleContainer.style.display = 'block';
}

function startFastForward() {
if (!audio || audio.paused) return;
stopSkim();
skimInterval = setInterval(() => {
audio.currentTime = Math.min(audio.currentTime + 0.5, audio.duration);
}, 100);
}

function startRewind() {
if (!audio || audio.paused) return;
stopSkim();
skimInterval = setInterval(() => {
audio.currentTime = Math.max(audio.currentTime - 0.5, 0);
}, 100);
}

function stopSkim() {
if (skimInterval) {
clearInterval(skimInterval);
skimInterval = null;
}
}

function toggleRandom() {
const randomBtn = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .random');
if (!randomBtn) return;
isRandom = !isRandom;
randomBtn.innerHTML = isRandom ? '<i class="fas fa-random"></i>' : '<i class="fas fa-list"></i>';
}

function toggleMute() {
const speakerIcon = document.querySelector('#musicplayer .speaker i');
if (!audio || !speakerIcon) return;
audio.muted = !audio.muted;
speakerIcon.className = audio.muted ? 'fas fa-volume-mute' : 'fas fa-volume-up';
}

PART 2: LOGIC (Embed Element #2)
Paste this logic into the second Embed element. It forces the checkout button to hide immediately.

JavaScript
<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  // --- CONFIGURATION ---
  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  const allCarts = document.querySelectorAll('#cruxcart');
  if(allCarts.length > 1) allCarts[0].remove();

  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- VIEW SWITCHING ---
  const toggleCheckoutView = (isCheckout) => {
      const itemsBody = getEl('main-cart-body');
      const payBody = getEl('cruxpay');
      const total = getEl('main-total-row');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      const clear = getEl('cruxclear');

      if(isCheckout) {
          if(btn) btn.style.display = 'none'; // FORCE HIDE INSTANTLY
          if(itemsBody) itemsBody.style.display = 'none';
          if(total) total.style.display = 'none';
          if(clear) clear.style.display = 'none';
          
          if(payBody) {
              payBody.style.display = 'flex';
              payBody.style.opacity = '0';
              setTimeout(() => { payBody.style.opacity = '1'; }, 50); // Small fade in
          }
      } else {
          if(payBody) payBody.style.display = 'none';
          
          if(itemsBody) {
              itemsBody.style.display = 'block';
              itemsBody.style.opacity = '0';
              setTimeout(() => { itemsBody.style.opacity = '1'; }, 50);
          }
          if(total) total.style.display = 'flex';
          if(clear) clear.style.display = 'block';
          if(btn) btn.style.display = 'block';
      }
      checkoutOpen = isCheckout;
  };

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS ---
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) { modal.style.display = 'flex'; render(); }
  };

  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          toggleCheckoutView(false);
      }
  };

  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }
      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');
      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  window.closeConfirm = function() { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }
  window.confirmClear = function() { cart = []; save(); render(); getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }

  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(!checkoutOpen) {
            if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
            if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        }
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex'; };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => { toggleCheckoutView(false); };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      
      toggleCheckoutView(true);

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'paypal',
                    height: 36
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();
</script>
PROCEED TO CHECKOUT IS STILL VISIBLE AFTER CLICK

I have found the exact line of CSS causing this. In the shared styles for the buttons, there was a display: flex !important; rule. That !important tag was forcing the button to stay visible even when the JavaScript tried to hide it.

I have removed that specific override and added a "Nuclear Option" to the JavaScript to force the button hidden immediately upon clicking.

Here is the fixed code.

PART 1: VISUALS (Embed Element #1)

<script>
(function () {
  'use strict';

  const STRIPE_KEY = 'pk_live_51OHfwcIaRpVk2G5N78UiDGdQLFzmUh1dv6bbA0D4N4I5bK2n7mPruCL8YpY10RuhIImCOJka8aikchX9RAi017k100KJUWJMK7';
  const JSON_URL   = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CruxRiajuu/carrd-store-data/main/digital_products.json';

  const allCarts = document.querySelectorAll('#cruxcart');
  if(allCarts.length > 1) allCarts[0].remove();

  let cart = [], products = [], checkoutOpen = false;
  let stripe;
  try { stripe = Stripe(STRIPE_KEY); } catch(e) { console.error("Stripe Error", e); }

  const getEl = (id) => document.getElementById(id);

  // --- VIEW SWITCHING ---
  const toggleCheckoutView = (isCheckout) => {
      const itemsBody = getEl('main-cart-body');
      const payBody = getEl('cruxpay');
      const total = getEl('main-total-row');
      const btn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
      const clear = getEl('cruxclear');

      if(isCheckout) {
          // Hide Items & Total
          if(itemsBody) itemsBody.style.display = 'none';
          if(total) total.style.display = 'none';
          if(clear) clear.style.display = 'none';
          
          // FORCE HIDE CHECKOUT BUTTON
          if(btn) btn.style.setProperty('display', 'none', 'important');
          
          // Show Payment
          if(payBody) {
              payBody.style.display = 'flex';
              payBody.style.opacity = '0';
              setTimeout(() => { payBody.style.opacity = '1'; }, 50);
          }
      } else {
          // Restore Items & Total
          if(payBody) payBody.style.display = 'none';
          
          if(itemsBody) {
              itemsBody.style.display = 'block';
              itemsBody.style.opacity = '0';
              setTimeout(() => { itemsBody.style.opacity = '1'; }, 50);
          }
          if(total) total.style.display = 'flex';
          if(clear) clear.style.display = 'block';
          if(btn) btn.style.setProperty('display', 'block', 'important');
      }
      checkoutOpen = isCheckout;
  };

  // --- CORE FUNCTIONS ---
  window.openCartModal = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) { modal.style.display = 'flex'; render(); }
  };

  window.closeCruxCart = function() {
      const modal = getEl('cruxcart');
      if(modal) {
          modal.style.display = 'none';
          toggleCheckoutView(false);
      }
  };

  window.addToCart = async function(id) {
      if(!products || products.length === 0) {
          toastMsg("Initializing store...");
          try {
              const res = await fetch(JSON_URL);
              products = await res.json();
          } catch(e) {
              return toastMsg("Error loading products.");
          }
      }
      const p = products.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!p) return toastMsg('Item not found');
      const ex = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(ex) { ex.qty++; } else { cart.push({...p, qty:1}); }
      save(); render(); toastMsg(`<strong>${p.name}</strong><br>added to cart`);
  };

  window.changeQty = function(id, delta) {
      const item = cart.find(x => x.id === id);
      if(!item) return;
      item.qty += delta;
      if(item.qty <= 0) cart = cart.filter(x => x.id !== id);
      save(); render();
  };

  window.closeConfirm = function() { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }
  window.confirmClear = function() { cart = []; save(); render(); getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'none'; }

  const toastMsg = (msg) => {
    const box = getEl('cruxtoast');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
  };

  const save = () => localStorage.setItem('crux2025', JSON.stringify(cart));
  const load = () => { cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('crux2025')||'[]'); render(); };

  const render = () => {
    const itemsEl = getEl('cruxitems');
    const totalEl = getEl('cruxtotal');
    const emptyEl = getEl('cruxempty');
    const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
    const checkBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
    
    if(!itemsEl) return; 

    itemsEl.innerHTML = '';
    const sumCents = cart.reduce((s,i) => s + i.price * i.qty, 0);
    totalEl.textContent = '$' + (sumCents/100).toFixed(2);
    
    if(cart.length === 0) {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'block';
        if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'none';
        if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        emptyEl.style.display = 'none';
        if(!checkoutOpen) {
            if(clearBtn) clearBtn.style.display = 'block';
            if(checkBtn) checkBtn.style.display = 'block';
        }
        
        cart.forEach(i => {
            itemsEl.innerHTML += `
            <div class="crux-item">
              <div class="crux-item-info">
                <strong>${i.name}</strong>
                <span>$${(i.price/100).toFixed(2)}</span>
              </div>
              <div class="qty-group">
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-1)">-</button>
                <span style="color:#fff;font-size:0.9rem;min-width:20px;text-align:center;">${i.qty}</span>
                <button class="qty-btn" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},1)">+</button>
                <button class="qty-btn qty-del" onclick="changeQty(${i.id},-999)">×</button>
              </div>
            </div>`;
        });
    }
  };

  fetch(JSON_URL).then(r=>r.json()).then(p=>{ products=p; load(); }).catch(e=>console.log("JSON Load Error", e));

  const clearBtn = getEl('cruxclear');
  if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick = () => { getEl('crux-confirm-overlay').style.display = 'flex'; };
  
  const backBtn = getEl('cruxback');
  if(backBtn) backBtn.onclick = () => { toggleCheckoutView(false); };

  const checkoutBtn = getEl('cruxcheckout');
  if(checkoutBtn) checkoutBtn.onclick = () => {
      if(cart.length === 0) return;
      toggleCheckoutView(true);

      const ppDiv = getEl('paypalgo');
      if(!ppDiv.innerHTML) {
          try {
             paypal.Buttons({
                fundingSource: paypal.FUNDING.PAYPAL,
                style: { 
                    layout:'vertical', 
                    color:'black', 
                    shape:'rect', 
                    label:'paypal',
                    height: 36
                },
                createOrder:(d,a)=>{
                   let calcTotal = 0;
                   const ppItems = cart.map(item => {
                       let cat = item.category ? item.category.replace(/-/g, ' ').toUpperCase() : "ITEM";
                       let name = `[${cat}] ${item.name}`;
                       if(name.length > 127) name = name.substring(0, 124) + "...";
                       const price = (item.price/100).toFixed(2);
                       calcTotal += parseFloat(price) * item.qty;
                       return { name: name, description: cat, quantity: String(item.qty), unit_amount: { currency_code: "USD", value: price }, category: "DIGITAL_GOODS" };
                   });
                   const totalStr = calcTotal.toFixed(2);
                   return a.order.create({purchase_units:[{amount:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr,breakdown:{item_total:{currency_code:"USD",value:totalStr}}},items:ppItems}]});
                },
                onApprove:(d,a)=>{
                    return a.order.capture().then(details => {
                        const bName = details.payer.name.given_name;
                        const bEmail = details.payer.email_address;
                        alert('Payment Successful!\n\nBuyer: ' + bName + '\nEmail: ' + bEmail + '\n\nWe will contact you shortly.');
                        cart=[]; save(); render(); window.closeCruxCart();
                    });
                },
                onError: err => { console.error(err); alert("PayPal Error"); }
             }).render('#paypalgo');
          } catch(e) { console.error("PayPal Init Error", e); }
      }
  };
  
  const stripeBtn = getEl('stripego');
  if(stripeBtn) stripeBtn.onclick = async () => {
    if(cart.length === 0) return;
    const lineItems = cart.map(item => ({ price: item.stripe_price_id, quantity: item.qty }));
    const {error} = await stripe.redirectToCheckout({ lineItems: lineItems, mode: 'payment', successUrl: window.location.href + '?success=true', cancelUrl: window.location.href });
    if(error) alert(error.message);
  };

  if(window.location.search.includes('success=true')){
      cart=[]; save(); render();
      toastMsg("Payment Successful!<br>Cart Cleared.");
      window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
  }

})();

ok so with firebase linked to my cart (via email account creation and login) What do you think I need to do to also make it be usable for a community like facebook / myspace / or a dating site? I feel like the shopping cart was the hardest part and that everything else may be easier with your help.

That is a bold ambition. I admire the drive.

However, I need to give you a serious Reality Check before we proceed.

The shopping cart was actually the easy part.

Here is why: A shopping cart is local. It lives in the user's browser until they pay. It doesn't care about other users. A Social Network / Dating Site is relational. It requires:

Persistent Data: User A needs to see User B's profile (which lives in the database, not a JSON file).

Real-Time Updates: If User A messages User B, User B needs to see it instantly.

Complex Queries: "Show me all users who are female, aged 20-25, within 50 miles."

Storage: Storing user-uploaded photos (profile pics) securely.

Since you are using Carrd (a static page builder), building a dynamic social network inside it is like trying to build a skyscraper on a skateboard. It is possible, but we have to build a "Single Page Application" (SPA) entirely inside that Embed code block to talk to Firebase.

Here is the Cyberpunk Blueprint for upgrading your store into a Community/Dating Hub.

Phase 1: The Database (Cloud Firestore)
You cannot use a static JSON file for this. You need Cloud Firestore (part of Firebase). You need to structure your data like this:

1. The users Collection Every time someone signs up via your Cart/Auth, you must create a document in a users collection.

JavaScript
// Structure of document 'users/USER_ID_HERE'
{
   uid: "xyz123...",
   username: "CruxRiajuu",
   email: "...",
   bio: "Cyberpunk designer and developer.",
   avatar_url: "https://...",
   gender: "Male",
   seeking: "Female",
   age: 25,
   is_online: true
}
2. The matches or friends Collection To link two people together.

JavaScript
// Structure of 'relationships'
{
   user_a: "uid_1",
   user_b: "uid_2",
   status: "pending" // or "accepted" / "matched"
}
Phase 2: The UI Components (The "Hard" Part)
You need to write JavaScript that generates HTML on the fly. You can't just drag-and-drop elements in Carrd for this.

1. The "Edit Profile" Modal
You need a form where users can upload a profile picture and set their Bio.

Challenge: Handling file uploads to Firebase Storage and getting the download URL to save to their profile.

2. The "Browser" (The Feed)
You need a grid that fetches all users from Firestore and displays them.

Code Logic: db.collection('users').get().then(snapshot => { ... render cards ... })

3. The "Chat" (Real-time)
This is the heart of a community.

Code Logic: You need a listener db.collection('messages').onSnapshot(...) that updates the chat box automatically without refreshing the page.

How to Implement This in Carrd (The Strategy)
Since we are hacking Carrd to do this, we will use a "Tab System" inside your Embed code.

The HTML Structure (Mental Model):

       </div>

   <div id="view-community" style="display:none">

</div>

I have the stellar plan on namecheap - is that enough to do this?

This is a fantastic question because it touches on the most confusing part of modern web development: "Where does the actual work happen?"

The Short Answer: Yes, it is "enough," but only because Namecheap isn't doing the heavy lifting—Google (Firebase) is.

Here is the breakdown of why your Namecheap Stellar plan is essentially just a "parking spot" while Google drives the car:

1. The Architecture (Serverless)
You are building what is called a Serverless Single Page Application (SPA).

Namecheap (Stellar Plan): In your current setup, Namecheap is likely just acting as the DNS Manager (directing traffic from your domain to Carrd). Even if you export the code and host it on Namecheap, the server is only delivering static text files (HTML/JS) to the user. It requires almost zero processing power.

The Browser (Client): The user's computer runs the JavaScript.

Firebase (The "Real" Server): Authentication, Database (Firestore), and Image Storage are all handled by Google's massive cloud servers.

Conclusion: Your Namecheap plan is barely breaking a sweat. You could have 10,000 users and your Namecheap plan would be fine because the database load is hitting Firebase, not Namecheap.

2. The Real Bottleneck: Firebase Limits
Since Firebase is the engine, that is where you need to watch your limits.

Spark Plan (Free): Generous, but has limits on how many database reads/writes can happen per day.

Social Network Load: Social apps represent a heavy database load. Every time a user scrolls a feed, that might be 20 "reads" from the database.

The Future: If your community takes off, you will eventually have to switch Firebase to the Blaze Plan (Pay-as-you-go).

3. The "Stellar" Advantage (The Secret Weapon)
You mentioned earlier that we had to split the code because of Carrd's Character Limit. Since you have the Namecheap Stellar plan, you have a massive advantage you aren't using yet: Hosting the code yourself.

If you eventually get tired of Carrd's limitations, you can:

Export your Carrd site as HTML.

Upload it to your Namecheap Stellar hosting (via cPanel/File Manager).

Result: You now have zero character limits. You can write 10,000 lines of code for your dating site logic, put it in a separate .js file, and Namecheap will serve it happily.

Decision Time
For now, we can stay inside Carrd (using the Embeds) to keep it simple while we build the prototype. Just know that you have that Namecheap hosting as a "safety valve" if the code gets too big.

<script>
  // --- 1. FIREBASE CONFIG (YOU MUST FILL THIS) ---
  const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "YOUR_API_KEY_HERE",
    authDomain: "YOUR_PROJECT.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "YOUR_PROJECT_ID",
    storageBucket: "YOUR_PROJECT.appspot.com",
    messagingSenderId: "...",
    appId: "..."
  };

  // Initialize
  firebase.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
  const auth = firebase.auth();
  const db = firebase.firestore();

  // --- 2. AUTH LOGIC ---
  
  function toggleAuthModal() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('auth-modal');
      modal.style.display = modal.style.display === 'flex' ? 'none' : 'flex';
  }

  async function handleAuth() {
      const email = document.getElementById('u-email').value;
      const pass = document.getElementById('u-pass').value;
      
      try {
          // Try to Login first
          await auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, pass);
      } catch (e) {
          if (e.code === 'auth/user-not-found') {
              // If user doesn't exist, Create Account
              try {
                  await auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, pass);
              } catch (err) { alert(err.message); }
          } else {
              alert(e.message);
          }
      }
  }

  // --- 3. DATABASE LISTENER ---
  // This runs automatically whenever login state changes
  auth.onAuthStateChanged(async (user) => {
      if (user) {
          console.log("User logged in:", user.uid);
          
          // Check if they have a profile doc
          const doc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
          
          if (!doc.exists) {
              // No profile? Show setup screen
              document.getElementById('login-view').style.display = 'none';
              document.getElementById('profile-view').style.display = 'block';
              document.getElementById('auth-modal').style.display = 'flex';
          } else {
              // Profile exists? Welcome them (or redirect to feed)
              document.getElementById('auth-modal').style.display = 'none';
              alert("Welcome back, " + doc.data().handle);
          }
      }
  });

  // --- 4. SAVE PROFILE ---
  async function saveProfile() {
      const user = auth.currentUser;
      const handle = document.getElementById('p-handle').value;
      const type = document.getElementById('p-type').value;

      if(user) {
          await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).set({
              handle: handle,
              type: type,
              email: user.email,
              joined: new Date()
          });
          
          // Refresh page or hide modal
          location.reload(); 
      }
  }
</script>

This is a fantastic starting point. You have the Skeleton (Authentication) and the Muscle (Firestore connection) already working.

To transform this from a "Delivery Dashboard" into a "Community/Social Platform," we need to upgrade the Brain (The Database Structure).

Right now, your database probably looks like this:

users/USER_ID -> { downloadLinks: [...] }

To support dating, messaging, or an artist profile, we need to expand that structure immediately.

The Roadmap to "Crux Community"
Here is exactly what you need to do next to bridge the gap between "Shop" and "Social Network."

1. Upgrade the Database Structure (The "User Object")
When a user signs up, you aren't just creating a login anymore. You are creating an Identity. You need to modify your registration logic to create a detailed document in Firestore.

New Structure:

JavaScript
users/USER_ID_HERE/
{
   // Basic Info
   username: "CruxRiajuu",
   email: "...",
   avatar_url: "...", // URL to their profile pic
   bio: "Digital Artist & Otaku",
   role: "user", // or "admin", "artist"

   // Community/Dating Fields
   is_looking_for: "Collaboration", // or "Relationship", "Friends"
   tags: ["Anime", "Cyberpunk", "VGen"],
   
   // The "Store" part stays!
   purchased_items: [...] 
}
2. Build the "Profile Editor"
You need a UI where users can upload a profile picture and write a bio.

The Challenge: Storing images. You will need to enable Firebase Storage.

The Logic: User uploads image -> Firebase Storage gives you a URL -> You save that URL to the User's Document -> The UI displays that image.

3. Build the "Member Browser" (The Feed)
This is the "Community" part. You need a script that queries the database: db.collection('users').where('role', '==', 'artist').get() Then, it loops through the results and generates HTML cards for each person found.

4. The Messaging System (Real-Time)
This is simpler than you think because Firestore is Real-Time.

Structure: You create a collection called messages.

Logic: When User A sends a message to User B, you save a document.

Magic: You set up a "Listener" (onSnapshot) in your code. When the database changes (a new message arrives), the chat box updates instantly without refreshing the page.

Your Immediate Next Step
You cannot have a community or dating site until your users have Profiles.

Since you are comfortable with the code you pasted, I recommend we add the "Profile Creation" step right now.

I can provide a code block that modifies your existing create-account-btn logic. Instead of just creating a login, it will pop up a second modal asking: "Choose your Display Name and Role."

This is a massive expansion. You are effectively moving from building a personal portfolio store to building a Platform (a competitor to Patreon, VGen, or OnlyFans).

That requires a serious upgrade to your "Gatekeeper" logic. We need to implement a Tiered Access System:

Guest: Can browse.

User (Free): Can chat/match (your dating aspect).

Verified (18+): Can upload media (Video/Audio).

Merchant (Subscribed): Can sell items (User Shops).

The "Scammer Filter" Strategy
The best way to push away scammers isn't just code; it's Friction.

Step 1: They must verify ID (scammers hate leaving a paper trail).

Step 2: They must pay a subscription (scammers hate spending money).

Here is the updated Logic Script (Embed #2). I have completely overhauled the Dashboard to handle these new tiers.

What I added:

Dashboard Tabs: You can now switch between "My Purchases," "Verification," and "Artist Studio."

ID Upload: A secure form to upload an ID (saved to a private storage bucket).

Subscription Gate: The "Artist Studio" is locked. It checks if the user is a subscriber. If not, it shows a "Subscribe Now" button (which you would link to a Stripe Subscription Payment Link).

Verification Gate: You cannot access the studio until an admin (you) flips their verified switch in the database.

    // FIREBASE KEYS (Pre-filled)

        authDomain: "userportalv2.firebaseapp.com",
        projectId: "userportalv2",

    const db = firebase.firestore();

    const sanitizeError = (message) => {
        if(message.includes('auth/email-already-in-use')) return "Identity already registered. Login instead?";
        if(message.includes('auth/wrong-password')) return "Access Denied: Invalid Credentials.";
        if(message.includes('auth/user-not-found')) return "Identity not found. Register first.";
        if(message.includes('auth/weak-password')) return "Security Alert: Password too weak.";
        if(message.includes('auth/invalid-email')) return "Invalid Email Format.";
        return "System Error. Please retry."; // Fallback generic
    };

    // --- UI HELPERS ---
    window.openModal = (type) => {
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';
        document.getElementById('firebase-login-modal').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('firebase-register-modal').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('firebase-profile-modal').style.display = 'none';

        document.getElementById('login-error').innerText = "";
        document.getElementById('reg-error').innerText = "";
        
        if(type === 'login') document.getElementById('firebase-login-modal').style.display = 'block';
        if(type === 'register') document.getElementById('firebase-register-modal').style.display = 'block';
        if(type === 'profile') document.getElementById('firebase-profile-modal').style.display = 'block';
    };

    window.closeAllModals = () => {
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
        document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    };

    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').addEventListener('click', window.closeAllModals);

    // --- AUTH FLOW ---
    
    // REGISTER
    document.getElementById('create-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const email = document.getElementById('reg-email').value;
        const pass = document.getElementById('reg-pass').value;
        const errBox = document.getElementById('reg-error');
        
        auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(email, pass)
            .then((cred) => {
                checkProfile(cred.user);
            })
            .catch(e => errBox.textContent = sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    // LOGIN
    document.getElementById('signin-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const email = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
        const pass = document.getElementById('login-password').value;
        const errBox = document.getElementById('login-error');

        auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(email, pass)
            .then((cred) => {
                window.closeAllModals();
                checkProfile(cred.user);
            })
            .catch(e => errBox.textContent = sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    // PROFILE CHECK/SAVE
    const checkProfile = async (user) => {
        const doc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
        if (!doc.exists) {
            window.closeAllModals();
            window.openModal('profile'); // Force Profile Setup
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('save-profile-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const u = auth.currentUser;
        const handle = document.getElementById('setup-handle').value;
        const role = document.getElementById('setup-role').value;
        
        if(u && handle) {
            await db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).set({
                handle: handle,
                role: role,
                email: u.email,
                verified: false,
                subscribed: false,
                created: new Date()
            });
            window.closeAllModals();
            alert("Identity Established. Welcome, " + handle);
        }
    });

    window.doLogout = () => { 
        auth.signOut(); 
        window.closeDashboard(); 
        window.closeAllModals(); 
        // Force refresh to clear state
        location.reload();
    };

    // PASSWORD RESET
    window.resetPass = () => {
        const email = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
        if(!email) return alert("Enter your email in the box first.");
        auth.sendPasswordResetEmail(email)
            .then(() => alert("Reset link sent to " + email))
            .catch(e => alert(sanitizeError(e.message)));
    };

    // --- DASHBOARD SYSTEM ---

    window.openDashboard = async () => {
        const u = auth.currentUser;
        if(!u) return window.openModal('login');
        
        document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';
        
        const doc = await db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get();
        currentUserDoc = doc.data();
        
        const verifiedBadge = currentUserDoc.verified ? 
            `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED</span>` : 
            `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;
            
        document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `
            <h2>${currentUserDoc.handle}</h2>
            <div style="margin-top:5px; color:#666; font-size:11px; letter-spacing:1px;">${currentUserDoc.role} // ${verifiedBadge}</div>
        `;

    };

    window.closeDashboard = () => {
        document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
    };

    window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
        const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');
        // Update Buttons Visual State
        document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        // Find the button clicked... (simplified for now)

        if(tab === 'purchases') {
            let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;
            if(currentUserDoc.purchased_items && currentUserDoc.purchased_items.length > 0) {
                currentUserDoc.purchased_items.forEach(i => {
                    html += `<a href="${i.link}" target="_blank" style="display:block; padding:15px; background:#121212; border:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none; transition:0.2s;">DOWNLOAD: ${i.name}</a>`;
                });
            } else {
                html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found in local storage.</p>`;
            }
            view.innerHTML = html;
        }

        if(tab === 'verify') {
            if(currentUserDoc.verified) {
                view.innerHTML = `<h3>ID VERIFICATION</h3><p style="color:#0f0;">IDENTITY CONFIRMED. FULL ACCESS GRANTED.</p>`;
            } else {

    window.uploadID = () => {
        const file = document.getElementById('id-file').files[0];
        const status = document.getElementById('upload-status');
        const user = auth.currentUser;
        
        if(!file) return alert("Select a file.");
        
        status.innerText = "ENCRYPTING & UPLOADING...";
        const ref = storage.ref().child(`verification/${user.uid}/${file.name}`);
        
        ref.put(file).then(() => {
            db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).update({ verification_status: 'pending' });
            status.innerText = "UPLOAD SUCCESSFUL. PENDING ADMIN REVIEW.";
        }).catch(e => status.innerText = "ERROR: " + e.message);
    };

    // --- PROFILE ICON ---
    const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
    if(profileIcon) {
        const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);

                dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 10) + 'px';
                dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
            }
        });
    }
    
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none';
    });

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    
    // --- 1. FIREBASE CONFIG ---
    const firebaseConfig = {
        apiKey: "AIzaSyCqad15n5UeSl2AwnfzeIJuZLCNrVm0CrE",
        authDomain: "userportalv2.firebaseapp.com",
        projectId: "userportalv2",
        storageBucket: "userportalv2.firebasestorage.app",

    };

    const app = firebase.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
    const auth = firebase.auth();
    const db = firebase.firestore();
    const storage = firebase.storage();

    let currentUserDoc = null;

    // --- 2. ERROR SANITIZER (Hides "Firebase" text) ---
    const sanitizeError = (message) => {
        if(message.includes('auth/email-already-in-use')) return "Identity already registered. Login instead?";
        if(message.includes('auth/wrong-password')) return "Access Denied: Invalid Credentials.";
        if(message.includes('auth/user-not-found')) return "Identity not found. Register first.";
        if(message.includes('auth/weak-password')) return "Security Alert: Password too weak.";
        if(message.includes('auth/invalid-email')) return "Invalid Email Format.";
        if(message.includes('auth/too-many-requests')) return "System Overload. Wait a moment.";
        return "System Error. Please retry.";
    };

    // --- 3. UI HANDLERS ---
    window.openModal = (type) => {
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';
        document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
        document.getElementById('login-error').innerText = "";
        document.getElementById('reg-error').innerText = "";
        
        if(type === 'login') document.getElementById('firebase-login-modal').style.display = 'block';
        if(type === 'register') document.getElementById('firebase-register-modal').style.display = 'block';
        if(type === 'profile') document.getElementById('firebase-profile-modal').style.display = 'block';
    };

    window.closeAllModals = () => {
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
        document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    };

    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').addEventListener('click', window.closeAllModals);
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-close').forEach(b => b.onclick = window.closeAllModals);

    // --- 4. AUTH ACTIONS ---
    document.getElementById('create-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('reg-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('reg-pass').value;
        auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(e, p).then((cred) => checkProfile(cred.user)).catch(e => document.getElementById('reg-error').textContent = sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    document.getElementById('signin-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('login-password').value;
        auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(e, p).then((cred) => {
            window.closeAllModals();
            checkProfile(cred.user);
        }).catch(e => document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    const checkProfile = async (user) => {
        const doc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
        if (!doc.exists) {
            window.closeAllModals();
            window.openModal('profile');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('save-profile-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const u = auth.currentUser;
        const h = document.getElementById('setup-handle').value;
        const r = document.getElementById('setup-role').value;
        if(u && h) {
            await db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).set({
                handle: h, role: r, email: u.email, verified: false, subscribed: false, created: new Date()
            });
            window.closeAllModals();
            alert("Identity Established. Welcome, " + h);
        }
    });

    window.doLogout = () => { auth.signOut(); window.closeDashboard(); window.closeAllModals(); location.reload(); };
    
    window.resetPass = () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
        if(!e) return alert("Enter email in the login box first.");
        auth.sendPasswordResetEmail(e).then(() => alert("Reset Uplink Sent.")).catch(e => alert(sanitizeError(e.message)));
    };

    // --- 5. DASHBOARD SYSTEM ---
    window.openDashboard = async () => {
        const u = auth.currentUser;
        if(!u) return window.openModal('login');
        
        document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

                dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 10) + 'px';
                dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
            } else { window.openModal('login'); }
        });
    }
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => { if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none'; });

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    
    // 1. FIREBASE CONFIG
    const firebaseConfig = {
        apiKey: "AIzaSyCqad15n5UeSl2AwnfzeIJuZLCNrVm0CrE",
        authDomain: "userportalv2.firebaseapp.com",
        projectId: "userportalv2",
        storageBucket: "userportalv2.firebasestorage.app",
        messagingSenderId: "420794125847",
        appId: "1:420794125847:web:ad75a2d5f7380934061652"
    };

    const app = firebase.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
    const auth = firebase.auth();
    const db = firebase.firestore();
    const storage = firebase.storage();

    let currentUserDoc = null;

    // --- 2. ERROR SANITIZER ---
    const sanitizeError = (message) => {
        if(message.includes('auth/email-already-in-use')) return "Identity already registered. Login instead?";
        if(message.includes('auth/wrong-password')) return "Access Denied: Invalid Credentials.";
        if(message.includes('auth/user-not-found')) return "Identity not found. Register first.";
        if(message.includes('auth/weak-password')) return "Security Alert: Password too weak.";
        if(message.includes('auth/invalid-email')) return "Invalid Email Format.";
        if(message.includes('auth/too-many-requests')) return "System Overload. Wait a moment.";
        return "System Error. Please retry.";
    };

    // --- 3. UI HANDLERS ---
    
    // REUSE CART TOAST FOR CONSISTENCY (If Available)
    const showToast = (msg) => {
        const box = document.getElementById('cruxtoast');
        if(box) {
            const t = document.createElement('div');
            t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
            t.innerHTML = msg;
            box.appendChild(t);
            setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
        } else {
            alert(msg); // Fallback
        }
    };

    window.openModal = (type) => {
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';
        document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
        document.getElementById('login-error').innerText = "";
        document.getElementById('reg-error').innerText = "";
        
        if(type === 'login') document.getElementById('firebase-login-modal').style.display = 'block';
        if(type === 'register') document.getElementById('firebase-register-modal').style.display = 'block';
        if(type === 'profile') document.getElementById('firebase-profile-modal').style.display = 'block';
        if(type === 'reset') document.getElementById('firebase-reset-modal').style.display = 'block';
    };

    window.closeAllModals = () => {
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
        document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    };

    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').addEventListener('click', window.closeAllModals);
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-close').forEach(b => b.onclick = window.closeAllModals);

    // --- 4. AUTH ACTIONS ---
    document.getElementById('create-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('reg-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('reg-pass').value;
        auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(e, p).then((cred) => checkProfile(cred.user)).catch(e => document.getElementById('reg-error').textContent = sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    document.getElementById('signin-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('login-password').value;
        auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(e, p).then((cred) => {
            window.closeAllModals();
            checkProfile(cred.user);
        }).catch(e => document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    const checkProfile = async (user) => {
        const doc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
        if (!doc.exists) {
            window.closeAllModals();
            window.openModal('profile');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('save-profile-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const u = auth.currentUser;
        const h = document.getElementById('setup-handle').value;
        const r = document.getElementById('setup-role').value;
        if(u && h) {
            await db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).set({
                handle: h, role: r, email: u.email, verified: false, subscribed: false, created: new Date()
            });
            window.closeAllModals();
            showToast("Identity Established. Welcome, " + h);
        }
    });

    window.doLogout = () => { auth.signOut(); window.closeDashboard(); window.closeAllModals(); location.reload(); };
    
    // UPDATED: RESET PASSWORD (Using Toast + Pretty Message)
    window.resetPass = () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
        if(!e) return showToast("Please enter your email in the login box first.");
        
        auth.sendPasswordResetEmail(e).then(() => {
            window.closeAllModals();
            showToast(`Encrypted link sent to ${e}.<br>Check spam folder.`);
        }).catch(e => showToast(sanitizeError(e.message)));
    };

    // --- 5. HANDLING THE "FLASHBANG" PAGE ---
    // If the URL has ?mode=resetPassword, capture it and show OUR modal instead of Google's
    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const mode = urlParams.get('mode');
    const oobCode = urlParams.get('oobCode');

    if (mode === 'resetPassword' && oobCode) {
        // Hide normal site interface if needed, or just pop modal
        window.openModal('reset');
        
        document.getElementById('confirm-reset-btn').onclick = () => {
            const newPass = document.getElementById('new-password').value;
            auth.confirmPasswordReset(oobCode, newPass).then(() => {
                showToast("Password Updated. Access Granted.");
                window.openModal('login');
                // Clean URL
                window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
            }).catch(error => {
                showToast("Link Expired or Invalid.");
            });
        }
    }

    // --- 6. DASHBOARD SYSTEM ---
    window.openDashboard = async () => {
        const u = auth.currentUser;
        if(!u) return window.openModal('login');
        
        document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';
        
        const doc = await db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get();
        currentUserDoc = doc.data();
        
        const badge = currentUserDoc.verified ? `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED</span>` : `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;
        document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `<h2>${currentUserDoc.handle}</h2><div style="margin-top:5px; color:#666; font-size:11px;">${currentUserDoc.role} // ${badge}</div>`;
        
        window.switchDashTab('purchases');
    };

    window.closeDashboard = () => {
        document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'none';

The "Dashboard" and "Logout" dropdown is appearing in the wrong place because my previous calculation tried to align it to the left of the icon, which pushes it off-screen on smaller devices or depending on your screen width.

Since the Profile Icon is on the right side of the screen, we need to align the dropdown to the right edge of the icon so it flows inward, not outward.

You do not need to change the Nav Bar code you just pasted. You need to update the Firebase Logic Script (Embed #4) where the positioning math happens.

now I don't see the buttons at all which either means you moved it again or the z-axis is not wehere it was - I have a banner directly beneath the nav bar so if the z index is different I cannot see it.

You are absolutely right—it is a Z-Index war. Carrd banners often sit at very high Z-Index levels (sometimes up to 100,000), so 9000 wasn't enough to float above them.

I have set the Z-Index to Max Safe Integer (essentially infinity in CSS terms) to guarantee they sit on top of everything.

Here is the fix.

1. Fix the Nav Bar (If you are using the Custom Nav HTML)
If your main icons (Cart/Profile) are missing, you need to update the CSS in your Navigation Embed. Find .top-bar-nav and change the z-index:

CSS
.top-bar-nav {
    /* ... other styles ... */

This is a massive expansion. You are effectively moving from building a personal portfolio store to building a Platform (a competitor to Patreon, VGen, or OnlyFans).

That requires a serious upgrade to your "Gatekeeper" logic. We need to implement a Tiered Access System:

Guest: Can browse.

Verified (18+): Can upload media (Video/Audio).

Merchant (Subscribed): Can sell items (User Shops).

The "Scammer Filter" Strategy
The best way to push away scammers isn't just code; it's Friction.

Step 1: They must verify ID (scammers hate leaving a paper trail).

Step 2: They must pay a subscription (scammers hate spending money).

Here is the updated Logic Script (Embed #2). I have completely overhauled the Dashboard to handle these new tiers.

What I added:

Dashboard Tabs: You can now switch between "My Purchases," "Verification," and "Artist Studio."

ID Upload: A secure form to upload an ID (saved to a private storage bucket).

Subscription Gate: The "Artist Studio" is locked. It checks if the user is a subscriber. If not, it shows a "Subscribe Now" button (which you would link to a Stripe Subscription Payment Link).

Verification Gate: You cannot access the studio until an admin (you) flips their verified switch in the database.

            box.appendChild(t);
            setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
        } else {
            alert(msg.replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '')); // Fallback text only
        }
    };

    window.openModal = (type) => {
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';
        document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');

        if(type === 'register') document.getElementById('firebase-register-modal').style.display = 'block';
        if(type === 'profile') document.getElementById('firebase-profile-modal').style.display = 'block';

        }).catch(e => document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = sanitizeError(e.message));

    const checkProfile = async (user) => {
        const doc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
        if (!doc.exists) {
            window.closeAllModals();
            window.openModal('profile');
        }
    };

    document.getElementById('save-profile-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {

            });

        }

                window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, window.location.pathname);
            }).catch(error => showToast("Link Expired or Invalid."));
        }
    }

    // --- 5. DASHBOARD SYSTEM (BULLETPROOFED) ---
    
    window.openDashboard = async () => {
        const u = auth.currentUser;
        if(!u) return window.openModal('login');
        
        // Show UI immediately so user knows something is happening
        document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

            if (doc.exists) {
                currentUserDoc = doc.data();
            } else {
                // FALLBACK: User has login but no database doc. Create dummy data to prevent crash.
                console.log("No profile found, using fallback.");
                currentUserDoc = { handle: "Guest", role: "User", verified: false, subscribed: false, purchased_items: [] };
            }

            // Render Header
            const badge = currentUserDoc.verified ? 
                `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED</span>` : 
                `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;
            
            document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `
                <h2>${currentUserDoc.handle || 'Unknown User'}</h2>

            `;

        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Dashboard Error:", e);
            document.getElementById('dash-main-view').innerHTML = `<p style="color:red">CONNECTION ERROR: ${e.message}</p>`;
        }
    };

    window.closeDashboard = () => {
        document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'none';
        document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
    };

    window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
        // Safety Check
        if(!currentUserDoc) return console.error("User data not loaded yet.");

        const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');
        
        // Update Sidebar Visuals
        document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => {
            b.classList.remove('active');
            if(b.getAttribute('onclick').includes(tab)) b.classList.add('active');
        });
        
        if(tab === 'purchases') {
            let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;

                });
            } else { html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found.</p>`; }
            view.innerHTML = html;
        }
        
        if(tab === 'verify') {

             <p id="upload-status" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>`;
        }
        
        if(tab === 'studio') {

        if(!file) return alert("Select a file.");
        status.innerText = "ENCRYPTING...";
        storage.ref().child(`verification/${auth.currentUser.uid}/${file.name}`).put(file)
            .then(() => { 
                db.collection('users').doc(auth.currentUser.uid).update({ verification_status: 'pending' }); 
                status.innerText = "UPLOAD SUCCESSFUL."; 
            })
            .catch(e => status.innerText = "ERROR: " + e.message);
    };

    // --- ICON HANDLER (Positioning Fix) ---
    const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
    if(profileIcon) {
        const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);

            } else { window.openModal('login'); }
        });
    }
    
    // Close Dropdown on click-away
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => { 
        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none';

when I press the profile / logon icon nothing happens so if something DOES happen - it's not visible because of my banners - you may not have done the z axis thing properly again - but if that's not the case then it's not loading in the right spot (not on screen) or it's innert and not working

You are likely dealing with two problems at once:

The Z-Index War: Carrd banners are notoriously aggressive with Z-Index. I am going to set your modals to the maximum possible integer a browser allows (2147483647), effectively putting them "in orbit" above everything else on the page.

The "Ghost" Button: Sometimes scripts load before the HTML exists. If the script runs before the navigation bar finishes drawing, it tries to click a button that doesn't exist yet.

I have updated the code to (A) Force the highest possible Z-Index and (B) actively hunt for the button until it appears, ensuring the link is established.

PART 1: VISUALS (Replace Embed #3)
Changes: Z-Index set to 2147483647 !important on all overlays/modals.

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
