window.closeDashboard = () => window.closeAllModals();

// --- 6. SWITCH TABS LOGIC ---
window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
    const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');

    // Button Glow Logic
    document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.dash-nav-btn[onclick*="'${tab}'"]`);
    if(activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');

    // 1. PURCHASES TAB
    if(tab === 'purchases') {
        let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;
        if(currentUserDoc.purchased_items && currentUserDoc.purchased_items.length > 0) {
            currentUserDoc.purchased_items.forEach(i => {
                html += `<a href="${i.link}" target="_blank" style="display:block; padding:15px; background:#121212; border:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none;">DOWNLOAD: ${i.name}</a>`;
            });
        } else { html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found.</p>`; }
        view.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // 2. VERIFY TAB
    if(tab === 'verify') {
        view.innerHTML = currentUserDoc.verified ? `<h3>ID VERIFICATION</h3><p style="color:#0f0;">CONFIRMED.</p>` :
        `<h3>ID VERIFICATION REQUIRED</h3>
        <p style="font-size:13px; color:#888;">Upload government ID to unlock features.</p>
        <label for="id-file" class="drop-zone" id="drag-zone">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19.35 10.04C18.67 6.59 15.64 4 12 4 9.11 4 6.6 5.64 5.35 8.04 2.34 8.36 0 10.91 0 14c0 3.31 2.69 6 6 6h13c2.76 0 5-2.24 5-5 0-2.64-2.05-4.78-4.65-4.96zM14 13v4h-4v-4H7l5-5 5 5h-3z"></path></svg>
            <div class="drop-text-main" id="drop-text">SCAN CREDENTIALS</div>
            <div class="drop-text-sub">(CLICK OR DRAG FILE HERE)</div>
        </label>
        <input type="file" id="id-file" onchange="handleManualSelect(this)">
        <button id="transmit-btn" onclick="transmitData()" class="cyber-btn" style="display:none;">TRANSMIT DATA</button>
        <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar"></div></div>
        <p id="upload-status" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>`;
        setTimeout(setupDragDrop, 100);
    }

    // 3. STUDIO TAB
    if(tab === 'studio') {
        if(!currentUserDoc.verified) { view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST STUDIO LOCKED</h3><p style="color:#ff4444;">⚠ Verification required.</p>`; return; }
        if(!currentUserDoc.subscribed) {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED</h3><div style="background:#121212; border:1px solid #40c4ff; padding:20px; text-align:center;"><h4 style="color:#fff;">ARTIST PASS</h4><p style="color:#40c4ff; font-size:24px; font-weight:bold;">$5 / mo</p><a href="${SUBSCRIPTION_URL}" target="_blank" class="cyber-btn" style="display:block; text-decoration:none;">SUBSCRIBE NOW</a></div>`;
        } else { view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST STUDIO</h3><p>Manage assets.</p><button class="cyber-btn">+ UPLOAD NEW ITEM</button>`; }
    }

    // 4. DISCONNECT TAB (Matrix Effect)
    if(tab === 'disconnect') {
        view.innerHTML = `
            <h3 style="color:#ff4444; border-color:#ff4444;">TERMINATION REQUESTED</h3>
            <div style="background:#161616; border:1px solid #333; padding:20px; text-align:center; box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,0,0,0.1) inset;">

                    </div>
                </div>

// --- 7. NEW LOGOUT PROCESS ---
window.processLogout = () => {
    // 1. Hide buttons, show bar
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';

    // 2. Animate Bar
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            // 3. Done
            showToast("DISCONNECTED.");
            setTimeout(() => {
                auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5; // Speed of logout
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50); // Updates every 50ms
};

// --- 8. UPLOAD LOGIC ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0]);
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.transmitData = () => {
    if(!stagedFile) return alert("Select a file first.");
    startUpload(stagedFile);
};

window.startUpload = (file) => {
    const status = document.getElementById('upload-status');
    const progContainer = document.getElementById('prog-container');
    const progBar = document.getElementById('prog-bar');
    const btn = document.getElementById('transmit-btn');
    if(btn) btn.style.display = 'none';

    status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    progContainer.style.display = "block";
    progContainer.style.opacity = "1";
    progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uploadTask = storage.ref().child(`verification/${auth.currentUser.uid}/${file.name}`).put(file);
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        status.innerText = sanitizeError(error.message);
        progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
    },
    () => {
        status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE. PENDING REVIEW.";
        progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
        db.collection('users').doc(auth.currentUser.uid).update({ verification_status: 'pending' });
    });
};

// --- 9. ICON HANDLER ---
const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
if(profileIcon) {
    const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);
    profileIcon.parentNode.replaceChild(newIcon, profileIcon);
    newIcon.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if(auth.currentUser) {
            const rect = newIcon.getBoundingClientRect();
            const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
            dd.style.left = (rect.right - 160) + 'px';
            dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 15) + 'px';
            dd.style.position = 'fixed';
            dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
            dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
        } else { window.openModal('login'); }
    });
}
window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none';
});

// Helper: Ensure normal logout works as disconnect
window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard();
    window.switchDashTab('disconnect');
};

});

ok one other thing - if I click profile icon and then the dashboard button - the dashboard then loads back to the page we left off at - which was the disconnect tab - which is bad. I think THEN after we chose to stay that that tab shouldn't be the one we see - Maybe it should be the one we use the most? or what do you think?

You are absolutely right. That is a bad user experience. It feels like a glitch if you "Abort" a disconnect and then later open your dashboard only to be greeted by the "Termination Requested" screen again.

You are correct: It should default to the "My Downloads" (Purchases) tab every time you open the dashboard. That is the most useful page.

The issue was that the dashboard was "remembering" the last HTML that was inside it. I have updated the logic to force it to reset to "My Downloads" the instant you open it.

I also updated the doLogout function so that if you click "Logout" from the dropdown menu, it correctly forces the Disconnect tab to open.

ok lets set up firebase to accept images - maybe clean inventory sectioning off (this folder holds ID's needing to be processed) (this folder is for profile pictures) (this folder is profile user uploads for art or just general photography) etc.

This is a smart move. Keeping your database organized from the start prevents a massive headache later.

We are going to structure your Firebase Storage like this:

verification/{userID}/ → For ID cards (High Security).

avatars/{userID}/ → For profile pictures (Publicly visible later).

art_uploads/{userID}/ → For general photography/art uploads.

Here is how we implement this. You need to do two things:

1. Update Your Firebase Storage Rules (In the Firebase Console)
You need to tell Firebase that these folders exist and who is allowed to touch them.

Go to Firebase Console.

Click Storage (on the left) -> Rules.

Delete what is there and paste this. It locks folders so users can only upload to their own specific folders.

JavaScript
rules_version = '2';
service firebase.storage {
  match /b/{bucket}/o {
    
    // 1. VERIFICATION FOLDER (IDs)
    // Only the user can write. Only Admins (you) should be able to read (we'll handle admin checks later), 
    // but for now, we allow the user to read their own to confirm upload.
    match /verification/{userId}/{allPaths=**} {
      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
    }

    // 2. AVATARS (Profile Pics)
    // User writes their own. Anyone can read (so others can see their pic).
    match /avatars/{userId}/{allPaths=**} {
      allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
      allow read: if true;
    }

    // 3. ART / UPLOADS
    // User writes their own. Anyone can read.
    match /art_uploads/{userId}/{allPaths=**} {
       allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
       allow read: if true;
    }
  }
}

window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            // Auto-start for drag-drop verification
            startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    
    // Determine which UI elements to update based on folder
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
        statusId = 'upload-status-art';
        progId = 'prog-bar-art';
        containerId = 'prog-container-art';
    }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);
    
    // Hide transmit button if it exists
    const btn = document.getElementById('transmit-btn');
    if(btn) btn.style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) {
        progContainer.style.display = "block";
        progContainer.style.opacity = "1";
    }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uploadTask = storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${auth.currentUser.uid}/${file.name}`).put(file);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
    },
    () => {
        if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
        
        // If it was verification, update the database status
        if(folderName === 'verification') {
             status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE. PENDING REVIEW.";
             db.collection('users').doc(auth.currentUser.uid).update({ verification_status: 'pending' });
        }
        
        // If it was art, maybe give a success toast
        if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
             showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.");
        }
    });
};

// --- 9. ICON HANDLER ---
const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
if(profileIcon) {
    const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);
    profileIcon.parentNode.replaceChild(newIcon, profileIcon);

        if(auth.currentUser) {
            const rect = newIcon.getBoundingClientRect();

Get started with Cloud Firestore Security Rulesbookmark_border



With Cloud Firestore Security Rules, you can focus on building a great user experience without having to manage infrastructure or write server-side authentication and authorization code.

Security rules provide access control and data validation in a simple yet expressive format. To build user-based and role-based access systems that keep your users' data safe, you need to use Firebase Authentication with Cloud Firestore Security Rules.



Note: The server client libraries bypass all Cloud Firestore Security Rules and instead authenticate through Google Application Default Credentials. If you're using the server client libraries or the REST or RPC APIs, make sure to set up Identity and Access Management (IAM) for Cloud Firestore.

Security rules version 2

As of May 2019, version 2 of the Cloud Firestore security rules is now available. Version 2 of the rules changes the behavior of recursive wildcards {name=**}. You must use version 2 if you plan to use collection group queries. You must opt-in to version 2 by making rules_version = '2'; the first line in your security rules:



rules_version = '2';

service cloud.firestore {

match /databases/{database}/documents {

Writing rules

You will write and manage Cloud Firestore Security Rules tailored to the data model you create for the default database and each additional database in your project.

All Cloud Firestore Security Rules consist of match statements, which identify documents in your database, and allow expressions, which control access to those documents:



service cloud.firestore { match /databases/{database}/documents { match /<some_path>/ { allow read, write: if <some_condition>; } }}

Every database request from a Cloud Firestore mobile/web client library is evaluated against your security rules before reading or writing any data. If the rules deny access to any of the specified document paths, the entire request fails.

Below are some examples of basic rule sets. While these rules are valid, they are not recommended for production applications:

Auth required

Deny all

Allow all



// Allow read/write access on all documents to any user signed in to the applicationservice cloud.firestore { match /databases/{database}/documents { match /{document=**} { allow read, write: if request.auth != null; } }}

The {document=**} path used in the examples above matches any document in the entire database. Continue on to the guide for structuring security rules to learn how to match specific data paths and work with hierarchical data.

Testing rules

Cloud Firestore provides a rules simulator that you can use to test your ruleset. You can access the simulator from the Rules tab in the Cloud Firestore section of the Firebase console.

The rules simulator lets you simulate authenticated and unauthenticated reads, writes, and deletes. When you simulate an authenticated request, you can build and preview authentication tokens from various providers. Simulated requests run against the ruleset in your editor, not your currently deployed ruleset.

Deploying rules

Before you can start using Cloud Firestore from your mobile app, you will need to deploy security rules. You can deploy rules in the Firebase console, using the Firebase CLI, or with the Cloud Firestore management REST API.

Updates to Cloud Firestore Security Rules can take up to a minute to affect new queries and listeners. However, it can take up to 10 minutes to fully propagate the changes and affect any active listeners.

Note: When you deploy security rules using the Firebase CLI, the rules defined in your project directory overwrite any existing rules in the Firebase console. So, if you choose to define or edit your security rules using the Firebase console, make sure that you also update the rules defined in your project directory.

Use the Firebase console

To set up and deploy your first set of rules, for the default database in your project, open the Rules tab in the Cloud Firestore section of the Firebase console.

Write your rules in the online editor, then click Publish.

Note: The Firebase console currently supports deployment of Cloud Firestore Security Rules to your project's default database. Future updates will allow you to deploy Rules to additional databases in your project. You can use the Firebase CLI to work with Rules in your multi-database projects.

Use the Firebase CLI

You can also deploy rules using the Firebase CLI. Using the CLI allows you to keep your rules under version control with your application code and deploy rules as part of your existing deployment process.



// Set up Firestore in your project directory, creates a .rules filefirebase init firestore// Edit the generated .rules file to your desired security rules// ...// Deploy rules for all configured databasesfirebase deploy --only firestore

Enhance security for Cloud Storage

Your apps will benefit from the robust database features of Cloud Firestore and the file storage and management features of Cloud Storage. Used together, these products also provide reinforcing app security, since Cloud Firestore can capture authorization requirements usable by Firebase Security Rules for both products. For more, see the guide for Cloud Storage." is any of this relevant? if so can you have me fix this first before we do anything else?

Those warnings look scary, but they are standard for new Firebase projects. They happen because Firebase sets "test mode" rules by default that expire after 30 days (which explains the "October" dates in your alerts). Once that date passes, Firebase locks everything down, causing your app to fail until you put in real rules.

The documentation page you pasted is just a general manual. You don't need to read it. I have written the exact rules you need for both your Database (Firestore) and your Files (Storage).

We need to fix this in two places in your Firebase Console.

Part 1: Fix Database Rules (Firestore)
This fixes the warnings about "denying client requests" for user profiles.

Go to your Firebase Console.

Click Build -> Firestore Database on the left menu.

Click the Rules tab at the top.

Delete whatever code is currently there.

Paste this code (This allows users to create their own profile and read their own data):

JavaScript
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    // Match the users collection
    match /users/{userId} {
      // Allow anyone to read user profiles (so you can see who is who)
      allow read: if true;
      
      // Allow users to create/edit ONLY their own document
      allow create, update: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
    }
  }
}
Click Publish.

Part 2: Fix Storage Rules (Files/Images)
This sets up the folders we discussed (IDs, Avatars, Art) so the new code I gave you works.

Click Build -> Storage on the left menu.

Click the Rules tab at the top.

Delete whatever code is there.

Paste this code:

JavaScript
rules_version = '2';
service firebase.storage {
  match /b/{bucket}/o {
    
    // 1. VERIFICATION FOLDER (IDs)
    // Only the user can write. Only Admins should read (for now, user can read their own to confirm).
    match /verification/{userId}/{allPaths=**} {
      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
    }

    // 2. AVATARS (Profile Pics)
    // User writes their own. Anyone can read.
    match /avatars/{userId}/{allPaths=**} {
      allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
      allow read: if true;
    }

    // 3. ART / UPLOADS
    // User writes their own. Anyone can read.
    match /art_uploads/{userId}/{allPaths=**} {
       allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
       allow read: if true;
    }
  }
}
Click Publish.

That’s it. Those warnings should stop impacting your app immediately (though the old alerts might stay in your notifications history for a while).

The "Blaze" Plan (Pay-as-you-go) also gives you that same 5GB for free, but you pay if you go over it.

Because you are just developing and testing, you will not be charged (unless you somehow upload 50,000 images overnight).

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            showToast("DISCONNECTED.");
            setTimeout(() => {
                auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- 8. UPLOAD LOGIC ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        startUpload(input.files[0], 'art_uploads');
    }
};

window.transmitData = () => {
    if(!stagedFile) return alert("Select a file first.");
    startUpload(stagedFile, 'verification');
};

window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
        statusId = 'upload-status-art';
        progId = 'prog-bar-art';
        containerId = 'prog-container-art';
    }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);
    const btn = document.getElementById('transmit-btn');
    if(btn) btn.style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uploadTask = storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${auth.currentUser.uid}/${file.name}`).put(file);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
    },
    () => {
        if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
        if(folderName === 'verification') {
             status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE. PENDING REVIEW.";
             db.collection('users').doc(auth.currentUser.uid).update({ verification_status: 'pending' });
        }
        if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
             showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.");
        }
    });
};

// --- 9. ICON HANDLER ---
const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
if(profileIcon) {
    const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);
    profileIcon.parentNode.replaceChild(newIcon, profileIcon);
    newIcon.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if(auth.currentUser) {
            const rect = newIcon.getBoundingClientRect();
            const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
            dd.style.left = (rect.right - 160) + 'px';
            dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 15) + 'px';
            dd.style.position = 'fixed';
            dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
            dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
        } else { window.openModal('login'); }
    });
}
window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none';
});

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect');

    if(message.includes('auth/wrong-password')) return "Access Denied.";
    if(message.includes('auth/user-not-found')) return "Identity not found.";
    return "System Error: " + message;
};

const showToast = (msg) => {
    const box = document.getElementById('cruxtoast');
    if(box) {
        const t = document.createElement('div');
        t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
        t.innerHTML = msg;
        box.appendChild(t);
        setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
    } else { alert(msg.replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '')); }
};

// --- 3. UI HANDLERS ---
window.openModal = (type) => {
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';
    document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    if(type === 'login') document.getElementById('firebase-login-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'register') document.getElementById('firebase-register-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'profile') document.getElementById('firebase-profile-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'reset') document.getElementById('firebase-reset-modal').style.display = 'block';
};

window.closeAllModals = () => {
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
    document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (e.target.id === 'firebase-modal-overlay') window.closeAllModals();
});
document.querySelectorAll('.modal-close').forEach(b => b.onclick = window.closeAllModals);

// --- 4. AUTH ---
document.getElementById('create-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const e = document.getElementById('reg-email').value;
    const p = document.getElementById('reg-pass').value;
    auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(e, p).then((cred) => checkProfile(cred.user)).catch(e => document.getElementById('reg-error').textContent = sanitizeError(e.message));
});

document.getElementById('signin-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
    const p = document.getElementById('login-password').value;
    auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(e, p).then((cred) => {
        window.closeAllModals();
        checkProfile(cred.user);
    }).catch(e => document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = sanitizeError(e.message));
});

const checkProfile = async (user) => {
    const doc = await db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
    if (!doc.exists) {
        window.closeAllModals();
        window.openModal('profile');
    }
};

document.getElementById('save-profile-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const u = auth.currentUser;
    const h = document.getElementById('setup-handle').value;
    const r = document.getElementById('setup-role').value;
    if(u && h) {
        await db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).set({
            handle: h, role: r, email: u.email, verified: false, subscribed: false, created: new Date()
        });
        window.closeAllModals();
        showToast("Identity Established. Welcome, " + h);
    }
});

window.resetPass = () => {
    const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
    if(!e) return showToast("Enter email in box first.");
    auth.sendPasswordResetEmail(e).then(()=>showToast("Reset Link Sent.")).catch(e=>showToast(sanitizeError(e.message)));
};

// --- 5. DASHBOARD ---
window.openDashboard = async (targetTab = 'purchases') => {
    const u = auth.currentUser;
    if(!u) return window.openModal('login');

    window.switchDashTab(targetTab);

    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

    try {
        const doc = await db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get();
        currentUserDoc = doc.exists ? doc.data() : { handle: "Guest", role: "User", verified: false };
        
        const badge = currentUserDoc.verified ? `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED</span>` : `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;
        document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `<h2>${currentUserDoc.handle}</h2><div style="margin-top:5px; color:#666; font-size:11px;">${currentUserDoc.role} // ${badge}</div>`;
        
        // Refresh with data loaded
        window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
};

window.closeDashboard = () => window.closeAllModals();

// --- 6. SWITCH TABS LOGIC ---
window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
    const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');

    document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.dash-nav-btn[onclick*="'${tab}'"]`);
    if(activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');

    if(tab === 'purchases') {
        let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;
        if(currentUserDoc.purchased_items && currentUserDoc.purchased_items.length > 0) {
            currentUserDoc.purchased_items.forEach(i => {
                html += `<a href="${i.link}" target="_blank" style="display:block; padding:15px; background:#121212; border:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none;">DOWNLOAD: ${i.name}</a>`;
            });
        } else { html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found.</p>`; }
        view.innerHTML = html;
    }

    if(tab === 'verify') {
        // STATE 1: ALREADY VERIFIED
        if(currentUserDoc.verified) {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ID VERIFICATION</h3><p style="color:#0f0; font-size:1.2rem;">IDENTITY CONFIRMED.</p><p style="color:#666;">You have full access to the Artist Studio.</p>`;
        } 
        // STATE 2: PENDING (The new persistent state)
        else if(currentUserDoc.verification_status === 'pending') {
            view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>VERIFICATION PENDING</h3>
                <div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #d4a017; background: rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.1); text-align:center;">
                    <p style="color:#d4a017; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.1rem; margin-bottom:10px;">PROCESSING CREDENTIALS</p>
                    <p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem;">Your documentation has been received and is currently under review.</p>
                    <p style="color:#666; font-size:0.8rem; margin-top:15px;">You will be notified once status updates.</p>
                </div>
            `;
        } 
        // STATE 3: UNVERIFIED (Show Upload Form)
        else {
            view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ID VERIFICATION REQUIRED</h3>
                <p style="font-size:13px; color:#888;">Upload government ID to unlock features.</p>
                <label for="id-file" class="drop-zone" id="drag-zone">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19.35 10.04C18.67 6.59 15.64 4 12 4 9.11 4 6.6 5.64 5.35 8.04 2.34 8.36 0 10.91 0 14c0 3.31 2.69 6 6 6h13c2.76 0 5-2.24 5-5 0-2.64-2.05-4.78-4.65-4.96zM14 13v4h-4v-4H7l5-5 5 5h-3z"></path></svg>
                    <div class="drop-text-main" id="drop-text">SCAN CREDENTIALS</div>
                    <div class="drop-text-sub">(CLICK OR DRAG FILE HERE)</div>
                </label>
                <input type="file" id="id-file" onchange="handleManualSelect(this)">
                <button id="transmit-btn" onclick="transmitData()" class="cyber-btn" style="display:none;">TRANSMIT DATA</button>
                
                <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-verify"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-verify"></div></div>
                <p id="upload-status-verify" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
            `;
            setTimeout(setupDragDrop, 100);
        }
    }

    if(tab === 'studio') {
        if(!currentUserDoc.verified) { view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST STUDIO LOCKED</h3><p style="color:#ff4444;">⚠ Verification required.</p>`; return; }
        if(!currentUserDoc.subscribed) {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED</h3><div style="background:#121212; border:1px solid #40c4ff; padding:20px; text-align:center;"><h4 style="color:#fff;">ARTIST PASS</h4><p style="color:#40c4ff; font-size:24px; font-weight:bold;">$5 / mo</p><a href="${SUBSCRIPTION_URL}" target="_blank" class="cyber-btn" style="display:block; text-decoration:none;">SUBSCRIBE NOW</a></div>`;
        } else { 
            view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ARTIST STUDIO</h3>
                <p>Upload your artwork to your portfolio.</p>
                <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('art-file-input').click()">+ UPLOAD NEW ITEM</button>
                <input type="file" id="art-file-input" style="display:none;" onchange="handleArtUpload(this)">
                
                <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-art" style="margin-top:20px;"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-art"></div></div>
                <p id="upload-status-art" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
            `; 
        }
    }

    if(tab === 'disconnect') {
        view.innerHTML = `
            <h3 style="color:#ff4444; border-color:#ff4444;">TERMINATION REQUESTED</h3>
            <div style="background:#161616; border:1px solid #333; padding:20px; text-align:center; box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,0,0,0.1) inset;">
                <p style="color:#fff; font-size:1.1rem; font-family:monospace; margin-bottom:10px;">NEURAL LINK: <span style="color:#0f0;">ACTIVE</span></p>
                <p style="color:#aaa; line-height:1.5;">You are attempting to sever the connection.<br>Do you wish to leave the matrix?</p>
                <div id="disconnect-actions" style="margin-top:25px; display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:center;">
                    <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="closeDashboard()" style="border-color:#444; color:#aaa;">ABORT</button>
                    <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="processLogout()" style="border-color:#ff4444; color:#ff4444; background:rgba(255,0,0,0.1);">EJECT</button>
                </div>
                <div id="logout-sequence" style="display:none; margin-top:20px;">
                    <p style="color:#ff4444; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:2px;">SEVERING CONNECTION...</p>
                    <div class="upload-progress-container" style="opacity:1; display:block; background:#300;">
                        <div id="logout-bar" class="upload-progress-bar" style="background:#ff0000; width:0%; box-shadow:0 0 10px #ff0000;"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }
};

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            showToast("DISCONNECTED.");
            setTimeout(() => {
                auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- 8. UPLOAD LOGIC ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        startUpload(input.files[0], 'art_uploads');
    }
};

window.transmitData = () => {
    if(!stagedFile) return alert("Select a file first.");
    startUpload(stagedFile, 'verification');
};

window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
        statusId = 'upload-status-art';
        progId = 'prog-bar-art';
        containerId = 'prog-container-art';
    }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);
    const btn = document.getElementById('transmit-btn');
    if(btn) btn.style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uploadTask = storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${auth.currentUser.uid}/${file.name}`).put(file);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
    },
    () => {
        if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
        if(folderName === 'verification') {
             status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE. PENDING REVIEW.";
             // UPDATE LOCAL DATA IMMEDIATELY SO UI DOESN'T FLICKER
             currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
             db.collection('users').doc(auth.currentUser.uid).update({ verification_status: 'pending' });
             
             // Refresh tab after 1.5 seconds to show the "Pending" screen
             setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1500);
        }
        if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
             showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.");
        }
    });
};

// --- 9. ICON HANDLER ---
const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
if(profileIcon) {
    const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);
    profileIcon.parentNode.replaceChild(newIcon, profileIcon);
    newIcon.addEventListener('click', () => {
        if(auth.currentUser) {
            const rect = newIcon.getBoundingClientRect();
            const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
            dd.style.left = (rect.right - 160) + 'px';
            dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 15) + 'px';
            dd.style.position = 'fixed';
            dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
            dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
        } else { window.openModal('login'); }
    });
}
window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none';
});

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

});

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.");
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- 6. UPLOAD LOGIC ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.startUpload(input.files[0], 'art_uploads');
    }
};

window.transmitData = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return alert("Select a file first.");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'verification');
};

window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
        statusId = 'upload-status-art';
        progId = 'prog-bar-art';
        containerId = 'prog-container-art';
    }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);
    const btn = document.getElementById('transmit-btn');
    if(btn) btn.style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${window.auth.currentUser.uid}/${file.name}`).put(file);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
    },
    () => {
        if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
        
        if(folderName === 'verification') {
             status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE. PENDING REVIEW.";
             window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
             window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).update({ verification_status: 'pending' });
             setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1500);
        }
        if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
             window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.");
        }
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

window.sanitizeError = (message) => {
    if(message.includes('auth/email-already-in-use')) return "Identity already registered.";
    if(message.includes('auth/wrong-password')) return "Access Denied.";
    if(message.includes('auth/user-not-found')) return "Identity not found.";

};

window.showToast = (msg) => {
    const box = document.getElementById('cruxtoast');
    if(box) {
        const t = document.createElement('div');
        t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
        t.innerHTML = msg;
        box.appendChild(t);
        setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
    } else { alert(msg.replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '')); }
};

// --- 3. BASIC UI HANDLERS ---
window.openModal = (type) => {
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';
    document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    if(type === 'login') document.getElementById('firebase-login-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'register') document.getElementById('firebase-register-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'profile') document.getElementById('firebase-profile-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'reset') document.getElementById('firebase-reset-modal').style.display = 'block';
};

window.closeAllModals = () => {
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
    document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

// --- 4. AUTH EVENT LISTENERS ---
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    
    // Close on overlay click
    const overlay = document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay');
    if(overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target.id === 'firebase-modal-overlay') window.closeAllModals();
    });
    
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-close').forEach(b => b.onclick = window.closeAllModals);

    // Login / Register / Reset Buttons
    const createBtn = document.getElementById('create-btn');
    if(createBtn) createBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('reg-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('reg-pass').value;
        window.auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(e, p)
            .then((cred) => window.checkProfile(cred.user))
            .catch(e => document.getElementById('reg-error').textContent = window.sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    const signinBtn = document.getElementById('signin-btn');
    if(signinBtn) signinBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('login-password').value;
        window.auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(e, p)
            .then((cred) => {
                window.closeAllModals();
                window.checkProfile(cred.user);
            })
            .catch(e => document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = window.sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    const saveProfileBtn = document.getElementById('save-profile-btn');
    if(saveProfileBtn) saveProfileBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const u = window.auth.currentUser;
        const h = document.getElementById('setup-handle').value;
        const r = document.getElementById('setup-role').value;
        if(u && h) {
            await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).set({
                handle: h, role: r, email: u.email, verified: false, subscribed: false, created: new Date()
            });
            window.closeAllModals();
            window.showToast("Identity Established. Welcome, " + h);
        }
    });
});

window.checkProfile = async (user) => {
    const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
    if (!doc.exists) {
        window.closeAllModals();
        window.openModal('profile');
    }
};

window.resetPass = () => {
    const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
    if(!e) return window.showToast("Enter email in box first.");
    window.auth.sendPasswordResetEmail(e)
        .then(()=>window.showToast("Reset Link Sent."))
        .catch(e=>window.showToast(window.sanitizeError(e.message)));
};
</script>

<script>
// --- 5. DASHBOARD LOGIC ---
window.openDashboard = async (targetTab = 'purchases') => {
    const u = window.auth.currentUser;
    if(!u) return window.openModal('login');

    // Clear state
    window.switchDashTab(targetTab);

    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

    try {
        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get();
        window.currentUserDoc = doc.exists ? doc.data() : { handle: "Guest", role: "User", verified: false };
        
        const badge = window.currentUserDoc.verified ? `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED</span>` : `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;
        document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `<h2>${window.currentUserDoc.handle}</h2><div style="margin-top:5px; color:#666; font-size:11px;">${window.currentUserDoc.role} // ${badge}</div>`;
        
        // Refresh Tab
        window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
};

window.closeDashboard = () => window.closeAllModals();

window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
    const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');

    document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.dash-nav-btn[onclick*="'${tab}'"]`);
    if(activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');

    // TAB: PURCHASES
    if(tab === 'purchases') {
        let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items && window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.length > 0) {
            window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.forEach(i => {
                html += `<a href="${i.link}" target="_blank" style="display:block; padding:15px; background:#121212; border:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none;">DOWNLOAD: ${i.name}</a>`;
            });
        } else { html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found.</p>`; }
        view.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // TAB: VERIFY
    if(tab === 'verify') {
        if(window.currentUserDoc.verified) {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ID VERIFICATION</h3><p style="color:#0f0; font-size:1.2rem;">IDENTITY CONFIRMED.</p><p style="color:#666;">You have full access to the Artist Studio.</p>`;
        } 
        else if(window.currentUserDoc.verification_status === 'pending') {
            view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>VERIFICATION PENDING</h3>
                <div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #d4a017; background: rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.1); text-align:center;">
                    <p style="color:#d4a017; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.1rem; margin-bottom:10px;">PROCESSING CREDENTIALS</p>
                    <p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem;">Your documentation has been received and is currently under review.</p>
                    <p style="color:#666; font-size:0.8rem; margin-top:15px;">You will be notified once status updates.</p>
                </div>`;
        } 
        else {
            view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ID VERIFICATION REQUIRED</h3>
                <p style="font-size:13px; color:#888;">Upload government ID to unlock features.</p>
                <label for="id-file" class="drop-zone" id="drag-zone">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19.35 10.04C18.67 6.59 15.64 4 12 4 9.11 4 6.6 5.64 5.35 8.04 2.34 8.36 0 10.91 0 14c0 3.31 2.69 6 6 6h13c2.76 0 5-2.24 5-5 0-2.64-2.05-4.78-4.65-4.96zM14 13v4h-4v-4H7l5-5 5 5h-3z"></path></svg>
                    <div class="drop-text-main" id="drop-text">SCAN CREDENTIALS</div>
                    <div class="drop-text-sub">(CLICK OR DRAG FILE HERE)</div>
                </label>
                <input type="file" id="id-file" onchange="handleManualSelect(this)">
                <button id="transmit-btn" onclick="transmitData()" class="cyber-btn" style="display:none;">TRANSMIT DATA</button>
                <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-verify"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-verify"></div></div>
                <p id="upload-status-verify" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
            `;
            setTimeout(window.setupDragDrop, 100);
        }
    }

    // TAB: STUDIO
    if(tab === 'studio') {
        if(!window.currentUserDoc.verified) { view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST STUDIO LOCKED</h3><p style="color:#ff4444;">⚠ Verification required.</p>`; return; }
        if(!window.currentUserDoc.subscribed) {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED</h3><div style="background:#121212; border:1px solid #40c4ff; padding:20px; text-align:center;"><h4 style="color:#fff;">ARTIST PASS</h4><p style="color:#40c4ff; font-size:24px; font-weight:bold;">$5 / mo</p><a href="${window.SUBSCRIPTION_URL}" target="_blank" class="cyber-btn" style="display:block; text-decoration:none;">SUBSCRIBE NOW</a></div>`;
        } else { 
            view.innerHTML = `

                    <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="closeDashboard()" style="border-color:#444; color:#aaa;">ABORT</button>
                    <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="processLogout()" style="border-color:#ff4444; color:#ff4444; background:rgba(255,0,0,0.1);">EJECT</button>
                </div>
                <div id="logout-sequence" style="display:none; margin-top:20px;">
                    <p style="color:#ff4444; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:2px;">SEVERING CONNECTION...</p>
                    <div class="upload-progress-container" style="opacity:1; display:block; background:#300;">
                        <div id="logout-bar" class="upload-progress-bar" style="background:#ff0000; width:0%; box-shadow:0 0 10px #ff0000;"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }
};

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.");
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- 6. UPLOAD LOGIC ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.startUpload(input.files[0], 'art_uploads');
    }
};

window.transmitData = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return alert("Select a file first.");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'verification');
};

window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
        statusId = 'upload-status-art';
        progId = 'prog-bar-art';
        containerId = 'prog-container-art';
    }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);
    const btn = document.getElementById('transmit-btn');
    if(btn) btn.style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${window.auth.currentUser.uid}/${file.name}`).put(file);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
    },
    () => {
        if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
        
        if(folderName === 'verification') {
             status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE. PENDING REVIEW.";
             window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
             window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).update({ verification_status: 'pending' });
             setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1500);
        }
        if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
             window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.");
        }
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

// --- 7. ICON HANDLER ---
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
    if(profileIcon) {
        const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);
        profileIcon.parentNode.replaceChild(newIcon, profileIcon);
        newIcon.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if(window.auth.currentUser) {
                const rect = newIcon.getBoundingClientRect();
                const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
                dd.style.left = (rect.right - 160) + 'px';
                dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 15) + 'px';
                dd.style.position = 'fixed';
                dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
                dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
            } else { window.openModal('login'); }
        });
    }
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none';
    });
});

<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.6.1/firebase-app-compat.js"></script>
<script src="https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/9.6.1/firebase-auth-compat.js"></script>
