<script>
// --- GLOBAL VARIABLES ---
window.currentUserDoc = {};
window.stagedFile = null;
window.SUBSCRIPTION_URL = "https://buy.stripe.com/YOUR_LINK_HERE";

// --- 1. FIREBASE CONFIG ---
const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyCqad15n5UeSl2AwnfzeIJuZLCNrVm0CrE",
    authDomain: "userportalv2.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "userportalv2",
    storageBucket: "userportalv2.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "420794125847",
    appId: "1:420794125847:web:ad75a2d5f7380934061652"
};

// Initialize globally
window.app = firebase.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
window.auth = firebase.auth();
window.db = firebase.firestore();
window.storage = firebase.storage();

// --- 2. HELPERS ---
window.sanitizeError = (message) => {
    if(message.includes('auth/email-already-in-use')) return "Identity already registered.";
    if(message.includes('auth/wrong-password')) return "Access Denied.";
    if(message.includes('auth/user-not-found')) return "Identity not found.";
    return "System Error: " + message;
};

window.showToast = (msg) => {
    const box = document.getElementById('cruxtoast');
    if(box) {
        const t = document.createElement('div');
        t.className = 'crux-toast-msg';
        t.innerHTML = msg;
        box.appendChild(t);
        setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(),300); }, 3000);
    } else { alert(msg.replace(/<[^>]*>?/gm, '')); }
};

// --- 3. BASIC UI HANDLERS ---
window.openModal = (type) => {
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';
    document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    if(type === 'login') document.getElementById('firebase-login-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'register') document.getElementById('firebase-register-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'profile') document.getElementById('firebase-profile-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'reset') document.getElementById('firebase-reset-modal').style.display = 'block';
};

window.closeAllModals = () => {
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
    document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

// --- 4. AUTH EVENT LISTENERS ---
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay');
    if(overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target.id === 'firebase-modal-overlay') window.closeAllModals();
    });
    
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-close').forEach(b => b.onclick = window.closeAllModals);

    const createBtn = document.getElementById('create-btn');
    if(createBtn) createBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('reg-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('reg-pass').value;
        window.auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(e, p)
            .then((cred) => window.checkProfile(cred.user))
            .catch(e => document.getElementById('reg-error').textContent = window.sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    const signinBtn = document.getElementById('signin-btn');
    if(signinBtn) signinBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('login-password').value;
        window.auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(e, p)
            .then((cred) => {
                window.closeAllModals();
                window.checkProfile(cred.user);
            })
            .catch(e => document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = window.sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    const saveProfileBtn = document.getElementById('save-profile-btn');
    if(saveProfileBtn) saveProfileBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const u = window.auth.currentUser;
        const h = document.getElementById('setup-handle').value;
        const r = document.getElementById('setup-role').value;
        if(u && h) {
            await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).set({
                handle: h, 
                role: r, 
                email: u.email, 
                verified: false,        // ID Verified
                verification_status: 'unverified',
                artist_status: 'unverified', // Artist Video Proof
                subscription: 'free',   // free, subscribed, premium
                created: new Date(),
                rejection_count: 0
            });
            window.closeAllModals();
            window.showToast("Identity Established. Welcome, " + h);
        }
    });
});

window.checkProfile = async (user) => {
    const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
    if (!doc.exists) {
        window.closeAllModals();
        window.openModal('profile');
    }
};

window.resetPass = () => {
    const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
    if(!e) return window.showToast("Enter email in box first.");
    window.auth.sendPasswordResetEmail(e)
        .then(()=>window.showToast("Reset Link Sent."))
        .catch(e=>window.showToast(window.sanitizeError(e.message)));
};
</script>
FIREBASE EMBED 3: Features (Dashboard, Logic, Uploads)
Paste this into the Third Firebase Embed. This handles the complex logic: Persistent Verification, Rejections (5 strikes), Artist Video Proof, and Infinite Uploads for Premium.

HTML
<script>
// --- 5. DASHBOARD LOGIC ---
window.openDashboard = async (targetTab = 'purchases') => {
    const u = window.auth.currentUser;
    if(!u) return window.openModal('login');

    window.switchDashTab(targetTab);

    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

    try {
        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get();
        // Force refresh local data on open
        window.currentUserDoc = doc.exists ? doc.data() : { handle: "Guest", role: "User", verified: false, verification_status: 'unverified' };
        
        // --- BADGE LOGIC ---
        let badgesHtml = "";
        if(window.currentUserDoc.verified) badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED ID</span>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'subscribed') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-subscribed">ARTIST PASS</span>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'premium') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-premium">PREMIUM</span>`;
        if(!badgesHtml) badgesHtml = `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;

        document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `<h2>${window.currentUserDoc.handle}</h2><div style="margin-top:5px; color:#666; font-size:11px;">${window.currentUserDoc.role} // ${badgesHtml}</div>`;
        
        window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
};

window.closeDashboard = () => window.closeAllModals();

window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
    const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');

    document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.dash-nav-btn[onclick*="'${tab}'"]`);
    if(activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');

    // TAB: PURCHASES
    if(tab === 'purchases') {
        let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items && window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.length > 0) {
            window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.forEach(i => {
                html += `<a href="${i.link}" target="_blank" style="display:block; padding:15px; background:#121212; border:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none;">DOWNLOAD: ${i.name}</a>`;
            });
        } else { html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found.</p>`; }
        view.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // TAB: ID VERIFICATION (PERSISTENT STATE & APPEALS)
    if(tab === 'verify') {
        const status = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status || 'unverified';
        const appeals = window.currentUserDoc.rejection_count || 0;
        const appealsLeft = 5 - appeals;

        // 1. VERIFIED
        if(status === 'verified') {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ID VERIFICATION</h3><p style="color:#0f0; font-size:1.2rem;">IDENTITY CONFIRMED.</p><p style="color:#666;">Step 1 Complete. You may now apply for Artist Status.</p>`;
        } 
        // 2. PENDING (PERSISTENT!)
        else if(status === 'pending') {
            view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>VERIFICATION PENDING</h3>
                <div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #d4a017; background: rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.1); text-align:center;">
                    <p style="color:#d4a017; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.1rem; margin-bottom:10px;">UNDER REVIEW</p>
                    <p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem;">Your documentation is currently in the queue.</p>
                    <p style="color:#666; font-size:0.8rem; margin-top:15px;">Check back later. Do not re-upload.</p>
                </div>`;
        }
        // 3. REJECTED / BANNED
        else if(status === 'rejected') {
            if(appealsLeft <= 0) {
                 view.innerHTML = `
                    <h3 style="color:#ff0000;">ACCESS DENIED</h3>
                    <div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #ff0000; background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1); text-align:center;">
                        <p style="color:#ff0000; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem;">ACCOUNT REJECTED</p>
                        <p style="color:#aaa;">You have exhausted all appeal attempts.</p>
                    </div>`;
            } else {
                view.innerHTML = `
                    <h3 style="color:#ff4444;">VERIFICATION REJECTED</h3>
                    <p style="color:#aaa;">Your ID was rejected. Please ensure it is clear and valid.</p>
                    <p style="color:#ff4444; font-weight:bold;">Appeals Remaining: ${appealsLeft}</p>
                    <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="retryVerify()">TRY AGAIN</button>
                `;
            }
        } 
        // 4. UNVERIFIED (Default)
        else {
            renderVerifyUpload(view);
        }
    }

    // TAB: ARTIST STUDIO (New Video Proof Logic)
    if(tab === 'studio') {
        // Must have ID first
        if(!window.currentUserDoc.verified) { 
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST STUDIO LOCKED</h3><p style="color:#ff4444;">⚠ Step 1: ID Verification required first.</p>`; return; 
        }

        // Must Subscribed (Artist Pass or Premium)
        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'free') {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>SUBSCRIPTION REQUIRED</h3><div style="background:#121212; border:1px solid #40c4ff; padding:20px; text-align:center;"><h4 style="color:#fff;">ARTIST PASS</h4><p style="color:#40c4ff; font-size:24px; font-weight:bold;">$5 / mo</p><a href="${window.SUBSCRIPTION_URL}" target="_blank" class="cyber-btn" style="display:block; text-decoration:none;">SUBSCRIBE NOW</a></div>`;
            return;
        }

        const artistStatus = window.currentUserDoc.artist_status || 'unverified';

        // ARTIST PROOF FLOW
        if(artistStatus === 'verified') {
             view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ARTIST STUDIO</h3>
                <p>Welcome, Artist. Upload your work.</p>
                <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('art-file-input').click()">+ UPLOAD ARTWORK</button>
                <input type="file" id="art-file-input" style="display:none;" onchange="handleArtUpload(this)">
                
                <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-art" style="margin-top:20px;"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-art"></div></div>
                <p id="upload-status-art" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
            `; 
        } else if(artistStatus === 'pending') {
             view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ARTIST VERIFICATION PENDING</h3>
                <div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #b28dff; background: rgba(178, 141, 255, 0.1); text-align:center;">
                    <p style="color:#b28dff; font-weight:bold;">REVIEWING VIDEO PROOF</p>
                    <p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem;">We are analyzing your process video for AI usage.</p>
                </div>`;
        } else {
             // VIDEO UPLOAD FORM
             view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ARTIST PROOF REQUIRED</h3>
                <p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem;">To ensure quality, you must prove you are human.</p>
                <div style="background:#1a1a1a; padding:15px; border-left:2px solid #ff4444; margin-bottom:15px;">
                    <p style="color:#fff; font-size:0.8rem; margin:0;"><strong>REQUIREMENTS:</strong><br>• Video of you drawing (Screen record or Camera)<br>• Layers must be visible<br>• NO Timelapses<br>• Max 30 seconds</p>
                </div>
                
                <label for="video-file" class="drop-zone" id="drag-zone-vid">
                    <div class="drop-text-main" id="drop-text-vid">UPLOAD PROOF VIDEO</div>
                </label>
                <input type="file" id="video-file" accept="video/*" onchange="handleVideoSelect(this)">
                <button id="transmit-btn-vid" onclick="transmitVideo()" class="cyber-btn" style="display:none;">TRANSMIT PROOF</button>
                
                <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-vid"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-vid"></div></div>
                <p id="upload-status-vid" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
             `;
        }
    }

    // TAB: DISCONNECT
    if(tab === 'disconnect') {
        view.innerHTML = `
            <h3 style="color:#ff4444; border-color:#ff4444;">TERMINATION REQUESTED</h3>
            <div style="background:#161616; border:1px solid #333; padding:20px; text-align:center; box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,0,0,0.1) inset;">
                <p style="color:#fff; font-size:1.1rem; font-family:monospace; margin-bottom:10px;">NEURAL LINK: <span style="color:#0f0;">ACTIVE</span></p>
                <p style="color:#aaa; line-height:1.5;">You are attempting to sever the connection.<br>Do you wish to leave the matrix?</p>
                <div id="disconnect-actions" style="margin-top:25px; display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:center;">
                    <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="closeDashboard()" style="border-color:#444; color:#aaa;">ABORT</button>
                    <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="processLogout()" style="border-color:#ff4444; color:#ff4444; background:rgba(255,0,0,0.1);">EJECT</button>
                </div>
                <div id="logout-sequence" style="display:none; margin-top:20px;">
                    <p style="color:#ff4444; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:2px;">SEVERING CONNECTION...</p>
                    <div class="upload-progress-container" style="opacity:1; display:block; background:#300;">
                        <div id="logout-bar" class="upload-progress-bar" style="background:#ff0000; width:0%; box-shadow:0 0 10px #ff0000;"></div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
    }
};

window.renderVerifyUpload = (view) => {
    view.innerHTML = `
        <h3>ID VERIFICATION REQUIRED</h3>
        <p style="font-size:13px; color:#888;">Upload government ID to unlock features.</p>
        <label for="id-file" class="drop-zone" id="drag-zone">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19.35 10.04C18.67 6.59 15.64 4 12 4 9.11 4 6.6 5.64 5.35 8.04 2.34 8.36 0 10.91 0 14c0 3.31 2.69 6 6 6h13c2.76 0 5-2.24 5-5 0-2.64-2.05-4.78-4.65-4.96zM14 13v4h-4v-4H7l5-5 5 5h-3z"></path></svg>
            <div class="drop-text-main" id="drop-text">SCAN CREDENTIALS</div>
        </label>
        <input type="file" id="id-file" onchange="handleManualSelect(this)">
        <button id="transmit-btn" onclick="transmitData()" class="cyber-btn" style="display:none;">TRANSMIT DATA</button>
        <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-verify"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-verify"></div></div>
        <p id="upload-status-verify" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
    `;
    setTimeout(window.setupDragDrop, 100);
}

window.retryVerify = () => {
    window.renderVerifyUpload(document.getElementById('dash-main-view'));
}

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.");
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- 6. UPLOAD LOGIC ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.handleVideoSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text-vid').innerText = "VIDEO STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid').style.borderColor = "#b28dff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'block';
    }
}

window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.startUpload(input.files[0], 'art_uploads');
    }
};

window.transmitData = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return alert("Select a file first.");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'verification');
};

window.transmitVideo = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return alert("Select a video first.");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'artist_proofs');
};

window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
        statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art';
    }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {

Here is the complete code for your Firebase Storage Rules. You can delete everything currently in that window and paste this single block.

Firebase Console -> Storage -> Rules
JavaScript
rules_version = '2';
service firebase.storage {
  match /b/{bucket}/o {
    
    // 1. VERIFICATION FOLDER (IDs)
    // High security: Only the user can read/write their own ID.
    match /verification/{userId}/{allPaths=**} {
      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
    }

    // 2. ARTIST PROOFS (Videos)
    // High security: Only the user can read/write their proof video.
    match /artist_proofs/{userId}/{allPaths=**} {
      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
    }

    // 3. AVATARS (Profile Pics)
    // User uploads, but anyone on the internet can see it (Public).
    match /avatars/{userId}/{allPaths=**} {
      allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
      allow read: if true;
    }

    // 4. ART / UPLOADS (Portfolio)
    // User uploads, but anyone on the internet can see it (Public).
    match /art_uploads/{userId}/{allPaths=**} {
       allow write: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
       allow read: if true;
    }
  }
}

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.");
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- DRAG & DROP & UPLOAD HANDLERS ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.handleVideoSelect = (input) => {

        document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'block';

window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {

window.transmitData = () => {

<script>
// --- 5. DASHBOARD VIEW LOGIC ---

window.openDashboard = async (targetTab = 'purchases') => {
    const u = window.auth.currentUser;
    if(!u) return window.openModal('login');

    // Show loading state
    window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

    try {
        // FORCE SERVER FETCH (Bypasses cache to ensure status is real)
        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get({ source: 'server' });
        
        // Default data structure if missing
        window.currentUserDoc = doc.exists ? doc.data() : { 
            handle: "Guest", 
            role: "User", 
            verification_status: 'unverified', // unverified, pending, verified, rejected
            rejection_count: 0
        };
        
        // Render Header Badges
        let badgesHtml = "";
        const vStatus = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status;
        
        if(vStatus === 'verified') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED ID</span>`;
        else if(vStatus === 'pending') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified" style="color:#d4a017; border-color:#d4a017;">PENDING</span>`;
        else badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;

        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'subscribed') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-subscribed">ARTIST PASS</span>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'premium') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-premium">PREMIUM</span>`;

        document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `<h2>${window.currentUserDoc.handle}</h2><div style="margin-top:5px; color:#666; font-size:11px;">${window.currentUserDoc.role} // ${badgesHtml}</div>`;
        
        window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    } catch (e) { 
        console.error("Dashboard Error:", e);
        alert("Connection Error. Please refresh.");
    }
};

window.closeDashboard = () => window.closeAllModals();

window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
    const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');

    document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.dash-nav-btn[onclick*="'${tab}'"]`);
    if(activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');

    // TAB: PURCHASES
    if(tab === 'purchases') {
        let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items && window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.length > 0) {
            window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.forEach(i => {
                html += `<a href="${i.link}" target="_blank" style="display:block; padding:15px; background:#121212; border:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none;">DOWNLOAD: ${i.name}</a>`;
            });
        } else { html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found.</p>`; }
        view.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // TAB: ID VERIFICATION (THE FIX)
    if(tab === 'verify') {
        const status = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status || 'unverified';
        const appeals = window.currentUserDoc.rejection_count || 0;
        const appealsLeft = 5 - appeals;

        // 1. VERIFIED (PERPETUAL)
        if(status === 'verified') {
            view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ID VERIFICATION</h3>
                <div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #0f0; background: rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.05); text-align:center;">

                    <p style="color:#aaa;">Your identity has been confirmed.</p>
                </div>
                <p style="color:#666; margin-top:20px; text-align:center;">You may now access the Artist Studio.</p>
            `;
        } 
        // 2. PENDING (PERPETUAL WAIT SCREEN)
        else if(status === 'pending') {
            view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>VERIFICATION PENDING</h3>
                <div style="padding:40px; border:1px solid #d4a017; background: rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.1); text-align:center;">

            return;

        const artistStatus = window.currentUserDoc.artist_status || 'unverified';

        if(artistStatus === 'verified') {

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.");
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.handleVideoSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text-vid').innerText = "VIDEO STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid').style.borderColor = "#b28dff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'block';
    }
}

window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.startUpload(input.files[0], 'art_uploads');
    }
};

window.transmitData = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return alert("Select a file first.");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'verification');
};

window.transmitVideo = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return alert("Select a video first.");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'artist_proofs');
};

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${window.auth.currentUser.uid}/${file.name}`).put(file);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
    },
    () => {
        // Upload success, now update Database
        if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
        
        if(folderName === 'verification') {
             status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
             // Explicitly update Firestore to PENDING
             window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).update({ 
                 verification_status: 'pending' 
             }).then(() => {
                 // ONLY update UI if database save succeeded
                 window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                 setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
             }).catch(err => {
                 alert("DATABASE ERROR: " + err.message + "\nCheck Firestore Rules.");
             });
        }
        
        if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
             status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
             window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).update({ 
                 artist_status: 'pending' 
             }).then(() => {
                 window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                 setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
             });
        }
        
        if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
             window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.");
        }
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
    if(profileIcon) {
        const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);
        profileIcon.parentNode.replaceChild(newIcon, profileIcon);
        newIcon.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if(window.auth.currentUser) {
                const rect = newIcon.getBoundingClientRect();
                const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
                dd.style.left = (rect.right - 160) + 'px';
                dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 15) + 'px';
                dd.style.position = 'fixed';
                dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
                dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
            } else { window.openModal('login'); }
        });
    }
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none';
    });
});

when I try to upload the id in id verification I get a pop-up toaster thing saying "riajuu.dev says DATABASE ERROR: No document to update: projects/userportalv2/databases/(default)/documents/users/RnMXE8uhkQZH2qlMj0000iVrWlu2 Check firestore rules"

This error means your Auth Account exists (so you can log in), but your User Profile Document in the database is missing.

This usually happens if you registered but didn't complete the "Identity Setup" step (creating a handle/role), or if you are using an old test account from before we added the profile creation logic. The system is trying to "Update" a file that doesn't exist yet.

The fix is simple: We will tell the code to Create the document if it's missing, instead of just trying to update it.

Update Firebase Embed 4 (Actions & Uploads)

        if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
        
        // --- THE FIX IS HERE ---
        // We use .set(data, {merge: true}) instead of .update()
        // This creates the document if it doesn't exist.
        
        if(folderName === 'verification') {
             status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
             window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).set({ 
                 verification_status: 'pending' 
             }, { merge: true }) // <--- Forces creation if missing
             .then(() => {
                 window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                 setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
             }).catch(err => {
                 alert("DATABASE ERROR: " + err.message);
             });
        }
        
        if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
             status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
             window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).set({ 
                 artist_status: 'pending' 
             }, { merge: true }) // <--- Forces creation if missing
             .then(() => {
                 window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                 setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
             });
        }
        
        if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
             window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.");
        }
    });
};

    window.openDashboard('disconnect');

<script>
// --- GLOBAL VARIABLES ---
window.currentUserDoc = {};
window.stagedFile = null;
window.SUBSCRIPTION_URL = "https://buy.stripe.com/YOUR_LINK_HERE";

// --- 1. FIREBASE CONFIG ---
const firebaseConfig = {
    apiKey: "AIzaSyCqad15n5UeSl2AwnfzeIJuZLCNrVm0CrE",
    authDomain: "userportalv2.firebaseapp.com",
    projectId: "userportalv2",
    storageBucket: "userportalv2.firebasestorage.app",
    messagingSenderId: "420794125847",

// Initialize globally
window.app = firebase.initializeApp(firebaseConfig);
window.auth = firebase.auth();
window.db = firebase.firestore();
window.storage = firebase.storage();

// --- 2. HELPERS ---
window.sanitizeError = (message) => {
    if(message.includes('auth/email-already-in-use')) return "Identity already registered.";
    if(message.includes('auth/wrong-password')) return "Access Denied.";
    if(message.includes('auth/user-not-found')) return "Identity not found.";
    return "System Error: " + message;
};

// --- UPDATED TOAST FUNCTION ---
window.showToast = (msg, type = 'normal') => {
    const box = document.getElementById('cyber-toast-container');
    if(!box) return; // Should exist from Embed 1

    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'cyber-toast';
    
    // Add specific classes for color coding
    if(type === 'error') t.classList.add('error');
    if(type === 'success') t.classList.add('success');
    
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    
    // Remove after 3s
    setTimeout(()=>{ 
        t.style.opacity='0'; 
        t.style.transform='translateX(50px)';
        setTimeout(()=>t.remove(), 300); 
    }, 3000);
};

// --- 3. BASIC UI HANDLERS ---
window.openModal = (type) => {
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';
    document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    if(type === 'login') document.getElementById('firebase-login-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'register') document.getElementById('firebase-register-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'profile') document.getElementById('firebase-profile-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'reset') document.getElementById('firebase-reset-modal').style.display = 'block';
};

window.closeAllModals = () => {
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'none';
    document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

// --- 4. AUTH EVENT LISTENERS ---
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay');
    if(overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target.id === 'firebase-modal-overlay') window.closeAllModals();
    });
    
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-close').forEach(b => b.onclick = window.closeAllModals);

    const createBtn = document.getElementById('create-btn');
    if(createBtn) createBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('reg-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('reg-pass').value;
        window.auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(e, p)
            .then((cred) => window.checkProfile(cred.user))
            .catch(e => document.getElementById('reg-error').textContent = window.sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    const signinBtn = document.getElementById('signin-btn');
    if(signinBtn) signinBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('login-password').value;
        window.auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(e, p)
            .then((cred) => {
                window.closeAllModals();
                window.checkProfile(cred.user);
            })
            .catch(e => document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = window.sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    const saveProfileBtn = document.getElementById('save-profile-btn');
    if(saveProfileBtn) saveProfileBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const u = window.auth.currentUser;
        const h = document.getElementById('setup-handle').value;
        const r = document.getElementById('setup-role').value;
        if(u && h) {
            await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).set({
                handle: h, 
                role: r, 
                email: u.email, 
                verified: false,        
                verification_status: 'unverified',
                artist_status: 'unverified', 
                subscription: 'free',   
                created: new Date(),
                rejection_count: 0
            });
            window.closeAllModals();
            window.showToast("Identity Established. Welcome, " + h, "success");
        }
    });
});

window.checkProfile = async (user) => {
    const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
    if (!doc.exists) {
        window.closeAllModals();
        window.openModal('profile');
    }
};

window.resetPass = () => {
    const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
    if(!e) return window.showToast("Enter email address first.", "error");
    window.auth.sendPasswordResetEmail(e)
        .then(()=>window.showToast("Reset Link Sent.", "success"))
        .catch(e=>window.showToast(window.sanitizeError(e.message), "error"));
};
</script>

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.", "error"); // Red for disconnect
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.handleVideoSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text-vid').innerText = "VIDEO STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid').style.borderColor = "#b28dff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'block';
    }
}

window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.startUpload(input.files[0], 'art_uploads');
    }
};

window.transmitData = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return window.showToast("Select a file first.", "error");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'verification');
};

window.transmitVideo = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return window.showToast("Select a video first.", "error");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'artist_proofs');
};

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${window.auth.currentUser.uid}/${file.name}`).put(file);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
        
        if(folderName === 'verification') {
             status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
             window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).set({ 
                 verification_status: 'pending' 
             }, { merge: true }) 
             .then(() => {
                 window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                 setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
             }).catch(err => {
                 window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");
             });
        }
        
        if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
             status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
             window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).set({ 
                 artist_status: 'pending' 
             }, { merge: true }) 
             .then(() => {
                 window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                 setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
             });
        }
        
        if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
             window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
        }
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

                dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
                dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
            } else { window.openModal('login'); }
        });
    }
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none';
    });
});

ok that worked! but you seem to have removed the L-E-D bar that is supposed to be next to the disconnect button when it's in use.

You are absolutely right. The reason the LED bar "disappeared" is that the dashboard script identifies which button to highlight by looking for the tab name in the button's code.

Because the Disconnect button was running doLogout() instead of switchDashTab('disconnect'), the script didn't realize that was the active button, so it didn't apply the "Active" class (which triggers the LED bar).

I have fixed the HTML in Embed 1 to link them correctly.

ok so since it says my id is under review how do I (As the owner of the site) go about verifying them?

Right now, since we haven't built an Admin Panel (a "God Mode" dashboard), you have to act as the "Operator" inside the Firebase Console.

Here is the manual workflow to approve or reject your users:

Step 1: Look at the ID (The Evidence)
Go to your Firebase Console.

Click Storage (on the left sidebar).

Open the verification folder.

Open the folder named after the User's ID (it will be a long string of random characters).

Click on the image file inside to see it on the right side of the screen.

Judge it: Is it a real ID? Is it legible?

Step 2: Make the Decision (The Verdict)
Click Firestore Database (on the left sidebar).

Click the users collection.

Find that same User ID document.

Look for the field verification_status (it currently says "pending").

OPTION A: ACCEPT THEM (Green Pill)
Change verification_status to: verified (all lowercase).

Result: The next time they open their dashboard, they will see the Green "IDENTITY CONFIRMED" screen and the "Artist Studio" will unlock.

OPTION B: REJECT THEM (Red Pill)
Change verification_status to: rejected.

CRITICAL: You must also find the rejection_count field and increment it by 1. (e.g., change 0 to 1).

Result: They will see the Red "REJECTED" screen with the "Try Again" button (unless they hit 5 strikes).

Step 3: Artist Verification (The Video)
If they are applying for the Artist Studio, the process is the exact same, but the folders/fields are different:

View Video: Go to Storage -> artist_proofs -> [User ID].

Update DB: Go to Firestore -> [User ID].

Change Status: Update artist_status to verified or rejected.

Do you want to build an "Admin Terminal"?
Doing this manually in the Firebase Console is fine for now, but it's tedious.

If you want, I can write a "God Mode" Embed.

It would be a hidden dashboard only YOU can see.

It would list all "Pending" users.

It would show the image/video right there.

It would have big [APPROVE] and [REJECT] buttons that handle the database logic (and strike counting) automatically.

Would you like me to build that Admin Terminal code now?

ok so instead of doing that - howe do I do "since we haven't built an Admin Panel (a "God Mode" dashboard)"?

To build a "God Mode" Admin Panel, we need to do three things:

Promote You: We need to tell the database that YOU are the Admin (so random users can't open this panel).

The "Paper Trail" Fix: We need to slightly tweak the Upload Code (Embed 4) one last time. Why? Currently, we upload the file, but we don't save the link to that file in the database. The Admin Panel needs that link to show you the picture/video.

The Admin Panel Code: A new Embed that reads all pending applications and gives you Approve/Reject buttons.

Here is the step-by-step.

Step 1: Promote Yourself to "Admin"
You need to manually grant yourself the power once.

Go to Firebase Console -> Firestore Database.

Go to the users collection.

Find YOUR document (look for your email or handle).

Click Add field.

Field: isAdmin

Type: boolean

Value: true

Click Add.

Step 2: Update Embed 4 (To save the file links)
We are adding a few lines to the startUpload function so that when a user uploads a file, the Download URL is saved to their profile. This lets you click it in the Admin Panel.

Delete everything in Embed 4 and paste this Updated Version:

    window.renderVerifyUpload(document.getElementById('dash-main-view'));

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.", "error");
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {

        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${window.auth.currentUser.uid}/${file.name}`).put(file);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        // --- GET DOWNLOAD URL ---
        uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {
            if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
            if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
            
            // 1. ID VERIFICATION
            if(folderName === 'verification') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).set({ 
                     verification_status: 'pending',
                     id_proof_url: downloadURL  // <--- SAVING LINK FOR ADMIN
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            // 2. ARTIST PROOF
            if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).set({ 
                     artist_status: 'pending',
                     artist_proof_url: downloadURL // <--- SAVING LINK FOR ADMIN
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            // 3. ART UPLOAD (PORTFOLIO)
            if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
                 // Save to 'uploads' subcollection
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).collection('uploads').add({
                     url: downloadURL,
                     name: file.name,
                     uploadedAt: new Date()
                 });
                 window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
            }
        });
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

                dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';

        });
    }
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none';
    });

<script>
window.openAdminPanel = async () => {
    // Security Check: Client Side (Database rules also protect this)
    if(!window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) return window.showToast("ACCESS DENIED", "error");

    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display = 'none'; // Hide dropdown
    await loadPendingRequests();
};

window.closeAdminPanel = () => {
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

window.loadPendingRequests = async () => {
    const list = document.getElementById('admin-list');
    list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#666;">Scanning database...</p>';

    try {
        // 1. Get Pending IDs
        const idSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('verification_status', '==', 'pending').get();
        // 2. Get Pending Artists
        const artistSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('artist_status', '==', 'pending').get();

        list.innerHTML = '';
        let count = 0;

        // RENDER ID REQUESTS
        idSnaps.forEach(doc => {
            const d = doc.data();
            renderCard(list, doc.id, d, 'ID');
            count++;
        });

        // RENDER ARTIST REQUESTS
        artistSnaps.forEach(doc => {
            const d = doc.data();
            renderCard(list, doc.id, d, 'ARTIST');
            count++;
        });

        if(count === 0) list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; width:100%; color:#444;"><h2>ALL CLEAR</h2><p>No pending verification requests.</p></div>';

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        list.innerHTML = `<p style="color:red;">Error loading data: ${e.message}</p>`;
    }
};

function renderCard(container, uid, data, type) {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'admin-card';
    
    // Determine Proof URL and Media Type
    let proofUrl = (type === 'ID') ? data.id_proof_url : data.artist_proof_url;
    let mediaHtml = '';
    
    if(proofUrl) {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            mediaHtml = `<a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank"><img src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media"></a>`;
        } else {
            mediaHtml = `<video src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media" controls></video>`;
        }
    } else {
        mediaHtml = `<div class="proof-media" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#666;">NO FILE LINKED</div>`;
    }

    card.innerHTML = `
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between;">
            <span style="color:${type==='ID'?'#40c4ff':'#b28dff'}; font-weight:bold;">${type} VERIFICATION</span>
            <small>Appeals Used: ${data.rejection_count || 0}</small>
        </div>
        <strong>${data.handle || "Unknown User"}</strong>
        <small>${data.email}</small>
        ${mediaHtml}
        <div class="admin-actions">
            <button class="btn-reject" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'reject')">REJECT</button>
            <button class="btn-approve" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'approve')">APPROVE</button>
        </div>
    `;
    container.appendChild(card);
}

window.judgeUser = async (uid, type, verdict) => {
    const confirmMsg = verdict === 'approve' ? `Approve ${type}?` : `Reject ${type}? (This adds a strike)`;
    if(!confirm(confirmMsg)) return;

    try {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ verification_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("User ID Verified.", "success");
            } else {
                // Reject logic: Increment rejection count
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected',
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast("User ID Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        else if(type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        
        // Refresh list
        await loadPendingRequests();

    } catch (e) {
        alert("Error: " + e.message);
    }
};
</script>
How to access God Mode:

Since you added isAdmin: true to your profile in Step 1...

Refresh your site.

Click your Profile Icon.

You will now see a red "ADMIN TERMINAL" button at the top of the dropdown menu. Click it to begin judging.

if I delete collection will the login still work and I can attempt to reapply with an id?

Yes.

Here is exactly what will happen if you delete your User Document (or the whole collection) in Firestore:

Login Still Works: Your Email and Password live in Firebase Authentication, not the Database. So you can still sign in.

Profile Reset: When you sign in, the code (checkProfile) will look for your document in the database. Since you deleted it, it won't find one.

Identity Setup: The site will think you are a brand new user. It will pop up the "Identity Setup" modal asking for a Handle and Role.

Fresh Start: Once you save that new handle, it creates a brand new database entry for you with verification_status: 'unverified' and rejection_count: 0.

You can then go to the "ID Verification" tab and upload your ID again to test the flow.

⚠ IMPORTANT WARNING: You will lose Admin Status
If you delete your document to reset your ID test, you delete the isAdmin: true flag you added earlier.

When you recreate your profile:

Go back to Firebase Console -> Firestore.

Find your NEW document.

Add isAdmin (boolean) -> true again.

Then you can test the Admin Terminal on your own new application.

A Faster Way to Test (Without Deleting)
Instead of deleting the whole document and re-creating your handle, you can just edit the fields in Firebase to "reset" yourself:

Go to Firestore -> users -> Your Document.

Change verification_status to unverified.

Change rejection_count to 0.

Refresh your site.

Now you are back to square one and can upload the ID again immediately!

Got it. If you are just looking at the Firebase Console > Storage tab, you are seeing a list of folders named with long, random strings (like RnMXE8uhkQZH...).

That random string is the User ID (UID).

Here is how you find out "Who is Who" manually right now, without the Admin Panel:

The Manual "Trace" Method
You have to work backwards from the Database to the Storage.

Go to "Firestore Database" (Left Sidebar).

Click the users collection.

Look at the columns.

Column 2 lists the UIDs (the random strings).

Column 3 shows the data (where you can see the handle / Username).

Find the User/Handle you are looking for in Column 3.

Look to the left in Column 2 to see their UID.

Example: You see "Riajuu" in the data. The ID to the left is AbC123xyz...

Copy that ID.

Go to "Storage" (Left Sidebar).

Open the verification folder.

Find the folder that matches that ID (AbC123xyz...).

That folder contains that specific user's images.

Why don't we just name the folders by Username?
Technical reason: Usernames can change. UIDs never change. If a user changes their handle from "CoolGuy" to "ArtistPro", but their folder was named "CoolGuy", the database link breaks and you lose their files. Using the UID ensures the link is permanent.

Summary
Database tells you: Username = UID

Storage tells you: UID = Image

The Admin Panel code (Embed 6) I gave you earlier automates this lookup so you don't have to switch tabs back and forth. When you are ready to use it, just add isAdmin: true to your profile in the database, and you'll see the Username and Image side-by-side.

<script>
// --- 6. FEATURE LOGIC & HELPERS ---

window.renderVerifyUpload = (view) => {
    view.innerHTML = `
        <h3>ID VERIFICATION REQUIRED</h3>
        <p style="font-size:13px; color:#888;">Upload government ID to unlock features.</p>
        <label for="id-file" class="drop-zone" id="drag-zone">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19.35 10.04C18.67 6.59 15.64 4 12 4 9.11 4 6.6 5.64 5.35 8.04 2.34 8.36 0 10.91 0 14c0 3.31 2.69 6 6 6h13c2.76 0 5-2.24 5-5 0-2.64-2.05-4.78-4.65-4.96zM14 13v4h-4v-4H7l5-5 5 5h-3z"></path></svg>
            <div class="drop-text-main" id="drop-text">SCAN CREDENTIALS</div>
        </label>
        <input type="file" id="id-file" onchange="handleManualSelect(this)">
        <button id="transmit-btn" onclick="transmitData()" class="cyber-btn" style="display:none;">TRANSMIT DATA</button>
        <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-verify"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-verify"></div></div>
        <p id="upload-status-verify" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
    `;
    setTimeout(window.setupDragDrop, 100);
}

window.retryVerify = () => {
    window.renderVerifyUpload(document.getElementById('dash-main-view'));
}

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.", "error");
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.handleVideoSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text-vid').innerText = "VIDEO STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid').style.borderColor = "#b28dff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'block';
    }
}

window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.startUpload(input.files[0], 'art_uploads');
    }
};

window.transmitData = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return window.showToast("Select a file first.", "error");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'verification');
};

window.transmitVideo = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return window.showToast("Select a video first.", "error");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'artist_proofs');
};

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    // --- THE FIX: RENAME FILE TO INCLUDE USERNAME ---
    const uid = window.auth.currentUser.uid;
    const handle = window.currentUserDoc.handle || "UnknownUser";
    
    // Clean handle to remove spaces or weird characters that break URLs
    const safeHandle = handle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");
    
    // New Filename: "Riajuu_UID123_originalName.jpg"
    const newFileName = `${safeHandle}_${uid}_${file.name}`;

    // Also add Metadata so you see it in the sidebar details
    const metadata = {
        customMetadata: {
            'username': handle,
            'uid': uid,
            'original_name': file.name
        }
    };

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${uid}/${newFileName}`).put(file, metadata);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {
            if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
            if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
            
            if(folderName === 'verification') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     verification_status: 'pending',
                     id_proof_url: downloadURL 
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
                 }).catch(err => {
                     window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     artist_status: 'pending',
                     artist_proof_url: downloadURL
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('uploads').add({
                     url: downloadURL,
                     name: newFileName,
                     uploadedAt: new Date()
                 });
                 window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
            }
        });
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

// --- ICON HANDLER ---
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
    if(profileIcon) {
        const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);
        profileIcon.parentNode.replaceChild(newIcon, profileIcon);
        newIcon.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if(window.auth.currentUser) {
                const rect = newIcon.getBoundingClientRect();
                const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
                
                // ADMIN CHECK
                if(window.currentUserDoc && window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) {
                    if(!document.getElementById('admin-btn')) {
                         const adminLink = document.createElement('a');
                         adminLink.id = 'admin-btn';
                         adminLink.innerText = "ADMIN TERMINAL";
                         adminLink.style.color = "#ff4444";
                         adminLink.onclick = window.openAdminPanel;
                         dd.insertBefore(adminLink, dd.firstChild);
                    }
                }

                dd.style.left = (rect.right - 160) + 'px';
                dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 15) + 'px';
                dd.style.position = 'fixed';
                dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
                dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
            } else { window.openModal('login'); }
        });
    }
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none';
    });
});

Based on the screenshot you provided, I can see exactly what happened.

You are looking at the Database (Firestore), and two things are happening here:

The "Messy" URL is Normal: That long text starting with https://firebasestorage... is just the download link. It has to be that long to work on the internet.

The System Forgot Your Name: Look closely at that long URL in your screenshot. Inside the mess, the filename is listed as: Guest_RnMX...

It says "Guest" because you deleted your database document earlier. When you did that, you deleted your Username (Handle). The code couldn't find your name, so it panicked and defaulted to "Guest" to prevent a crash.

How to Fix This (Right Now, in that Screen)
You are already in the right place (Firestore Database). You just need to manually give yourself a name again.

In that document shown in your screenshot (RnMXE...), click + Add field.

Field: handle

Value: Riajuu (or whatever username you want).

Click Add.

(While you are there, let's enable the Admin Panel too so you don't have to come back) 5. Click + Add field again. 6. Field: isAdmin 7. Type: Select Boolean (toggle the switch). 8. Value: true 9. Click Add.
