window.sanitizeError = (message) => {
    if(message.includes('auth/email-already-in-use')) return "Identity already registered.";
    if(message.includes('auth/wrong-password')) return "Access Denied.";
    if(message.includes('auth/user-not-found')) return "Identity not found.";
    return "System Error: " + message;
};

// --- CYBER TOAST ---
window.showToast = (msg, type = 'normal') => {
    const box = document.getElementById('cyber-toast-container');
    if(!box) return;

    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'cyber-toast';
    if(type === 'error') t.classList.add('error');
    if(type === 'success') t.classList.add('success');
    
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; t.style.transform='translateX(50px)'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(), 300); }, 3000);
};

// --- 3. BASIC UI HANDLERS ---
window.openModal = (type) => {
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';
    document.querySelectorAll('.firebase-modal').forEach(m => m.style.display = 'none');
    if(type === 'login') document.getElementById('firebase-login-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'register') document.getElementById('firebase-register-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'profile') document.getElementById('firebase-profile-modal').style.display = 'block';
    if(type === 'reset') document.getElementById('firebase-reset-modal').style.display = 'block';
};

window.closeAllModals = () => {

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const overlay = document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay');
    if(overlay) overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target.id === 'firebase-modal-overlay') window.closeAllModals();
    });
    
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-close').forEach(b => b.onclick = window.closeAllModals);

    const createBtn = document.getElementById('create-btn');
    if(createBtn) createBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('reg-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('reg-pass').value;
        window.auth.createUserWithEmailAndPassword(e, p)
            .then((cred) => window.checkProfile(cred.user))
            .catch(e => document.getElementById('reg-error').textContent = window.sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    const signinBtn = document.getElementById('signin-btn');
    if(signinBtn) signinBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
        const p = document.getElementById('login-password').value;
        window.auth.signInWithEmailAndPassword(e, p)
            .then((cred) => {
                window.closeAllModals();
                window.checkProfile(cred.user);
            })
            .catch(e => document.getElementById('login-error').textContent = window.sanitizeError(e.message));
    });

    // --- SAVE IDENTITY (Updated for 18+) ---
    const saveProfileBtn = document.getElementById('save-profile-btn');
    if(saveProfileBtn) saveProfileBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
        const u = window.auth.currentUser;
        const h = document.getElementById('setup-handle').value;
        const r = document.getElementById('setup-role').value;
        const nsfw = document.getElementById('setup-nsfw').checked; // Capture Toggle

        if(u && h) {
            await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).set({
                handle: h, 
                role: r, 
                nsfw_enabled: nsfw, // Saves true/false
                email: u.email, 
                verified: false,        
                verification_status: 'unverified',
                artist_status: 'unverified', 
                subscription: 'free',   
                created: new Date(),
                rejection_count: 0
            });
            window.closeAllModals();
            window.showToast("Identity Established. Welcome, " + h, "success");
        }
    });
});

window.checkProfile = async (user) => {
    const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(user.uid).get();
    if (!doc.exists) {
        window.closeAllModals();
        window.openModal('profile');
    }
};

window.resetPass = () => {
    const e = document.getElementById('login-email').value;
    if(!e) return window.showToast("Enter email address first.", "error");
    window.auth.sendPasswordResetEmail(e)
        .then(()=>window.showToast("Reset Link Sent.", "success"))
        .catch(e=>window.showToast(window.sanitizeError(e.message), "error"));
};

window.renderVerifyUpload = (view) => {

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.", "error");
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

        document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid').style.borderColor = "#b28dff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'block';
    }
}

        window.startUpload(input.files[0], 'art_uploads');
    }
};

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    // RENAME FILE
    const uid = window.auth.currentUser.uid;
    const handle = window.currentUserDoc.handle || "UnknownUser";
    const safeHandle = handle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");
    const newFileName = `${safeHandle}_${uid}_${file.name}`;

    const metadata = { customMetadata: { 'username': handle, 'uid': uid, 'original_name': file.name } };

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${uid}/${newFileName}`).put(file, metadata);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {
            if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
            if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
            
            if(folderName === 'verification') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     verification_status: 'pending',
                     id_proof_url: downloadURL 
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
                 }).catch(err => {
                     window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     artist_status: 'pending',
                     artist_proof_url: downloadURL
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('uploads').add({
                     url: downloadURL,
                     name: newFileName,
                     uploadedAt: new Date()
                 });
                 window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
            }
        });
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

// --- UPDATED ICON HANDLER (The Fix) ---
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
    if(profileIcon) {
        const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);
        profileIcon.parentNode.replaceChild(newIcon, profileIcon);
        
        // Make this Async to allow data fetching
        newIcon.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            if(window.auth.currentUser) {
                
                // 1. Force Fetch User Data if missing
                if(!window.currentUserDoc || !window.currentUserDoc.role) {
                    try {
                        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).get();
                        if(doc.exists) window.currentUserDoc = doc.data();
                    } catch(e) { console.error("Profile Fetch Error", e); }
                }

                const rect = newIcon.getBoundingClientRect();
                const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
                
                // 2. CHECK ADMIN NOW (Data is guaranteed loaded)
                if(window.currentUserDoc && window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) {
                    if(!document.getElementById('admin-btn')) {
                         const adminLink = document.createElement('a');
                         adminLink.id = 'admin-btn';
                         adminLink.innerText = "ADMIN TERMINAL";
                         adminLink.style.color = "#ff4444";
                         adminLink.style.borderBottom = "1px solid #333";
                         adminLink.onclick = window.openAdminPanel;
                         dd.insertBefore(adminLink, dd.firstChild);
                    }
                }

                dd.style.left = (rect.right - 160) + 'px';
                dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 15) + 'px';
                dd.style.position = 'fixed';
                dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
                dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
            } else { window.openModal('login'); }
        });
    }
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon')) document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display='none';
    });
});

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';

        document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid').style.borderColor = "#b28dff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'block';

window.transmitVideo = () => {

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uid = window.auth.currentUser.uid;
    const handle = window.currentUserDoc.handle || "UnknownUser";
    const safeHandle = handle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");
    const newFileName = `${safeHandle}_${uid}_${file.name}`;

    const metadata = { customMetadata: { 'username': handle, 'uid': uid, 'original_name': file.name } };

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${uid}/${newFileName}`).put(file, metadata);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {
            if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
            if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
            
            if(folderName === 'verification') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     verification_status: 'pending',
                     id_proof_url: downloadURL 
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
                 }).catch(err => {
                     window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     artist_status: 'pending',
                     artist_proof_url: downloadURL
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('uploads').add({
                     url: downloadURL,
                     name: newFileName,
                     uploadedAt: new Date()
                 });
                 window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
            }
        });
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

// --- ICON HANDLER (FIXED CLOSING LOGIC) ---
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
    if(profileIcon) {
        const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);
        profileIcon.parentNode.replaceChild(newIcon, profileIcon);
        
        newIcon.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            if(window.auth.currentUser) {
                if(!window.currentUserDoc || !window.currentUserDoc.role) {
                    try {
                        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).get();
                        if(doc.exists) window.currentUserDoc = doc.data();
                    } catch(e) { console.error("Profile Fetch Error", e); }
                }

                const rect = newIcon.getBoundingClientRect();
                const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
                
                // ADMIN CHECK
                if(window.currentUserDoc && window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) {
                    if(!document.getElementById('admin-btn')) {
                         const adminLink = document.createElement('a');
                         adminLink.id = 'admin-btn';
                         adminLink.innerText = "ADMIN TERMINAL";
                         adminLink.style.color = "#ff4444";
                         adminLink.style.borderBottom = "1px solid #333";
                         adminLink.onclick = window.openAdminPanel; // <--- Calls code in Embed 5
                         dd.insertBefore(adminLink, dd.firstChild);
                    }
                }

                dd.style.left = (rect.right - 160) + 'px';
                dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 15) + 'px';
                dd.style.position = 'fixed';
                dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
                dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
            } else { window.openModal('login'); }
        });
    }
    
    // --- THE FIX: Don't close if clicking inside the dropdown ---
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon') && !e.target.closest('#user-dropdown')) {
            const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
            if(dd) dd.style.display='none';
        }
    });
});

<script>
window.openAdminPanel = async () => {
    if(!window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) return window.showToast("ACCESS DENIED", "error");

    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display = 'none'; 
    await loadPendingRequests();
};

window.closeAdminPanel = () => {
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

window.loadPendingRequests = async () => {
    const list = document.getElementById('admin-list');
    list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#666; padding:20px;">Scanning database...</p>';

    try {
        const idSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('verification_status', '==', 'pending').get();
        const artistSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('artist_status', '==', 'pending').get();

        list.innerHTML = '';
        let count = 0;

        idSnaps.forEach(doc => { renderCard(list, doc.id, doc.data(), 'ID'); count++; });
        artistSnaps.forEach(doc => { renderCard(list, doc.id, doc.data(), 'ARTIST'); count++; });

        if(count === 0) list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; width:100%; color:#444; padding:40px;"><h2>ALL CLEAR</h2><p>No pending verification requests.</p></div>';

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        list.innerHTML = `<p style="color:red; padding:20px;">Error loading data: ${e.message}</p>`;
    }
};

function renderCard(container, uid, data, type) {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'admin-card';
    
    // Determine Color Theme based on type
    const themeColor = type === 'ID' ? '#40c4ff' : '#b28dff';
    card.style.borderTopColor = themeColor;
    
    let proofUrl = (type === 'ID') ? data.id_proof_url : data.artist_proof_url;
    let mediaHtml = '';
    
    if(proofUrl) {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            // Click to open full size
            mediaHtml = `<a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank"><img src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media"></a>`;
        } else {
            mediaHtml = `<video src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media" controls></video>`;
        }
    } else {
        mediaHtml = `<div class="proof-media" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#666;">NO FILE LINKED</div>`;
    }

    // Convert Firestore Timestamp to readable date
    let joinDate = "Unknown";
    if(data.created && data.created.toDate) {
        joinDate = data.created.toDate().toLocaleDateString();
    }

    card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="dossier-header">
            <h3 style="color:${themeColor}">${data.handle || "NO_HANDLE"}</h3>
            <span>UID: ${uid}</span>
        </div>
        
        <div class="dossier-body">
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Request Type:</span> <span class="data-val" style="color:${themeColor}">${type} VERIFICATION</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Email:</span> <span class="data-val">${data.email}</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Joined:</span> <span class="data-val">${joinDate}</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Appeals Used:</span> <span class="data-val">${data.rejection_count || 0} / 5</span></div>
            
            <div style="margin-top:15px; margin-bottom:5px; color:#666; font-size:0.8rem;">SUBMITTED EVIDENCE:</div>
            ${mediaHtml}
        </div>

        <div class="admin-actions">
            <button class="btn-reject" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'reject')">REJECT</button>
            <button class="btn-approve" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'approve')">APPROVE</button>
        </div>
    `;
    container.appendChild(card);
}

window.judgeUser = async (uid, type, verdict) => {
    const confirmMsg = verdict === 'approve' ? `Approve ${type}?` : `Reject ${type}? (Adds a strike)`;
    if(!confirm(confirmMsg)) return;

    try {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ verification_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("User ID Verified.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected',
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast("User ID Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        else if(type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        
        await loadPendingRequests();

    } catch (e) {
        alert("Error: " + e.message);
    }
};

window.openAdminPanel = async () => {

window.loadPendingRequests = async () => {
    const list = document.getElementById('admin-list');
    list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#666; padding:20px;">Scanning database...</p>';

    try {
        const idSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('verification_status', '==', 'pending').get();
        const artistSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('artist_status', '==', 'pending').get();

        list.innerHTML = '';
        let count = 0;

        idSnaps.forEach(doc => { renderCard(list, doc.id, doc.data(), 'ID'); count++; });
        artistSnaps.forEach(doc => { renderCard(list, doc.id, doc.data(), 'ARTIST'); count++; });

        if(count === 0) list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; width:100%; color:#444; padding:40px;"><h2>ALL CLEAR</h2><p>No pending verification requests.</p></div>';

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        list.innerHTML = `<p style="color:red; padding:20px;">Error loading data: ${e.message}</p>`;
    }
};

function renderCard(container, uid, data, type) {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'admin-card';
    
    // Determine Color Theme based on type
    const themeColor = type === 'ID' ? '#40c4ff' : '#b28dff';
    card.style.borderTopColor = themeColor;
    
    let proofUrl = (type === 'ID') ? data.id_proof_url : data.artist_proof_url;
    let mediaHtml = '';
    
    if(proofUrl) {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            // Click to open full size
            mediaHtml = `<a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank"><img src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media"></a>`;
        } else {
            mediaHtml = `<video src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media" controls></video>`;
        }
    } else {
        mediaHtml = `<div class="proof-media" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#666;">NO FILE LINKED</div>`;
    }

    // Convert Firestore Timestamp to readable date
    let joinDate = "Unknown";
    if(data.created && data.created.toDate) {
        joinDate = data.created.toDate().toLocaleDateString();
    }

    card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="dossier-header">
            <h3 style="color:${themeColor}">${data.handle || "NO_HANDLE"}</h3>
            <span>UID: ${uid}</span>
        </div>
        
        <div class="dossier-body">
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Request Type:</span> <span class="data-val" style="color:${themeColor}">${type} VERIFICATION</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Email:</span> <span class="data-val">${data.email}</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Joined:</span> <span class="data-val">${joinDate}</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Appeals Used:</span> <span class="data-val">${data.rejection_count || 0} / 5</span></div>
            
            <div style="margin-top:15px; margin-bottom:5px; color:#666; font-size:0.8rem;">SUBMITTED EVIDENCE:</div>
            ${mediaHtml}
        </div>

        <div class="admin-actions">
            <button class="btn-reject" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'reject')">REJECT</button>
            <button class="btn-approve" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'approve')">APPROVE</button>
        </div>
    `;
    container.appendChild(card);
}

window.judgeUser = async (uid, type, verdict) => {
    const confirmMsg = verdict === 'approve' ? `Approve ${type}?` : `Reject ${type}? (Adds a strike)`;
    if(!confirm(confirmMsg)) return;

    try {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ verification_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("User ID Verified.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected',
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast("User ID Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        else if(type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        
        await loadPendingRequests();

    } catch (e) {
        alert("Error: " + e.message);
    }
};

window.processLogout = () => {

document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';

document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';

const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');

let width = 0;

const interval = setInterval(() => {

if(width >= 100) {

clearInterval(interval);

window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.", "error");

setTimeout(() => {

window.auth.signOut();

window.closeAllModals();

location.reload();

}, 800);

} else {

width += 5;

bar.style.width = width + '%';

}

}, 50);

};



// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS ---

window.setupDragDrop = () => {

const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');

if(!dz) return;

['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {

dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);

});

dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');

dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');

dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {

dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';

if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {

document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;

document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";

window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');

}

});

};



window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {

if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {

window.stagedFile = input.files[0];

document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;

document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";

document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';

}

};



window.handleVideoSelect = (input) => {

document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid').style.borderColor = "#b28dff";

document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'block';

}

}



window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---

window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {

let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';

let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';

let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';



if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }

if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }



const status = document.getElementById(statusId);

const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);

const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);



if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';

if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';



if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";

if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }

if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";



// RENAME FILE

const uid = window.auth.currentUser.uid;

const handle = window.currentUserDoc.handle || "UnknownUser";

const safeHandle = handle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");

const newFileName = `${safeHandle}_${uid}_${file.name}`;



const metadata = { customMetadata: { 'username': handle, 'uid': uid, 'original_name': file.name } };



const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${uid}/${newFileName}`).put(file, metadata);



uploadTask.on('state_changed',

(snapshot) => {

const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;

if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';

if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";

},

(error) => {

if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);

if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";

window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");

},

() => {

uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {

if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";

if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";



if(folderName === 'verification') {

status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";

window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({

verification_status: 'pending',

id_proof_url: downloadURL

}, { merge: true })

.then(() => {

window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';

setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);

}).catch(err => {

window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");

});

}



if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {

status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";

window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({

artist_status: 'pending',

artist_proof_url: downloadURL

}, { merge: true })

.then(() => {

window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';

setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);

});

}



if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {

window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('uploads').add({

url: downloadURL,

name: newFileName,

uploadedAt: new Date()

});

window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");

}

});

});

};



window.doLogout = () => {

window.openDashboard('disconnect');

};

newIcon.addEventListener('click', async () => {

if(window.auth.currentUser) {



// 1. Force Fetch User Data if missing

window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    // RENAME FILE
    const uid = window.auth.currentUser.uid;
    const handle = window.currentUserDoc.handle || "UnknownUser";
    const safeHandle = handle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");
    const newFileName = `${safeHandle}_${uid}_${file.name}`;

    const metadata = { customMetadata: { 'username': handle, 'uid': uid, 'original_name': file.name } };

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${uid}/${newFileName}`).put(file, metadata);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {
            if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
            if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
            
            if(folderName === 'verification') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     verification_status: 'pending',
                     id_proof_url: downloadURL 
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
                 }).catch(err => {
                     window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     artist_status: 'pending',
                     artist_proof_url: downloadURL
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('uploads').add({
                     url: downloadURL,
                     name: newFileName,
                     uploadedAt: new Date()
                 });
                 window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
            }
        });
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

<script>
window.openAdminPanel = async () => {
    if(!window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) return window.showToast("ACCESS DENIED", "error");

    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display = 'none'; 
    await loadPendingRequests();
};

window.closeAdminPanel = () => {
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

window.loadPendingRequests = async () => {
    const list = document.getElementById('admin-list');
    list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#666; padding:20px;">Scanning database...</p>';

    try {
        const idSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('verification_status', '==', 'pending').get();
        const artistSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('artist_status', '==', 'pending').get();

        list.innerHTML = '';
        let count = 0;

        idSnaps.forEach(doc => { renderCard(list, doc.id, doc.data(), 'ID'); count++; });
        artistSnaps.forEach(doc => { renderCard(list, doc.id, doc.data(), 'ARTIST'); count++; });

        if(count === 0) list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; width:100%; color:#444; padding:40px;"><h2>ALL CLEAR</h2><p>No pending verification requests.</p></div>';

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        list.innerHTML = `<p style="color:red; padding:20px;">Error loading data: ${e.message}</p>`;
    }
};

function renderCard(container, uid, data, type) {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'admin-card';
    
    // Determine Color Theme based on type
    const themeColor = type === 'ID' ? '#40c4ff' : '#b28dff';
    card.style.borderTopColor = themeColor;
    
    let proofUrl = (type === 'ID') ? data.id_proof_url : data.artist_proof_url;
    let mediaHtml = '';
    
    if(proofUrl) {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            // Click to open full size
            mediaHtml = `<a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank"><img src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media"></a>`;
        } else {
            mediaHtml = `<video src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media" controls></video>`;
        }
    } else {
        mediaHtml = `<div class="proof-media" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#666;">NO FILE LINKED</div>`;
    }

    // Convert Firestore Timestamp to readable date
    let joinDate = "Unknown";
    if(data.created && data.created.toDate) {
        joinDate = data.created.toDate().toLocaleDateString();
    }

    card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="dossier-header">
            <h3 style="color:${themeColor}">${data.handle || "NO_HANDLE"}</h3>
            <span>UID: ${uid}</span>
        </div>
        
        <div class="dossier-body">
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Request Type:</span> <span class="data-val" style="color:${themeColor}">${type} VERIFICATION</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Email:</span> <span class="data-val">${data.email}</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Joined:</span> <span class="data-val">${joinDate}</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Appeals Used:</span> <span class="data-val">${data.rejection_count || 0} / 5</span></div>
            
            <div style="margin-top:15px; margin-bottom:5px; color:#666; font-size:0.8rem;">SUBMITTED EVIDENCE:</div>
            ${mediaHtml}
        </div>

        <div class="admin-actions">
            <button class="btn-reject" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'reject')">REJECT</button>
            <button class="btn-approve" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'approve')">APPROVE</button>
        </div>
    `;
    container.appendChild(card);
}

window.judgeUser = async (uid, type, verdict) => {
    const confirmMsg = verdict === 'approve' ? `Approve ${type}?` : `Reject ${type}? (Adds a strike)`;
    if(!confirm(confirmMsg)) return;

    try {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ verification_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("User ID Verified.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected',
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast("User ID Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        else if(type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        
        await loadPendingRequests();

    } catch (e) {
        alert("Error: " + e.message);
    }
};

    if(message.includes('auth/user-not-found')) return "Identity not found.";

window.showToast = (msg, type = 'normal') => {
    const box = document.getElementById('cyber-toast-container');
    if(!box) return;
    const t = document.createElement('div');
    t.className = 'cyber-toast';
    if(type === 'error') t.classList.add('error');
    if(type === 'success') t.classList.add('success');
    t.innerHTML = msg;
    box.appendChild(t);
    setTimeout(()=>{ t.style.opacity='0'; t.style.transform='translateX(50px)'; setTimeout(()=>t.remove(), 300); }, 3000);

        const u = window.auth.currentUser;
        const h = document.getElementById('setup-handle').value.trim();

        // 1. CHECK FOR DUPLICATES

            return window.showToast("Username Taken. Choose another.", "error");

        if(u) {

                role: r, 
                nsfw_enabled: nsfw,
                email: u.email,

                artist_status: 'unverified',

                name_changes: 0 // New field for tracking

        }
    });
});

We add the attemptNameChange logic here. It checks if the new name is taken, checks if you have free changes left, and updates the database.

HTML
<script>
// --- 6. FEATURE LOGIC & HELPERS ---

// --- NEW NAME CHANGE LOGIC ---
window.attemptNameChange = async () => {
    const newHandle = document.getElementById('new-handle-input').value.trim();
    if(newHandle === window.currentUserDoc.handle) return window.showToast("No change detected.", "error");
    if(!newHandle) return window.showToast("Username cannot be empty.", "error");

    const changes = window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0;
    
    // Check if free change is available
    if(changes >= 1) {
        return alert("You have used your free name change. Please pay $5 to continue (Payment Link Placeholder).");
        // Future: window.open(STRIPE_LINK);
    }

    if(!confirm(`Change username to "${newHandle}"? This is your ONE free change.`)) return;

    try {
        // 1. Check Duplicates
        const snap = await window.db.collection('users').where('handle', '==', newHandle).get();
        if(!snap.empty) return window.showToast("Username taken.", "error");

        // 2. Update
        await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).update({
            handle: newHandle,
            name_changes: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
        });

        // 3. Refresh UI
        window.showToast("Username Updated!", "success");
        // Update local doc immediately
        window.currentUserDoc.handle = newHandle;
        window.currentUserDoc.name_changes = (window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0) + 1;
        
        // Refresh dashboard header
        document.querySelector('#dash-header-info h2').innerText = newHandle;
        // Refresh settings tab
        window.switchDashTab('settings');

    } catch(e) {
        window.showToast("Error: " + e.message, "error");
    }
};

window.renderVerifyUpload = (view) => {
    view.innerHTML = `
        <h3>ID VERIFICATION REQUIRED</h3>
        <p style="font-size:13px; color:#888;">Upload government ID to unlock features.</p>
        <label for="id-file" class="drop-zone" id="drag-zone">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19.35 10.04C18.67 6.59 15.64 4 12 4 9.11 4 6.6 5.64 5.35 8.04 2.34 8.36 0 10.91 0 14c0 3.31 2.69 6 6 6h13c2.76 0 5-2.24 5-5 0-2.64-2.05-4.78-4.65-4.96zM14 13v4h-4v-4H7l5-5 5 5h-3z"></path></svg>
            <div class="drop-text-main" id="drop-text">SCAN CREDENTIALS</div>
        </label>
        <input type="file" id="id-file" onchange="handleManualSelect(this)">
        <button id="transmit-btn" onclick="transmitData()" class="cyber-btn" style="display:none;">TRANSMIT DATA</button>
        <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-verify"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-verify"></div></div>
        <p id="upload-status-verify" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
    `;
    setTimeout(window.setupDragDrop, 100);
}

window.retryVerify = () => {
    window.renderVerifyUpload(document.getElementById('dash-main-view'));
}

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.", "error");
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.handleVideoSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text-vid').innerText = "VIDEO STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid').style.borderColor = "#b28dff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'block';
    }
}

window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.startUpload(input.files[0], 'art_uploads');
    }
};

window.transmitData = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return window.showToast("Select a file first.", "error");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'verification');
};

window.transmitVideo = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return window.showToast("Select a video first.", "error");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'artist_proofs');
};

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uid = window.auth.currentUser.uid;
    const handle = window.currentUserDoc.handle || "UnknownUser";
    const safeHandle = handle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");
    const newFileName = `${safeHandle}_${uid}_${file.name}`;

    const metadata = { customMetadata: { 'username': handle, 'uid': uid, 'original_name': file.name } };

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${uid}/${newFileName}`).put(file, metadata);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {
            if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
            if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
            
            if(folderName === 'verification') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     verification_status: 'pending',
                     id_proof_url: downloadURL 
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
                 }).catch(err => {
                     window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     artist_status: 'pending',
                     artist_proof_url: downloadURL
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('uploads').add({
                     url: downloadURL,
                     name: newFileName,
                     uploadedAt: new Date()
                 });
                 window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
            }
        });
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

// --- ICON HANDLER ---

    });

You are absolutely right. Using the browser's default confirm() alert is lazy and breaks the immersion. It looks like a Windows 95 pop-up on a Cyberpunk website.

We need to replace that native browser alert with a Custom Promise-Based Modal. This will pause the code (just like the old alert) but look exactly like your UI (Dark, Neon, Centered).

<script>
// --- ADMIN LOGIC ---

window.openAdminPanel = async () => {
    if(!window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) return window.showToast("ACCESS DENIED", "error");
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display = 'none'; 
    await loadPendingRequests();
};

window.closeAdminPanel = () => {
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

window.loadPendingRequests = async () => {
    const list = document.getElementById('admin-list');
    list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#666; padding:20px;">Scanning database...</p>';

    try {
        const idSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('verification_status', '==', 'pending').get();
        const artistSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('artist_status', '==', 'pending').get();

        list.innerHTML = '';
        let count = 0;

        idSnaps.forEach(doc => { renderCard(list, doc.id, doc.data(), 'ID'); count++; });
        artistSnaps.forEach(doc => { renderCard(list, doc.id, doc.data(), 'ARTIST'); count++; });

        if(count === 0) list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; width:100%; color:#444; padding:40px;"><h2>ALL CLEAR</h2><p>No pending verification requests.</p></div>';

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        list.innerHTML = `<p style="color:red; padding:20px;">Error loading data: ${e.message}</p>`;
    }
};

function renderCard(container, uid, data, type) {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'admin-card';
    
    const themeColor = type === 'ID' ? '#40c4ff' : '#b28dff';
    card.style.borderTopColor = themeColor;
    
    let proofUrl = (type === 'ID') ? data.id_proof_url : data.artist_proof_url;
    let mediaHtml = '';
    
    if(proofUrl) {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            mediaHtml = `<a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank"><img src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media"></a>`;
        } else {
            mediaHtml = `<video src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media" controls></video>`;
        }
    } else {
        mediaHtml = `<div class="proof-media" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#666;">NO FILE LINKED</div>`;
    }

    let joinDate = "Unknown";
    if(data.created && data.created.toDate) {
        joinDate = data.created.toDate().toLocaleDateString();
    }

    card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="dossier-header">
            <h3 style="color:${themeColor}">${data.handle || "NO_HANDLE"}</h3>
            <span>UID: ${uid}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="dossier-body">
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Request Type:</span> <span class="data-val" style="color:${themeColor}">${type} VERIFICATION</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Email:</span> <span class="data-val">${data.email}</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Joined:</span> <span class="data-val">${joinDate}</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Appeals Used:</span> <span class="data-val">${data.rejection_count || 0} / 5</span></div>
            <div style="margin-top:15px; margin-bottom:5px; color:#666; font-size:0.8rem;">SUBMITTED EVIDENCE:</div>
            ${mediaHtml}
        </div>
        <div class="admin-actions">
            <button class="btn-reject" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'reject')">REJECT</button>
            <button class="btn-approve" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'approve')">APPROVE</button>
        </div>
    `;
    container.appendChild(card);
}

// --- NEW CUSTOM CONFIRM FUNCTION ---
window.cyberConfirm = (title, msg, type) => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-overlay');
        const box = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-box');
        const txtTitle = document.getElementById('cc-title');
        const txtMsg = document.getElementById('cc-msg');
        const btnYes = document.getElementById('cc-btn-yes');
        const btnNo = document.getElementById('cc-btn-no');

        // Reset classes
        box.classList.remove('confirm-green', 'confirm-red');
        
        // Setup Style
        if(type === 'approve') {
            box.classList.add('confirm-green');
            btnYes.innerText = "AUTHORIZE";
        } else {
            box.classList.add('confirm-red');
            btnYes.innerText = "REJECT";
        }

        txtTitle.innerText = title;
        txtMsg.innerText = msg;
        modal.style.display = 'flex'; // Shows the modal

        // Handle Clicks
        const handleYes = () => { cleanup(); resolve(true); };
        const handleNo = () => { cleanup(); resolve(false); };

        function cleanup() {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            btnYes.removeEventListener('click', handleYes);
            btnNo.removeEventListener('click', handleNo);
        }

        btnYes.addEventListener('click', handleYes);
        btnNo.addEventListener('click', handleNo);
    });
};

window.judgeUser = async (uid, type, verdict) => {
    // 1. Define Message
    const title = verdict === 'approve' ? "AUTHORIZE USER?" : "REJECT USER?";
    const msg = verdict === 'approve' 
        ? `Grant ${type} Verification status to this user? They will gain access immediately.` 
        : `Reject this ${type} application? This will add a strike to their record.`;

    // 2. Wait for Custom Modal
    const confirmed = await window.cyberConfirm(title, msg, verdict);
    if(!confirmed) return;

    // 3. Execute Database Logic
    try {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ verification_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("User ID Verified.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected',
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast("User ID Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        else if(type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        
        await loadPendingRequests(); // Refresh list

    } catch (e) {
        alert("Error: " + e.message);
    }
};
</script>
when I approve it says in a different (also windows 95 looking ghetto ass toaster) riajuu.dev says "Error: Missing or insufficient permissions."

You are getting that error because Database Rules currently protect user profiles so strictly that only the owner can edit them.

Even though you are the "Admin" in the app, the Database itself doesn't know you are allowed to edit other people's status to "Verified". It blocks the write, throws an error, and the Javascript catches that error with a standard alert() (the ghetto toaster).

We need to do two things:

Update Firestore Rules: Allow "Admins" to edit anyone's document.

Update Embed 5: Swap the ugly alert() error for the cool showToast().

STEP 1: Unlock "God Mode" in the Database
You need to tell Firestore: "If the person trying to edit this file has isAdmin: true in their own profile, let them do whatever they want."

Go to Firebase Console -> Firestore Database.

Click the Rules tab.

Delete the code there and paste this Admin-Aware Rule Set:

JavaScript
rules_version = '2';
service cloud.firestore {
  match /databases/{database}/documents {
    match /users/{userId} {
      // 1. Anyone can read (needed for profiles/admin panel)
      allow read: if true;
      
      // 2. Creation: Only the user can create their own doc
      allow create: if request.auth != null && request.auth.uid == userId;
      
      // 3. Updates: Allow if it's YOUR account OR if YOU are an Admin
      allow update: if request.auth != null && (
        request.auth.uid == userId || 
        get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.isAdmin == true
      );
    }
    
    // Allow saving uploads to subcollections
    match /users/{userId}/uploads/{document=**} {
      allow read, write: if request.auth != null && (
        request.auth.uid == userId || 
        get(/databases/$(database)/documents/users/$(request.auth.uid)).data.isAdmin == true
      );
    }
  }
}
Click Publish.

STEP 2: Fix the "Ghetto Toaster" (Update Embed 5)
Now let's fix the UI so if an error does happen, it looks like a cool red notification, not a Windows 95 popup.

Update Embed 5 (Admin Panel) with this code. Changes: I replaced the alert(e.message) with window.showToast(e.message, 'error') inside the judgeUser function.

        else if(type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        
        await loadPendingRequests();

    } catch (e) {
        // --- THE FIX: NO MORE GHETTO TOASTER ---
        window.showToast("Error: " + e.message, "error");
        console.error(e);
    }
};

<script>
window.openAdminPanel = async () => {
    if(!window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) return window.showToast("ACCESS DENIED", "error");
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display = 'none'; 
    await loadPendingRequests();
};

window.closeAdminPanel = () => {
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

window.loadPendingRequests = async () => {
    const list = document.getElementById('admin-list');
    list.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#666; padding:20px;">Scanning database...</p>';

    try {
        const idSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('verification_status', '==', 'pending').get();
        const artistSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('artist_status', '==', 'pending').get();

        list.innerHTML = '';
        let count = 0;

        idSnaps.forEach(doc => { renderCard(list, doc.id, doc.data(), 'ID'); count++; });
        artistSnaps.forEach(doc => { renderCard(list, doc.id, doc.data(), 'ARTIST'); count++; });

        if(count === 0) list.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center; width:100%; color:#444; padding:40px;"><h2>ALL CLEAR</h2><p>No pending verification requests.</p></div>';

    } catch (e) {
        // Safe check for showToast
        if(window.showToast) window.showToast("Error loading data", "error");
        console.error(e);
        list.innerHTML = `<p style="color:red; padding:20px;">Error loading data: ${e.message}</p>`;
    }
};

function renderCard(container, uid, data, type) {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className = 'admin-card';
    
    const themeColor = type === 'ID' ? '#40c4ff' : '#b28dff';
    card.style.borderTopColor = themeColor;
    
    let proofUrl = (type === 'ID') ? data.id_proof_url : data.artist_proof_url;
    let mediaHtml = '';
    
    if(proofUrl) {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            mediaHtml = `<a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank"><img src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media"></a>`;
        } else {
            mediaHtml = `<video src="${proofUrl}" class="proof-media" controls></video>`;
        }
    } else {
        mediaHtml = `<div class="proof-media" style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#666;">NO FILE LINKED</div>`;
    }

    let joinDate = "Unknown";
    if(data.created && data.created.toDate) {
        joinDate = data.created.toDate().toLocaleDateString();
    }

    card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="dossier-header">
            <h3 style="color:${themeColor}">${data.handle || "NO_HANDLE"}</h3>
            <span>UID: ${uid}</span>
        </div>
        <div class="dossier-body">
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Request Type:</span> <span class="data-val" style="color:${themeColor}">${type} VERIFICATION</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Email:</span> <span class="data-val">${data.email}</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Joined:</span> <span class="data-val">${joinDate}</span></div>
            <div class="data-row"><span class="data-label">Appeals Used:</span> <span class="data-val">${data.rejection_count || 0} / 5</span></div>
            <div style="margin-top:15px; margin-bottom:5px; color:#666; font-size:0.8rem;">SUBMITTED EVIDENCE:</div>
            ${mediaHtml}
        </div>
        <div class="admin-actions">
            <button class="btn-reject" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'reject')">REJECT</button>
            <button class="btn-approve" onclick="judgeUser('${uid}', '${type}', 'approve')">APPROVE</button>
        </div>
    `;
    container.appendChild(card);
}

// --- CUSTOM CONFIRM FUNCTION ---
window.cyberConfirm = (title, msg, type) => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-overlay');
        const box = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-box');
        const txtTitle = document.getElementById('cc-title');
        const txtMsg = document.getElementById('cc-msg');
        const btnYes = document.getElementById('cc-btn-yes');
        const btnNo = document.getElementById('cc-btn-no');

        box.classList.remove('confirm-green', 'confirm-red');
        
        if(type === 'approve') {
            box.classList.add('confirm-green');
            btnYes.innerText = "AUTHORIZE";
        } else {
            box.classList.add('confirm-red');
            btnYes.innerText = "REJECT";
        }

        txtTitle.innerText = title;
        txtMsg.innerText = msg;
        modal.style.display = 'flex'; 

        const handleYes = () => { cleanup(); resolve(true); };
        const handleNo = () => { cleanup(); resolve(false); };

        function cleanup() {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            btnYes.removeEventListener('click', handleYes);
            btnNo.removeEventListener('click', handleNo);
        }

        btnYes.addEventListener('click', handleYes);
        btnNo.addEventListener('click', handleNo);
    });
};

window.judgeUser = async (uid, type, verdict) => {
    const title = verdict === 'approve' ? "AUTHORIZE USER?" : "REJECT USER?";
    const msg = verdict === 'approve' 
        ? `Grant ${type} Verification status to this user?` 
        : `Reject this ${type} application? This will add a strike.`;

    const confirmed = await window.cyberConfirm(title, msg, verdict);
    if(!confirmed) return;

    try {
        if(type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ verification_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("User ID Verified.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected',
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast("User ID Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        else if(type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        
        await loadPendingRequests();

    } catch (e) {
        window.showToast("Error: " + e.message, "error");
        console.error(e);
    }
};
</script>
ok I signed up and was verified but now I still see this "ARTIST STUDIO LOCKED

⚠ ACCESS DENIED

You must complete ID Verification first."

This is a logic mismatch in the code I gave you.

The Issue: The Admin Panel was updating the text status (verification_status: "verified"), but it forgot to flip the master switch (verified: true).

The Result: The "ID Verification" tab sees the text and says "Accepted" (Green), but the "Artist Studio" tab checks the master switch, sees "False", and locks you out.

We need to fix the Admin Panel (Embed 5) so that when you click "Approve", it flips both switches.

// --- CUSTOM CONFIRM FUNCTION ---
window.cyberConfirm = (title, msg, type) => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-overlay');
        const box = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-box');
        const txtTitle = document.getElementById('cc-title');
        const txtMsg = document.getElementById('cc-msg');
        const btnYes = document.getElementById('cc-btn-yes');
        const btnNo = document.getElementById('cc-btn-no');

        box.classList.remove('confirm-green', 'confirm-red');
        
        if(type === 'approve') {
            box.classList.add('confirm-green');
            btnYes.innerText = "AUTHORIZE";
        } else {
            box.classList.add('confirm-red');
            btnYes.innerText = "REJECT";
        }

        txtTitle.innerText = title;
        txtMsg.innerText = msg;
        modal.style.display = 'flex'; 

        const handleYes = () => { cleanup(); resolve(true); };
        const handleNo = () => { cleanup(); resolve(false); };

        function cleanup() {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            btnYes.removeEventListener('click', handleYes);
            btnNo.removeEventListener('click', handleNo);
        }

        btnYes.addEventListener('click', handleYes);
        btnNo.addEventListener('click', handleNo);
    });
};

window.judgeUser = async (uid, type, verdict) => {
    const title = verdict === 'approve' ? "AUTHORIZE USER?" : "REJECT USER?";
    const msg = verdict === 'approve' 
        ? `Grant ${type} Verification status to this user?` 
        : `Reject this ${type} application? This will add a strike.`;

    const confirmed = await window.cyberConfirm(title, msg, verdict);
    if(!confirmed) return;

    try {
        // ---------------- THE FIX IS HERE ----------------
        // We now update verified: true alongside the status string
        
        if(type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'verified',
                    verified: true  // <--- KEY FIX: FLIPPING THE MASTER SWITCH
                });
                
                // If YOU are the user being approved, update your local data immediately
                if(uid === window.auth.currentUser.uid) {
                    window.currentUserDoc.verified = true;
                    window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'verified';
                }
                
                window.showToast("User ID Verified.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected',
                    verified: false,
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast("User ID Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        else if(type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved.", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected.", "error");
            }
        }
        
        await loadPendingRequests();

    } catch (e) {
        window.showToast("Error: " + e.message, "error");
        console.error(e);
    }
};
