<script>
// --- GLOBAL ADMIN VARIABLES ---
window.pendingList = [];
window.rotatorIndex = 0;

window.openAdminPanel = async () => {
    if(!window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) return window.showToast("ACCESS DENIED", "error");
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display = 'none'; 
    await loadGodData();
};

window.closeAdminPanel = () => {
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

// --- 1. LOAD DATA INTO MEMORY ---
window.loadGodData = async () => {
    const container = document.getElementById('god-rotator');
    const emptyMsg = document.getElementById('god-empty-msg');
    
    container.innerHTML = ''; // Clear old
    window.pendingList = []; // Reset array
    window.rotatorIndex = 0;

    try {
        const idSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('verification_status', '==', 'pending').get();
        const artistSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('artist_status', '==', 'pending').get();

        idSnaps.forEach(doc => window.pendingList.push({ id: doc.id, data: doc.data(), type: 'ID' }));
        artistSnaps.forEach(doc => window.pendingList.push({ id: doc.id, data: doc.data(), type: 'ARTIST' }));

        document.getElementById('god-count').innerText = window.pendingList.length;

        if(window.pendingList.length === 0) {
            emptyMsg.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
            emptyMsg.style.display = 'none';
            buildGodCards(); // Build DOM
            updateGodCarousel(); // Apply 3D transforms
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        window.showToast("Data Load Error", "error");
    }
};

// --- 2. BUILD CARDS (DOM CREATION) ---
window.buildGodCards = () => {
    const container = document.getElementById('god-rotator');
    container.innerHTML = '';

    window.pendingList.forEach((item, index) => {
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'god-card';
        card.id = `card-${index}`; // ID for animation targeting
        
        // Theme Color
        const color = item.type === 'ID' ? '#40c4ff' : '#b28dff';
        card.style.borderTopColor = color;

        // Media
        const proofUrl = (item.type === 'ID') ? item.data.id_proof_url : item.data.artist_proof_url;
        let mediaHtml = `<div style="color:#444;">NO MEDIA FOUND</div>`;
        if(proofUrl) {
            if(item.type === 'ID') mediaHtml = `<a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank"><img src="${proofUrl}"></a>`;
            else mediaHtml = `<video src="${proofUrl}" controls></video>`;
        }

        // Date
        let joinDate = "Unknown";
        if(item.data.created && item.data.created.toDate) joinDate = item.data.created.toDate().toLocaleDateString();

        card.innerHTML = `
            <div class="god-card-header" style="border-bottom:1px solid ${color};">
                <h3 style="color:${color}">${item.data.handle}</h3>
                <span>UID: ${item.id}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="god-card-body">
                <div class="god-media-box">${mediaHtml}</div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">TYPE</span><span class="god-val" style="color:${color}">${item.type} VERIFICATION</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">EMAIL</span><span class="god-val">${item.data.email}</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">JOINED</span><span class="god-val">${joinDate}</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">STRIKES</span><span class="god-val">${item.data.rejection_count || 0} / 5</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="god-actions">
                <button class="god-btn god-btn-reject" onclick="judgeGodUser(${index}, 'reject')">REJECT</button>
                <button class="god-btn god-btn-approve" onclick="judgeGodUser(${index}, 'approve')">APPROVE</button>
            </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(card);
    });
};

// --- 3. THE 3D CAROUSEL ENGINE ---
window.updateGodCarousel = () => {
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.god-card');
    
    cards.forEach((card, i) => {
        // Calculate relative position to active index
        let offset = i - window.rotatorIndex;
        
        // Loop logic (optional, but for now we just want a stack)
        // If we want a finite stack that ends:
        if (i < window.rotatorIndex) {
            // Already processed cards (Hidden)
            card.style.opacity = '0';
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0)';
            card.style.zIndex = -1;
            return;
        }

        if (offset === 0) {
            // CENTER CARD (Active)
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateZ(0px) scale(1)';
            card.style.opacity = '1';
            card.style.zIndex = '10';
            card.style.filter = 'none';
            card.classList.add('active');
        } else if (offset === 1) {
            // RIGHT CARD (Next)
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(250px) translateZ(-200px) rotateY(-15deg) scale(0.8)';
            card.style.opacity = '0.5';
            card.style.zIndex = '5';
            card.style.filter = 'brightness(0.5)';
            card.classList.remove('active');
        } else if (offset === 2) {
            // FAR RIGHT
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(450px) translateZ(-400px) rotateY(-30deg) scale(0.6)';
            card.style.opacity = '0.2';
            card.style.zIndex = '1';
            card.classList.remove('active');
        } else {
            // WAY OFF
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(1000px) scale(0)';
            card.style.opacity = '0';
        }
    });
};

// --- 4. JUDGMENT LOGIC (ANIMATION + DB) ---
window.judgeGodUser = async (index, verdict) => {
    // 1. Get current item
    const item = window.pendingList[index];
    if(!item) return;

    // 2. Play Animation (Immediate feedback)
    const cardEl = document.getElementById(`card-${index}`);
    if(verdict === 'approve') cardEl.classList.add('phase-approve');
    else cardEl.classList.add('phase-reject');

    // 3. Move Carousel to next item immediately (Visual speed)
    window.rotatorIndex++;
    updateGodCarousel();
    
    // Update count display
    const remaining = window.pendingList.length - window.rotatorIndex;
    document.getElementById('god-count').innerText = remaining > 0 ? remaining : 0;
    if(remaining <= 0) document.getElementById('god-empty-msg').style.display = 'block';

    // 4. Perform Database Operation (Silent Background)
    try {
        if(item.type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ verification_status: 'verified', verified: true });
                window.showToast(`${item.data.handle} APPROVED`, "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected', verified: false,
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast(`${item.data.handle} REJECTED`, "error");
            }
        }
        else if(item.type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected", "error");
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        window.showToast("DB ERROR: " + e.message, "error");
    }
};
</script>
that is closer to what I wanted but it's slightly off center to the left and it's too high - needs to be centered totally in both height and width

This is a classic CSS conflict.

The issue is that I used an older "negative margin" technique to center the cards in the CSS, but the Javascript is also trying to center them using modern transforms. These two methods are fighting each other, resulting in the cards being shifted too far left and up.

I have cleaned up the CSS in Embed 5 to rely solely on the modern transform method, which will guarantee perfect centering on any screen size.

it's still not centered - it's centered vertically but not horizontally - still somewhat to the left of center

This is a frustrating issue caused by how browsers calculate the "center" point when combining 3D transforms (perspective) with padding and absolute positioning. The previous code had a padding-top: 60px on the stage area to make room for the header, but this threw off the calculated vertical center, and subtly impacted the horizontal center depending on the screen aspect ratio.

I have rewritten the CSS for the container and the stage to ensure it finds the true, mathematical center of the screen, ignoring the header space.

Update Firebase Embed 5 (The God Mode Terminal)

<script>
// --- GLOBAL ADMIN VARIABLES ---
window.pendingList = [];
window.rotatorIndex = 0;

window.openAdminPanel = async () => {
    if(!window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) return window.showToast("ACCESS DENIED", "error");
    // FIX: Ensure it opens as flex
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display = 'none'; 
    await loadGodData();
};

window.closeAdminPanel = () => {
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

// --- 1. LOAD DATA INTO MEMORY ---
window.loadGodData = async () => {
    const container = document.getElementById('god-rotator');
    const emptyMsg = document.getElementById('god-empty-msg');
    
    container.innerHTML = ''; // Clear old
    window.pendingList = []; // Reset array
    window.rotatorIndex = 0;

    try {
        const idSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('verification_status', '==', 'pending').get();
        const artistSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('artist_status', '==', 'pending').get();

        idSnaps.forEach(doc => window.pendingList.push({ id: doc.id, data: doc.data(), type: 'ID' }));
        artistSnaps.forEach(doc => window.pendingList.push({ id: doc.id, data: doc.data(), type: 'ARTIST' }));

        document.getElementById('god-count').innerText = window.pendingList.length;

        if(window.pendingList.length === 0) {
            emptyMsg.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
            emptyMsg.style.display = 'none';
            buildGodCards(); // Build DOM
            updateGodCarousel(); // Apply 3D transforms
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        window.showToast("Data Load Error", "error");
    }
};

// --- 2. BUILD CARDS (DOM CREATION) ---
window.buildGodCards = () => {
    const container = document.getElementById('god-rotator');
    container.innerHTML = '';

    window.pendingList.forEach((item, index) => {
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'god-card';
        card.id = `card-${index}`; // ID for animation targeting
        
        // Theme Color
        const color = item.type === 'ID' ? '#40c4ff' : '#b28dff';
        card.style.borderTopColor = color;

        // Media
        const proofUrl = (item.type === 'ID') ? item.data.id_proof_url : item.data.artist_proof_url;
        let mediaHtml = `<div style="color:#444;">NO MEDIA FOUND</div>`;
        if(proofUrl) {
            if(item.type === 'ID') mediaHtml = `<a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank"><img src="${proofUrl}"></a>`;
            else mediaHtml = `<video src="${proofUrl}" controls></video>`;
        }

        // Date
        let joinDate = "Unknown";
        if(item.data.created && item.data.created.toDate) joinDate = item.data.created.toDate().toLocaleDateString();

        card.innerHTML = `
            <div class="god-card-header" style="border-bottom:1px solid ${color};">
                <h3 style="color:${color}">${item.data.handle}</h3>
                <span>UID: ${item.id}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="god-card-body">
                <div class="god-media-box">${mediaHtml}</div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">TYPE</span><span class="god-val" style="color:${color}">${item.type} VERIFICATION</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">EMAIL</span><span class="god-val">${item.data.email}</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">JOINED</span><span class="god-val">${joinDate}</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">STRIKES</span><span class="god-val">${item.data.rejection_count || 0} / 5</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="god-actions">
                <button class="god-btn god-btn-reject" onclick="judgeGodUser(${index}, 'reject')">REJECT</button>
                <button class="god-btn god-btn-approve" onclick="judgeGodUser(${index}, 'approve')">APPROVE</button>
            </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(card);
    });
};

// --- 3. THE 3D CAROUSEL ENGINE (FIXED CENTERING) ---
window.updateGodCarousel = () => {
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.god-card');
    
    cards.forEach((card, i) => {
        let offset = i - window.rotatorIndex;
        
        if (i < window.rotatorIndex) {
            // Already processed (Hidden)
            card.style.opacity = '0';
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0)';
            card.style.zIndex = -1;
            return;
        }

        if (offset === 0) {
            // CENTER CARD (Active) - FIX: Ensure translate(-50%, -50%) is base
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateZ(0px) scale(1)';
            card.style.opacity = '1';
            card.style.zIndex = '10';
            card.style.filter = 'none';
            card.classList.add('active');
        } else if (offset === 1) {
            // RIGHT CARD (Next) - FIX: Ensure translate(-50%, -50%) is base
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(250px) translateZ(-200px) rotateY(-15deg) scale(0.8)';
            card.style.opacity = '0.5';
            card.style.zIndex = '5';
            card.style.filter = 'brightness(0.5)';
            card.classList.remove('active');
        } else if (offset === 2) {
            // FAR RIGHT - FIX: Ensure translate(-50%, -50%) is base
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(450px) translateZ(-400px) rotateY(-30deg) scale(0.6)';
            card.style.opacity = '0.2';
            card.style.zIndex = '1';
            card.classList.remove('active');
        } else {
            // WAY OFF
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(1000px) scale(0)';
            card.style.opacity = '0';
        }
    });
};

// --- 4. JUDGMENT LOGIC (ANIMATION + DB) ---
window.judgeGodUser = async (index, verdict) => {
    const item = window.pendingList[index];
    if(!item) return;

    // Play Animation
    const cardEl = document.getElementById(`card-${index}`);
    if(verdict === 'approve') cardEl.classList.add('phase-approve');
    else cardEl.classList.add('phase-reject');

    // Move Carousel
    window.rotatorIndex++;
    updateGodCarousel();
    
    // Update count
    const remaining = window.pendingList.length - window.rotatorIndex;
    document.getElementById('god-count').innerText = remaining > 0 ? remaining : 0;
    if(remaining <= 0) document.getElementById('god-empty-msg').style.display = 'block';

    // Perform DB Operation
    try {
        if(item.type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ verification_status: 'verified', verified: true });
                window.showToast(`${item.data.handle} APPROVED`, "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected', verified: false,
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast(`${item.data.handle} REJECTED`, "error");
            }
        }
        else if(item.type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected", "error");
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        window.showToast("DB ERROR: " + e.message, "error");
    }
};

I think if ppl have a really unique ability they shouldn't be limited but at the same time I don't want hackers and indian scammers to overrun the site. What do you think is the best thing to do?

This is a classic "Paywall vs. Quality" dilemma.

If you hard-lock the Studio behind a $5 subscription, you stop the scammers, but you also kill your platform's growth because talented artists who are skeptical of a new site won't pay upfront just to try it out.

The "Video Proof" you designed is actually your best weapon here. Scammers and bots rely on volume and speed; they will not take the time to record a specific video of themselves drawing layers in Photoshop just to spam your site. That manual review step is your firewall.

The Solution: "Merit-Based Entry" (The Free Tier)
We should change the logic so money isn't the gatekeeper—skill is.

Unlock the Studio for Everyone (who has an ID): Don't block them with the "Artist Pass" screen yet.

Force the Video Proof: Everyone (Free or Paid) must upload the video.

The Split (After Approval):

Free Verified Artist: Can upload 3 items to their shop (The "Prove it" tier).

Subscribed Artist: Infinite uploads + Featured placement.

This keeps the "Indian scammers" and hackers out (because you will reject their fake videos in God Mode) but lets the "unique talent" guys in immediately.

Update Firebase Embed 3 (Dashboard View)
I have removed the "Subscription Required" blocker. Now, Free users can see the "Upload Proof" screen. I also added a check so Free users see a "3/3 Uploads Used" limit if they try to go crazy.

HTML
<script>
// --- 5. DASHBOARD VIEW LOGIC ---

window.openDashboard = async (targetTab = 'purchases') => {
    const u = window.auth.currentUser;
    if(!u) return window.openModal('login');

    window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

    try {
        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get({ source: 'server' });
        window.currentUserDoc = doc.exists ? doc.data() : { handle: "Guest", role: "User", verification_status: 'unverified' };
        
        let badgesHtml = "";
        const vStatus = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status;
        if(vStatus === 'verified') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED ID</span>`;
        else if(vStatus === 'pending') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified" style="color:#d4a017; border-color:#d4a017;">PENDING</span>`;
        else badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;

        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'subscribed') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-subscribed">ARTIST PASS</span>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'premium') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-premium">PREMIUM</span>`;

        document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `<h2>${window.currentUserDoc.handle}</h2><div style="margin-top:5px; color:#666; font-size:11px;">${window.currentUserDoc.role} // ${badgesHtml}</div>`;
        
        // Inject Settings Button if missing
        const sidebar = document.querySelector('.dash-sidebar');
        if(!document.getElementById('btn-settings')) {
            const setBtn = document.createElement('button');
            setBtn.id = 'btn-settings';
            setBtn.className = 'dash-nav-btn';
            setBtn.innerText = 'SETTINGS';
            setBtn.onclick = () => window.switchDashTab('settings');
            const discBtn = document.getElementById('dash-disconnect');
            sidebar.insertBefore(setBtn, discBtn);
        }

        window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
};

window.closeDashboard = () => window.closeAllModals();

window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
    const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');
    document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    
    if(tab === 'settings') {
        const setBtn = document.getElementById('btn-settings');
        if(setBtn) setBtn.classList.add('active');
    } else {
        const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.dash-nav-btn[onclick*="'${tab}'"]`);
        if(activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');
    }

    // TAB: PURCHASES
    if(tab === 'purchases') {
        let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items && window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.length > 0) {
            window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.forEach(i => {
                html += `<a href="${i.link}" target="_blank" style="display:block; padding:15px; background:#121212; border:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none;">DOWNLOAD: ${i.name}</a>`;
            });
        } else { html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found.</p>`; }
        view.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // TAB: SETTINGS
    if(tab === 'settings') {
        const changes = window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0;
        const maxFree = 1;
        const remaining = maxFree - changes;
        const isFree = remaining > 0;

        view.innerHTML = `
            <h3>ACCOUNT SETTINGS</h3>
            <div style="background:#1a1a1a; padding:20px; border:1px solid #333; border-radius:6px;">
                <label style="display:block; color:#888; font-size:0.8rem; margin-bottom:5px;">CURRENT HANDLE</label>
                <div style="display:flex; gap:10px;">
                    <input type="text" id="new-handle-input" value="${window.currentUserDoc.handle}" style="flex:1; background:#000; border:1px solid #444; color:#fff; padding:10px;">
                    <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="attemptNameChange()" style="width:auto; margin:0; ${!isFree ? 'opacity:0.5; border-color:#666; color:#666;' : ''}">
                        ${isFree ? 'UPDATE' : 'PAY TO CHANGE'}
                    </button>
                </div>
                <p style="font-size:0.8rem; color:${isFree ? '#0f0' : '#ff4444'}; margin-top:5px;">
                    ${isFree ? `Free changes remaining: ${remaining}` : `Free changes exhausted. Fee: $5.00`}
                </p>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    // TAB: ID VERIFICATION
    if(tab === 'verify') {
        const status = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status || 'unverified';
        const appeals = window.currentUserDoc.rejection_count || 0;
        const appealsLeft = 5 - appeals;

        if(status === 'verified') {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ID VERIFICATION</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #0f0; background: rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.05); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#0f0; font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:bold; margin-bottom:10px;">ACCEPTED</p><p style="color:#aaa;">Your identity has been confirmed.</p></div><p style="color:#666; margin-top:20px; text-align:center;">You may now apply for Artist Status.</p>`;
        } 
        else if(status === 'pending') {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>VERIFICATION PENDING</h3><div style="padding:40px; border:1px solid #d4a017; background: rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#d4a017; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem; margin-bottom:15px;">UNDER REVIEW</p><p style="color:#fff; font-size:0.95rem;">Your ID has been received.</p><p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem; margin-top:5px;">Please wait for an admin to accept or reject your application.</p></div>`;
        }
        else if(status === 'rejected') {
            if(appealsLeft <= 0) {
                 view.innerHTML = `<h3 style="color:#ff0000;">ACCESS DENIED</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #ff0000; background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#ff0000; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem;">ACCOUNT PERMANENTLY REJECTED</p></div>`;
            } else {
                view.innerHTML = `<h3 style="color:#ff4444;">VERIFICATION REJECTED</h3><div style="background:#1a1a1a; padding:20px; border-left:4px solid #ff4444; margin-bottom:20px;"><p style="color:#fff; margin:0;"><strong>Reason:</strong> Your ID was unclear or invalid.</p></div><p style="color:#ff4444; font-weight:bold;">Appeals Remaining: ${appealsLeft}</p><button class="cyber-btn" onclick="retryVerify()">UPLOAD NEW ID</button>`;
            }
        } else {
            window.renderVerifyUpload(view);
        }
    }

    // TAB: ARTIST STUDIO (THE CHANGE: Opened for Free Users)
    if(tab === 'studio') {
        // 1. MUST BE ID VERIFIED
        if(!window.currentUserDoc.verified) { 
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST STUDIO LOCKED</h3><div style="text-align:center; padding:40px; opacity:0.5;"><p style="color:#ff4444; font-size:1.2rem;">⚠ ACCESS DENIED</p><p>You must complete ID Verification first.</p></div>`; return; 
        }

        const artistStatus = window.currentUserDoc.artist_status || 'unverified';
        const isFree = window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'free';

        // 2. APPROVED ARTIST VIEW
        if(artistStatus === 'verified') {
             // Free Tier Restriction Logic
             let uploadMsg = "Unlimited Uploads Enabled";
             let uploadColor = "#0f0";
             
             if(isFree) {
                 uploadMsg = "FREE TIER: 3 Uploads Limit";
                 uploadColor = "#d4a017";
             }

             view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ARTIST STUDIO</h3>
                <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:20px; border:1px solid ${uploadColor}; padding:10px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.2);">
                    <span style="color:${uploadColor}; font-weight:bold; font-size:0.8rem;">${uploadMsg}</span>
                    ${isFree ? `<a href="${window.SUBSCRIPTION_URL}" target="_blank" style="color:#fff; font-size:0.7rem; text-decoration:underline;">UPGRADE</a>` : ''}
                </div>
                
                <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('art-file-input').click()">+ UPLOAD ARTWORK</button>
                <input type="file" id="art-file-input" style="display:none;" onchange="handleArtUpload(this)">
                
                <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-art" style="margin-top:20px;"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-art"></div></div>
                <p id="upload-status-art" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
            `; 
        } 
        // 3. PENDING REVIEW
        else if(artistStatus === 'pending') {
             view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST VERIFICATION PENDING</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #b28dff; background: rgba(178, 141, 255, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#b28dff; font-weight:bold;">REVIEWING VIDEO PROOF</p><p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem;">We are analyzing your process video for AI usage.</p></div>`;
        } 
        // 4. UNVERIFIED (SHOW PROOF UPLOAD)
        else {
             view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ARTIST PROOF REQUIRED</h3>
                <p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem;">To ensure quality, you must prove you are human.</p>
                <div style="background:#1a1a1a; padding:15px; border-left:2px solid #ff4444; margin-bottom:15px;">
                    <p style="color:#fff; font-size:0.8rem; margin:0;"><strong>REQUIREMENTS:</strong><br>• Video of drawing process<br>• Layers visible<br>• NO Timelapses<br>• Max 30s</p>
                </div>
                <label for="video-file" class="drop-zone" id="drag-zone-vid"><div class="drop-text-main" id="drop-text-vid">UPLOAD PROOF VIDEO</div></label>
                <input type="file" id="video-file" accept="video/*" onchange="handleVideoSelect(this)">
                <button id="transmit-btn-vid" onclick="transmitVideo()" class="cyber-btn" style="display:none;">TRANSMIT PROOF</button>
                <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-vid"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-vid"></div></div>
                <p id="upload-status-vid" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
             `;
        }
    }

    // TAB: DISCONNECT
    if(tab === 'disconnect') {
        view.innerHTML = `<h3 style="color:#ff4444; border-color:#ff4444;">TERMINATION REQUESTED</h3><div style="background:#161616; border:1px solid #333; padding:20px; text-align:center; box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,0,0,0.1) inset;"><p style="color:#fff; font-size:1.1rem; font-family:monospace; margin-bottom:10px;">NEURAL LINK: <span style="color:#0f0;">ACTIVE</span></p><p style="color:#aaa; line-height:1.5;">You are attempting to sever the connection.<br>Do you wish to leave the matrix?</p><div id="disconnect-actions" style="margin-top:25px; display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:center;"><button class="cyber-btn" onclick="closeDashboard()" style="border-color:#444; color:#aaa;">ABORT</button><button class="cyber-btn" onclick="processLogout()" style="border-color:#ff4444; color:#ff4444; background:rgba(255,0,0,0.1);">EJECT</button></div><div id="logout-sequence" style="display:none; margin-top:20px;"><p style="color:#ff4444; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:2px;">SEVERING CONNECTION...</p><div class="upload-progress-container" style="opacity:1; display:block; background:#300;"><div id="logout-bar" class="upload-progress-bar" style="background:#ff0000; width:0%; box-shadow:0 0 10px #ff0000;"></div></div></div></div>`;
    }
};

<script>
// --- 6. FEATURE LOGIC & HELPERS ---

window.attemptNameChange = async () => {
    const newHandle = document.getElementById('new-handle-input').value.trim();
    if(newHandle === window.currentUserDoc.handle) return window.showToast("No change detected.", "error");
    if(!newHandle) return window.showToast("Username cannot be empty.", "error");

    const changes = window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0;
    
    if(changes >= 1) {
        return alert("You have used your free name change. Please pay $5 to continue (Payment Link Placeholder).");
    }

    if(!confirm(`Change username to "${newHandle}"? This is your ONE free change.`)) return;

    try {
        const snap = await window.db.collection('users').where('handle', '==', newHandle).get();
        if(!snap.empty) return window.showToast("Username taken.", "error");

        await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).update({
            handle: newHandle,
            name_changes: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
        });

        window.showToast("Username Updated!", "success");
        window.currentUserDoc.handle = newHandle;
        window.currentUserDoc.name_changes = (window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0) + 1;
        
        document.querySelector('#dash-header-info h2').innerText = newHandle;
        window.switchDashTab('settings');

    } catch(e) {
        window.showToast("Error: " + e.message, "error");
    }
};

    view.innerHTML = `
        <h3>ID VERIFICATION REQUIRED</h3>

            <div class="drop-text-main" id="drop-text">SCAN CREDENTIALS</div>
        </label>
        <input type="file" id="id-file" onchange="handleManualSelect(this)">

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.", "error");
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS (ID) ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS (VIDEO) ---
window.setupVideoDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text-vid').innerText = "VIDEO STAGED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid').style.borderColor = "#b28dff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'artist_proofs');
        }
    });
};

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uid = window.auth.currentUser.uid;
    const handle = window.currentUserDoc.handle || "UnknownUser";
    const safeHandle = handle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");
    const newFileName = `${safeHandle}_${uid}_${file.name}`;

    const metadata = { customMetadata: { 'username': handle, 'uid': uid, 'original_name': file.name } };

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${uid}/${newFileName}`).put(file, metadata);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {
            if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
            if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
            
            if(folderName === 'verification') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     verification_status: 'pending',
                     id_proof_url: downloadURL 
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
                 }).catch(err => {
                     window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     artist_status: 'pending',
                     artist_proof_url: downloadURL
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('uploads').add({
                     url: downloadURL,
                     name: newFileName,
                     uploadedAt: new Date()
                 });
                 window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
            }
        });
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

// --- ICON HANDLER ---
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
    if(profileIcon) {
        const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);
        profileIcon.parentNode.replaceChild(newIcon, profileIcon);
        
        newIcon.addEventListener('click', async () => {
            if(window.auth.currentUser) {
                if(!window.currentUserDoc || !window.currentUserDoc.role) {
                    try {
                        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).get();
                        if(doc.exists) window.currentUserDoc = doc.data();
                    } catch(e) { console.error("Profile Fetch Error", e); }
                }

                const rect = newIcon.getBoundingClientRect();
                const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
                
                if(window.currentUserDoc && window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) {
                    if(!document.getElementById('admin-btn')) {
                         const adminLink = document.createElement('a');
                         adminLink.id = 'admin-btn';
                         adminLink.innerText = "ADMIN TERMINAL";
                         adminLink.style.color = "#ff4444";
                         adminLink.style.borderBottom = "1px solid #333";
                         adminLink.onclick = window.openAdminPanel;
                         dd.insertBefore(adminLink, dd.firstChild);
                    }
                }

                dd.style.left = (rect.right - 160) + 'px';
                dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 15) + 'px';
                dd.style.position = 'fixed';
                dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
                dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
            } else { window.openModal('login'); }
        });
    }
    
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon') && !e.target.closest('#user-dropdown')) {
            const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
            if(dd) dd.style.display='none';
        }
    });
});

<script>
// --- 5. DASHBOARD VIEW LOGIC ---

window.openDashboard = async (targetTab = 'purchases') => {
    const u = window.auth.currentUser;
    if(!u) return window.openModal('login');

    window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

    try {
        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get({ source: 'server' });
        window.currentUserDoc = doc.exists ? doc.data() : { handle: "Guest", role: "User", verification_status: 'unverified' };
        
        let badgesHtml = "";
        const vStatus = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status;
        if(vStatus === 'verified') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED ID</span>`;
        else if(vStatus === 'pending') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified" style="color:#d4a017; border-color:#d4a017;">PENDING</span>`;
        else badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;

        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'subscribed') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-subscribed">ARTIST PASS</span>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'premium') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-premium">PREMIUM</span>`;

        document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `<h2>${window.currentUserDoc.handle}</h2><div style="margin-top:5px; color:#666; font-size:11px;">${window.currentUserDoc.role} // ${badgesHtml}</div>`;
        
        const sidebar = document.querySelector('.dash-sidebar');
        if(!document.getElementById('btn-settings')) {
            const setBtn = document.createElement('button');
            setBtn.id = 'btn-settings';
            setBtn.className = 'dash-nav-btn';
            setBtn.innerText = 'SETTINGS';
            setBtn.onclick = () => window.switchDashTab('settings');
            const discBtn = document.getElementById('dash-disconnect');
            sidebar.insertBefore(setBtn, discBtn);
        }

        window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
};

window.closeDashboard = () => window.closeAllModals();

window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
    const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');
    document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    
    if(tab === 'settings') {
        const setBtn = document.getElementById('btn-settings');
        if(setBtn) setBtn.classList.add('active');
    } else {
        const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.dash-nav-btn[onclick*="'${tab}'"]`);
        if(activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');
    }

    // TAB: PURCHASES
    if(tab === 'purchases') {
        let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items && window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.length > 0) {
            window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.forEach(i => {
                html += `<a href="${i.link}" target="_blank" style="display:block; padding:15px; background:#121212; border:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none;">DOWNLOAD: ${i.name}</a>`;
            });
        } else { html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found.</p>`; }
        view.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // TAB: SETTINGS
    if(tab === 'settings') {
        const changes = window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0;
        const maxFree = 1;
        const remaining = maxFree - changes;
        const isFree = remaining > 0;

        view.innerHTML = `
            <h3>ACCOUNT SETTINGS</h3>
            <div style="background:#1a1a1a; padding:20px; border:1px solid #333; border-radius:6px;">
                <label style="display:block; color:#888; font-size:0.8rem; margin-bottom:5px;">CURRENT HANDLE</label>
                <div style="display:flex; gap:10px;">
                    <input type="text" id="new-handle-input" value="${window.currentUserDoc.handle}" style="flex:1; background:#000; border:1px solid #444; color:#fff; padding:10px;">
                    <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="attemptNameChange()" style="width:auto; margin:0; ${!isFree ? 'opacity:0.5; border-color:#666; color:#666;' : ''}">
                        ${isFree ? 'UPDATE' : 'PAY TO CHANGE'}
                    </button>
                </div>
                <p style="font-size:0.8rem; color:${isFree ? '#0f0' : '#ff4444'}; margin-top:5px;">
                    ${isFree ? `Free changes remaining: ${remaining}` : `Free changes exhausted. Fee: $5.00`}
                </p>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    // TAB: ID VERIFICATION
    if(tab === 'verify') {
        const status = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status || 'unverified';
        const appeals = window.currentUserDoc.rejection_count || 0;
        const appealsLeft = 5 - appeals;

        if(status === 'verified') {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ID VERIFICATION</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #0f0; background: rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.05); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#0f0; font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:bold; margin-bottom:10px;">ACCEPTED</p><p style="color:#aaa;">Your identity has been confirmed.</p></div><p style="color:#666; margin-top:20px; text-align:center;">You may now apply for Artist Status.</p>`;
        } 
        else if(status === 'pending') {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>VERIFICATION PENDING</h3><div style="padding:40px; border:1px solid #d4a017; background: rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#d4a017; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem; margin-bottom:15px;">UNDER REVIEW</p><p style="color:#fff; font-size:0.95rem;">Your ID has been received.</p><p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem; margin-top:5px;">Please wait for an admin to accept or reject your application.</p></div>`;
        }
        else if(status === 'rejected') {
            if(appealsLeft <= 0) {
                 view.innerHTML = `<h3 style="color:#ff0000;">ACCESS DENIED</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #ff0000; background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#ff0000; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem;">ACCOUNT PERMANENTLY REJECTED</p></div>`;

            }
        } else {
            window.renderVerifyUpload(view);
        }
    }

    // TAB: ARTIST STUDIO
    if(tab === 'studio') {
        if(!window.currentUserDoc.verified) { 
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST STUDIO LOCKED</h3><div style="text-align:center; padding:40px; opacity:0.5;"><p style="color:#ff4444; font-size:1.2rem;">⚠ ACCESS DENIED</p><p>You must complete ID Verification first.</p></div>`; return; 
        }

        const artistStatus = window.currentUserDoc.artist_status || 'unverified';
        const isFree = window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'free';

        if(artistStatus === 'verified') {
             let uploadMsg = "Unlimited Uploads Enabled";
             let uploadColor = "#0f0";
             if(isFree) { uploadMsg = "FREE TIER: 3 Uploads Limit"; uploadColor = "#d4a017"; }

             view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ARTIST STUDIO</h3>
                <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:20px; border:1px solid ${uploadColor}; padding:10px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.2);">
                    <span style="color:${uploadColor}; font-weight:bold; font-size:0.8rem;">${uploadMsg}</span>
                    ${isFree ? `<a href="${window.SUBSCRIPTION_URL}" target="_blank" style="color:#fff; font-size:0.7rem; text-decoration:underline;">UPGRADE</a>` : ''}
                </div>
                <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('art-file-input').click()">+ UPLOAD ARTWORK</button>

        } 
        else {
             // --- THE NEW, READABLE UI ---
             view.innerHTML = `

what is "DAW" you talking in relation to making music? well that's fine but you also need to mention all other things like voice actor reading their lines or showcasing their vocal abilities on cam / video etc. not jus art and music.

A DAW stands for Digital Audio Workstation.

It is the software that musicians, producers, and voice actors use to record, edit, and mix audio. Famous examples include FL Studio, Ableton Live, Logic Pro, Pro Tools, and Audacity.

Why it matters for verification: Just like a digital painter has "Layers" in Photoshop, a musician or voice actor has "Tracks" in their DAW.

AI Audio usually generates a single, flat audio file.

Real Audio has a project file with multiple tracks (vocals, drums, background noise, multiple takes).

Showing the DAW timeline proves they actually built the audio and didn't just type "Make a rap song" into an AI generator.

The Fix: Inclusive Requirements
You are absolutely right. The previous text focused too much on drawing. We need to update the text to cover Voice Actors (recording lines), Musicians (playing instruments or mixing), and Artists (drawing).

Here is the updated Embed 3. I have rewritten the Requirements Box to be broad enough for everyone while still strict on the "No AI" rule.

Writer / Author: (Harder to verify via video, but they might show draft history).

Game Developer: (Needs to show the Game Engine like Unity/Unreal).

<script>
// --- 5. DASHBOARD VIEW LOGIC ---

window.openDashboard = async (targetTab = 'purchases') => {
    const u = window.auth.currentUser;
    if(!u) return window.openModal('login');

    window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

    try {
        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get({ source: 'server' });
        window.currentUserDoc = doc.exists ? doc.data() : { handle: "Guest", role: "User", verification_status: 'unverified' };
        
        let badgesHtml = "";
        const vStatus = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status;
        if(vStatus === 'verified') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED ID</span>`;
        else if(vStatus === 'pending') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified" style="color:#d4a017; border-color:#d4a017;">PENDING</span>`;
        else badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;

        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'subscribed') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-subscribed">ARTIST PASS</span>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'premium') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-premium">PREMIUM</span>`;

        document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `<h2>${window.currentUserDoc.handle}</h2><div style="margin-top:5px; color:#666; font-size:11px;">${window.currentUserDoc.role} // ${badgesHtml}</div>`;
        
        const sidebar = document.querySelector('.dash-sidebar');
        if(!document.getElementById('btn-settings')) {
            const setBtn = document.createElement('button');
            setBtn.id = 'btn-settings';
            setBtn.className = 'dash-nav-btn';
            setBtn.innerText = 'SETTINGS';
            setBtn.onclick = () => window.switchDashTab('settings');
            const discBtn = document.getElementById('dash-disconnect');
            sidebar.insertBefore(setBtn, discBtn);
        }

        window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
};

window.closeDashboard = () => window.closeAllModals();

window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
    const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');
    document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    
    if(tab === 'settings') {
        const setBtn = document.getElementById('btn-settings');
        if(setBtn) setBtn.classList.add('active');
    } else {
        const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.dash-nav-btn[onclick*="'${tab}'"]`);
        if(activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');
    }

    // TAB: PURCHASES
    if(tab === 'purchases') {
        let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items && window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.length > 0) {
            window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.forEach(i => {
                html += `<a href="${i.link}" target="_blank" style="display:block; padding:15px; background:#121212; border:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none;">DOWNLOAD: ${i.name}</a>`;
            });
        } else { html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found.</p>`; }
        view.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // TAB: SETTINGS
    if(tab === 'settings') {
        const changes = window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0;
        const maxFree = 1;
        const remaining = maxFree - changes;
        const isFree = remaining > 0;

        view.innerHTML = `
            <h3>ACCOUNT SETTINGS</h3>
            <div style="background:#1a1a1a; padding:20px; border:1px solid #333; border-radius:6px;">
                <label style="display:block; color:#888; font-size:0.8rem; margin-bottom:5px;">CURRENT HANDLE</label>
                <div style="display:flex; gap:10px;">
                    <input type="text" id="new-handle-input" value="${window.currentUserDoc.handle}" style="flex:1; background:#000; border:1px solid #444; color:#fff; padding:10px;">
                    <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="attemptNameChange()" style="width:auto; margin:0; ${!isFree ? 'opacity:0.5; border-color:#666; color:#666;' : ''}">
                        ${isFree ? 'UPDATE' : 'PAY TO CHANGE'}
                    </button>
                </div>
                <p style="font-size:0.8rem; color:${isFree ? '#0f0' : '#ff4444'}; margin-top:5px;">
                    ${isFree ? `Free changes remaining: ${remaining}` : `Free changes exhausted. Fee: $5.00`}
                </p>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    // TAB: ID VERIFICATION
    if(tab === 'verify') {
        const status = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status || 'unverified';
        const appeals = window.currentUserDoc.rejection_count || 0;
        const appealsLeft = 5 - appeals;

        if(status === 'verified') {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ID VERIFICATION</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #0f0; background: rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.05); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#0f0; font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:bold; margin-bottom:10px;">ACCEPTED</p><p style="color:#aaa;">Your identity has been confirmed.</p></div><p style="color:#666; margin-top:20px; text-align:center;">You may now apply for Artist Status.</p>`;
        } 
        else if(status === 'pending') {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>VERIFICATION PENDING</h3><div style="padding:40px; border:1px solid #d4a017; background: rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#d4a017; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem; margin-bottom:15px;">UNDER REVIEW</p><p style="color:#fff; font-size:0.95rem;">Your ID has been received.</p><p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem; margin-top:5px;">Please wait for an admin to accept or reject your application.</p></div>`;
        }
        else if(status === 'rejected') {
            if(appealsLeft <= 0) {
                 view.innerHTML = `<h3 style="color:#ff0000;">ACCESS DENIED</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #ff0000; background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#ff0000; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem;">ACCOUNT PERMANENTLY REJECTED</p></div>`;
            } else {
                view.innerHTML = `<h3 style="color:#ff4444;">VERIFICATION REJECTED</h3><div style="background:#1a1a1a; padding:20px; border-left:4px solid #ff4444; margin-bottom:20px;"><p style="color:#fff; margin:0;"><strong>Reason:</strong> Your ID was unclear or invalid.</p></div><p style="color:#ff4444; font-weight:bold;">Appeals Remaining: ${appealsLeft}</p><button class="cyber-btn" onclick="retryVerify()">UPLOAD NEW ID</button>`;
            }
        } else {
            window.renderVerifyUpload(view);
        }
    }

    // TAB: ARTIST STUDIO
    if(tab === 'studio') {
        if(!window.currentUserDoc.verified) { 
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST STUDIO LOCKED</h3><div style="text-align:center; padding:40px; opacity:0.5;"><p style="color:#ff4444; font-size:1.2rem;">⚠ ACCESS DENIED</p><p>You must complete ID Verification first.</p></div>`; return; 
        }

        const artistStatus = window.currentUserDoc.artist_status || 'unverified';
        const isFree = window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'free';

        if(artistStatus === 'verified') {
             let uploadMsg = "Unlimited Uploads Enabled";
             let uploadColor = "#0f0";
             if(isFree) { uploadMsg = "FREE TIER: 3 Uploads Limit"; uploadColor = "#d4a017"; }

             view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ARTIST STUDIO</h3>
                <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:20px; border:1px solid ${uploadColor}; padding:10px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.2);">
                    <span style="color:${uploadColor}; font-weight:bold; font-size:0.8rem;">${uploadMsg}</span>
                    ${isFree ? `<a href="${window.SUBSCRIPTION_URL}" target="_blank" style="color:#fff; font-size:0.7rem; text-decoration:underline;">UPGRADE</a>` : ''}
                </div>
                <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="document.getElementById('art-file-input').click()">+ UPLOAD ARTWORK</button>
                <input type="file" id="art-file-input" style="display:none;" onchange="handleArtUpload(this)">
                <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-art" style="margin-top:20px;"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-art"></div></div>
                <p id="upload-status-art" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
            `; 
        } 
        else if(artistStatus === 'pending') {
             view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST VERIFICATION PENDING</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #b28dff; background: rgba(178, 141, 255, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#b28dff; font-weight:bold;">REVIEWING VIDEO PROOF</p><p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem;">We are analyzing your process video for AI usage.</p></div>`;
        } 
        else {
             // --- NEW: COMPREHENSIVE REQUIREMENTS ---
             view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ARTIST PROOF REQUIRED</h3>
                <p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:20px;">Upload a video proving you created your work.</p>
                
                <div style="background:#000; padding:20px; border:1px solid #333; border-left:4px solid #b28dff; margin-bottom:20px; border-radius:6px;">
                    <strong style="display:block; color:#b28dff; margin-bottom:10px; font-size:1.1rem; letter-spacing:1px;">REQUIREMENTS:</strong>
                    <ul style="margin:0; padding-left:20px; color:#fff; font-size:1rem; line-height:1.6;">
                        <li><strong>Digital Art:</strong> Show layers, history, & strokes.</li>
                        <li><strong>Traditional:</strong> Show physical canvas & hand movement.</li>
                        <li><strong>3D Art:</strong> Show wireframes & project view.</li>
                        <li><strong>Music / Voice:</strong> Show DAW timeline or recording.</li>
                        <li><strong>ALL:</strong> Real-time only (NO Timelapses).</li>
                        <li><strong>Max 5 Minutes</strong></li>
                    </ul>
                </div>
                
                <label for="video-file" class="drop-zone" id="drag-zone-vid">
                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17 10.5V7c0-.55-.45-1-1-1H4c-.55 0-1 .45-1 1v10c0 .55.45 1 1 1h12c.55 0 1-.45 1-1v-3.5l4 4v-11l-4 4zM14 13h-3v3H9v-3H6v-2h3V8h2v3h3v2z"/></svg>
                    <div class="drop-text-main" id="drop-text-vid">UPLOAD PROOF VIDEO</div>
                    <div class="drop-text-sub">(CLICK OR DRAG VIDEO HERE)</div>
                </label>
                
                <input type="file" id="video-file" accept="video/*" onchange="handleVideoSelect(this)">
                <button id="transmit-btn-vid" onclick="transmitVideo()" class="cyber-btn" style="display:none;">TRANSMIT PROOF</button>
                <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-vid"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-vid"></div></div>
                <p id="upload-status-vid" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
             `;
             
             // Initialize Drag & Drop for Video
             setTimeout(window.setupVideoDragDrop, 100);
        }
    }

    if(tab === 'disconnect') {
        view.innerHTML = `<h3 style="color:#ff4444; border-color:#ff4444;">TERMINATION REQUESTED</h3><div style="background:#161616; border:1px solid #333; padding:20px; text-align:center; box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,0,0,0.1) inset;"><p style="color:#fff; font-size:1.1rem; font-family:monospace; margin-bottom:10px;">NEURAL LINK: <span style="color:#0f0;">ACTIVE</span></p><p style="color:#aaa; line-height:1.5;">You are attempting to sever the connection.<br>Do you wish to leave the matrix?</p><div id="disconnect-actions" style="margin-top:25px; display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:center;"><button class="cyber-btn" onclick="closeDashboard()" style="border-color:#444; color:#aaa;">ABORT</button><button class="cyber-btn" onclick="processLogout()" style="border-color:#ff4444; color:#ff4444; background:rgba(255,0,0,0.1);">EJECT</button></div><div id="logout-sequence" style="display:none; margin-top:20px;"><p style="color:#ff4444; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:2px;">SEVERING CONNECTION...</p><div class="upload-progress-container" style="opacity:1; display:block; background:#300;"><div id="logout-bar" class="upload-progress-bar" style="background:#ff0000; width:0%; box-shadow:0 0 10px #ff0000;"></div></div></div></div>`;
    }

one finicky thing - when I click pfp icon then dashboard - the dashboard and logout subitems are still visible even though I'm in the dashboard - they shouldn't be at that point

You are right. It looks sloppy if the menu hangs around while the Dashboard is trying to take center stage.

The fix is simple: we just need to tell the Dashboard function to forcibly close the dropdown menu the instant it launches.

Update Firebase Embed 3 (Dashboard View)
Delete everything in Embed 3 and paste this. I added the "Force Close Menu" line right at the top of the openDashboard function.

<script>
// --- 5. DASHBOARD VIEW LOGIC ---

window.openDashboard = async (targetTab = 'purchases') => {
    const u = window.auth.currentUser;
    if(!u) return window.openModal('login');

    // --- THE FIX: Force Dropdown to Close ---
    document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display = 'none';

    window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

    try {
        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get({ source: 'server' });
        window.currentUserDoc = doc.exists ? doc.data() : { handle: "Guest", role: "User", verification_status: 'unverified' };
        
        let badgesHtml = "";
        const vStatus = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status;
        if(vStatus === 'verified') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED ID</span>`;
        else if(vStatus === 'pending') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified" style="color:#d4a017; border-color:#d4a017;">PENDING</span>`;
        else badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;

        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'subscribed') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-subscribed">ARTIST PASS</span>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'premium') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-premium">PREMIUM</span>`;

        document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `<h2>${window.currentUserDoc.handle}</h2><div style="margin-top:5px; color:#666; font-size:11px;">${window.currentUserDoc.role} // ${badgesHtml}</div>`;
        
        const sidebar = document.querySelector('.dash-sidebar');
        if(!document.getElementById('btn-settings')) {
            const setBtn = document.createElement('button');
            setBtn.id = 'btn-settings';
            setBtn.className = 'dash-nav-btn';
            setBtn.innerText = 'SETTINGS';
            setBtn.onclick = () => window.switchDashTab('settings');
            const discBtn = document.getElementById('dash-disconnect');
            sidebar.insertBefore(setBtn, discBtn);

        window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
};

window.closeDashboard = () => window.closeAllModals();

window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
    const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');
    document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    
    if(tab === 'settings') {
        const setBtn = document.getElementById('btn-settings');
        if(setBtn) setBtn.classList.add('active');
    } else {
        const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.dash-nav-btn[onclick*="'${tab}'"]`);
        if(activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');
    }

    // TAB: PURCHASES
    if(tab === 'purchases') {
        let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items && window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.length > 0) {
            window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.forEach(i => {
                html += `<a href="${i.link}" target="_blank" style="display:block; padding:15px; background:#121212; border:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none;">DOWNLOAD: ${i.name}</a>`;
            });
        } else { html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found.</p>`; }
        view.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // TAB: SETTINGS
    if(tab === 'settings') {
        const changes = window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0;
        const maxFree = 1;
        const remaining = maxFree - changes;
        const isFree = remaining > 0;

        view.innerHTML = `
            <h3>ACCOUNT SETTINGS</h3>
            <div style="background:#1a1a1a; padding:20px; border:1px solid #333; border-radius:6px;">

                <div style="display:flex; gap:10px;">
                    <input type="text" id="new-handle-input" value="${window.currentUserDoc.handle}" style="flex:1; background:#000; border:1px solid #444; color:#fff; padding:10px;">
                    <button class="cyber-btn" onclick="attemptNameChange()" style="width:auto; margin:0; ${!isFree ? 'opacity:0.5; border-color:#666; color:#666;' : ''}">
                        ${isFree ? 'UPDATE' : 'PAY TO CHANGE'}
                    </button>
                </div>
                <p style="font-size:0.8rem; color:${isFree ? '#0f0' : '#ff4444'}; margin-top:5px;">
                    ${isFree ? `Free changes remaining: ${remaining}` : `Free changes exhausted. Fee: $5.00`}
                </p>
            </div>
        `;
    }

    // TAB: ID VERIFICATION
    if(tab === 'verify') {
        const status = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status || 'unverified';
        const appeals = window.currentUserDoc.rejection_count || 0;

        if(status === 'verified') {

        } 
        else if(status === 'pending') {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>VERIFICATION PENDING</h3><div style="padding:40px; border:1px solid #d4a017; background: rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#d4a017; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem; margin-bottom:15px;">UNDER REVIEW</p><p style="color:#fff; font-size:0.95rem;">Your ID has been received.</p><p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem; margin-top:5px;">Please wait for an admin to accept or reject your application.</p></div>`;
        }
        else if(status === 'rejected') {
            if(appealsLeft <= 0) {
                 view.innerHTML = `<h3 style="color:#ff0000;">ACCESS DENIED</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #ff0000; background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#ff0000; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem;">ACCOUNT PERMANENTLY REJECTED</p></div>`;
            } else {

            }
        } else {
            window.renderVerifyUpload(view);
        }
    }

    // TAB: ARTIST STUDIO
    if(tab === 'studio') {
        if(!window.currentUserDoc.verified) { 
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST STUDIO LOCKED</h3><div style="text-align:center; padding:40px; opacity:0.5;"><p style="color:#ff4444; font-size:1.2rem;">⚠ ACCESS DENIED</p><p>You must complete ID Verification first.</p></div>`; return; 
        }

        const artistStatus = window.currentUserDoc.artist_status || 'unverified';
        const isFree = window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'free';

        if(artistStatus === 'verified') {
             let uploadMsg = "Unlimited Uploads Enabled";
             let uploadColor = "#0f0";
             if(isFree) { uploadMsg = "FREE TIER: 3 Uploads Limit"; uploadColor = "#d4a017"; }

             view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ARTIST STUDIO</h3>
                <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:20px; border:1px solid ${uploadColor}; padding:10px; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.2);">
                    <span style="color:${uploadColor}; font-weight:bold; font-size:0.8rem;">${uploadMsg}</span>
                    ${isFree ? `<a href="${window.SUBSCRIPTION_URL}" target="_blank" style="color:#fff; font-size:0.7rem; text-decoration:underline;">UPGRADE</a>` : ''}

            `; 
        } 
        else if(artistStatus === 'pending') {
             view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST VERIFICATION PENDING</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #b28dff; background: rgba(178, 141, 255, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#b28dff; font-weight:bold;">REVIEWING VIDEO PROOF</p><p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem;">We are analyzing your process video for AI usage.</p></div>`;
        } 
        else {
             // --- INCLUSIVE REQUIREMENTS ---
             view.innerHTML = `
                <h3>ARTIST PROOF REQUIRED</h3>
                <p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem; margin-bottom:20px;">Upload a video proving you created your work.</p>
                
                <div style="background:#000; padding:20px; border:1px solid #333; border-left:4px solid #b28dff; margin-bottom:20px; border-radius:6px;">

                        <li><strong>Max 5 Minutes</strong></li>

                    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M17 10.5V7c0-.55-.45-1-1-1H4c-.55 0-1 .45-1 1v10c0 .55.45 1 1 1h12c.55 0 1-.45 1-1v-3.5l4 4v-11l-4 4zM14 13h-3v3H9v-3H6v-2h3V8h2v3h3v2z"/></svg>

it takes a long time to upload a simple 1 min vid - you got any ideas on making it faster?

The reason it takes so long is likely File Size.

A 1-minute video filmed on a modern iPhone (4K, 60fps) can be 400MB+. Most home internet connections have fast Download speeds but terrible Upload speeds. If their upload speed is 10mbps, a 400MB file takes about 6 minutes to upload.

Since we can't magically upgrade their internet, we have to Force a File Size Limit.

We will add a safety check: If the video is over 150MB, reject it immediately and tell them to compress it. This stops them from staring at a loading bar for 10 minutes only for it to fail.

Here is the update.

STEP 1: Update Firebase Embed 3 (Dashboard View)
I updated the "Requirements" text to explicitly say "Max 150MB" so they know.

HTML
<script>

    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

    try {
        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get({ source: 'server' });
        window.currentUserDoc = doc.exists ? doc.data() : { handle: "Guest", role: "User", verification_status: 'unverified' };
        
        let badgesHtml = "";
        const vStatus = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status;
        if(vStatus === 'verified') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED ID</span>`;
        else if(vStatus === 'pending') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified" style="color:#d4a017; border-color:#d4a017;">PENDING</span>`;
        else badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;

        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'subscribed') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-subscribed">ARTIST PASS</span>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'premium') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-premium">PREMIUM</span>`;

        document.getElementById('dash-header-info').innerHTML = `<h2>${window.currentUserDoc.handle}</h2><div style="margin-top:5px; color:#666; font-size:11px;">${window.currentUserDoc.role} // ${badgesHtml}</div>`;
        
        const sidebar = document.querySelector('.dash-sidebar');
        if(!document.getElementById('btn-settings')) {
            const setBtn = document.createElement('button');
            setBtn.id = 'btn-settings';
            setBtn.className = 'dash-nav-btn';
            setBtn.innerText = 'SETTINGS';
            setBtn.onclick = () => window.switchDashTab('settings');
            const discBtn = document.getElementById('dash-disconnect');
            sidebar.insertBefore(setBtn, discBtn);
        }

        window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
};

window.closeDashboard = () => window.closeAllModals();

window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {
    const view = document.getElementById('dash-main-view');
    document.querySelectorAll('.dash-nav-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
    
    if(tab === 'settings') {
        const setBtn = document.getElementById('btn-settings');
        if(setBtn) setBtn.classList.add('active');
    } else {
        const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.dash-nav-btn[onclick*="'${tab}'"]`);
        if(activeBtn) activeBtn.classList.add('active');
    }

    // TAB: PURCHASES
    if(tab === 'purchases') {
        let html = `<h3>MY DOWNLOADS</h3>`;
        if(window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items && window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.length > 0) {
            window.currentUserDoc.purchased_items.forEach(i => {
                html += `<a href="${i.link}" target="_blank" style="display:block; padding:15px; background:#121212; border:1px solid #333; margin-bottom:10px; color:#fff; text-decoration:none;">DOWNLOAD: ${i.name}</a>`;
            });
        } else { html += `<p style="color:#666; font-style:italic;">No data found.</p>`; }
        view.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // TAB: SETTINGS
    if(tab === 'settings') {
        const changes = window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0;
        const maxFree = 1;
        const remaining = maxFree - changes;
        const isFree = remaining > 0;

        view.innerHTML = `
            <h3>ACCOUNT SETTINGS</h3>
            <div style="background:#1a1a1a; padding:20px; border:1px solid #333; border-radius:6px;">

    // TAB: ID VERIFICATION
    if(tab === 'verify') {

        if(status === 'verified') {

        } 
        else if(status === 'pending') {
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>VERIFICATION PENDING</h3><div style="padding:40px; border:1px solid #d4a017; background: rgba(212, 160, 23, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#d4a017; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem; margin-bottom:15px;">UNDER REVIEW</p><p style="color:#fff; font-size:0.95rem;">Your ID has been received.</p><p style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.9rem; margin-top:5px;">Please wait for an admin to accept or reject your application.</p></div>`;
        }
        else if(status === 'rejected') {
            if(appealsLeft <= 0) {
                 view.innerHTML = `<h3 style="color:#ff0000;">ACCESS DENIED</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #ff0000; background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#ff0000; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem;">ACCOUNT PERMANENTLY REJECTED</p></div>`;
            } else {

            }
        } else {
            window.renderVerifyUpload(view);
        }
    }

    // TAB: ARTIST STUDIO
    if(tab === 'studio') {
        if(!window.currentUserDoc.verified) { 
            view.innerHTML = `<h3>ARTIST STUDIO LOCKED</h3><div style="text-align:center; padding:40px; opacity:0.5;"><p style="color:#ff4444; font-size:1.2rem;">⚠ ACCESS DENIED</p><p>You must complete ID Verification first.</p></div>`; return; 
        }

        const artistStatus = window.currentUserDoc.artist_status || 'unverified';
        const isFree = window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'free';

        if(artistStatus === 'verified') {
             let uploadMsg = "Unlimited Uploads Enabled";
             let uploadColor = "#0f0";
             if(isFree) { uploadMsg = "FREE TIER: 3 Uploads Limit"; uploadColor = "#d4a017"; }

             view.innerHTML = `

        } 
        else {
             // --- NEW: MAX SIZE TEXT ADDED ---
