window.attemptNameChange = async () => {
    const newHandle = document.getElementById('new-handle-input').value.trim();
    if(newHandle === window.currentUserDoc.handle) return window.showToast("No change detected.", "error");
    if(!newHandle) return window.showToast("Username cannot be empty.", "error");

    const changes = window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0;
    
    if(changes >= 1) {
        return alert("You have used your free name change. Please pay $5 to continue (Payment Link Placeholder).");
    }

    if(!confirm(`Change username to "${newHandle}"? This is your ONE free change.`)) return;

    try {
        const snap = await window.db.collection('users').where('handle', '==', newHandle).get();
        if(!snap.empty) return window.showToast("Username taken.", "error");

        await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).update({
            handle: newHandle,
            name_changes: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
        });

        window.showToast("Username Updated!", "success");
        window.currentUserDoc.handle = newHandle;
        window.currentUserDoc.name_changes = (window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0) + 1;
        
        document.querySelector('#dash-header-info h2').innerText = newHandle;
        window.switchDashTab('settings');

    } catch(e) {
        window.showToast("Error: " + e.message, "error");
    }
};

    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';

                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);

            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS (ID) ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS (VIDEO) ---
window.setupVideoDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    
    // --- 1. FILE SIZE CHECK (150MB Limit) ---
    // 150MB = 150 * 1024 * 1024 bytes
    const MAX_SIZE = 150 * 1024 * 1024; 
    
    if(file.size > MAX_SIZE) {
        return window.showToast("File too large. Max 150MB.", "error");
    }

    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uid = window.auth.currentUser.uid;
    const handle = window.currentUserDoc.handle || "UnknownUser";
    const safeHandle = handle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");
    const newFileName = `${safeHandle}_${uid}_${file.name}`;

    const metadata = { customMetadata: { 'username': handle, 'uid': uid, 'original_name': file.name } };

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${uid}/${newFileName}`).put(file, metadata);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {
            if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
            if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
            
            if(folderName === 'verification') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     verification_status: 'pending',
                     id_proof_url: downloadURL 
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
                 }).catch(err => {
                     window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     artist_status: 'pending',
                     artist_proof_url: downloadURL
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('uploads').add({
                     url: downloadURL,
                     name: newFileName,
                     uploadedAt: new Date()
                 });
                 window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
            }
        });
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

    const profileIcon = document.querySelector('.profile-icon');
    if(profileIcon) {
        const newIcon = profileIcon.cloneNode(true);
        profileIcon.parentNode.replaceChild(newIcon, profileIcon);

            if(window.auth.currentUser) {

                        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).get();

                const rect = newIcon.getBoundingClientRect();

                         const adminLink = document.createElement('a');

                         adminLink.innerText = "ADMIN TERMINAL";

                         adminLink.style.borderBottom = "1px solid #333";
                         adminLink.onclick = window.openAdminPanel;
                         dd.insertBefore(adminLink, dd.firstChild);
                    }
                }

                dd.style.left = (rect.right - 160) + 'px';
                dd.style.top = (rect.bottom + 15) + 'px';
                dd.style.position = 'fixed';
                dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";
                dd.style.display = dd.style.display === 'block' ? 'none' : 'block';
            } else { window.openModal('login'); }
        });
    }
    
    window.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon') && !e.target.closest('#user-dropdown')) {
            const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
            if(dd) dd.style.display='none';
        }
    });
});

not everyone knows how to compress footage or is tech savvy - it seems like something unfair to put

You are absolutely right. Penalizing an artist because they have slow rural internet or don't know how to use Handbrake to compress a 4K video is bad UX. It creates a barrier to entry for talented people.

The reason it takes so long is that "Upload Speed" on most home internet connections is terrible (often 10x slower than download speed). A 1-minute raw video can easily be 300MB.

The Solution: The "Hybrid" Approach We will not force them to compress. Instead, we will give them Two Options:

Direct Upload: We increase the limit to 500MB (enough for 5 mins of standard HD video).

Link Submission: We add a box to Paste a Link (YouTube Unlisted, Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.). This is instantaneous for them if they already have the video online, and it saves you storage costs.

Here is the update to all 3 Feature Embeds to support this.

STEP 1: Update Firebase Embed 3 (Dashboard View)
I added a "PASTE LINK" input box right below the Drop Zone. I also updated the text to "Max 500MB" so they know they have more room.

HTML
<script>
// --- 5. DASHBOARD VIEW LOGIC ---

window.openDashboard = async (targetTab = 'purchases') => {
    const u = window.auth.currentUser;
    if(!u) return window.openModal('login');

    document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display = 'none';

    window.switchDashTab(targetTab);
    document.getElementById('dashboard-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('firebase-modal-overlay').style.display = 'block';

    try {
        const doc = await window.db.collection('users').doc(u.uid).get({ source: 'server' });
        window.currentUserDoc = doc.exists ? doc.data() : { handle: "Guest", role: "User", verification_status: 'unverified' };
        
        let badgesHtml = "";
        const vStatus = window.currentUserDoc.verification_status;
        if(vStatus === 'verified') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-verified">VERIFIED ID</span>`;
        else if(vStatus === 'pending') badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified" style="color:#d4a017; border-color:#d4a017;">PENDING</span>`;
        else badgesHtml += `<span class="dash-badge badge-unverified">UNVERIFIED</span>`;

        if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription === 'subscribed') badgesHtml += ` <span class="dash-badge badge-subscribed">ARTIST PASS</span>`;

        const sidebar = document.querySelector('.dash-sidebar');

};

window.closeDashboard = () => window.closeAllModals();

window.switchDashTab = (tab) => {

        if(setBtn) setBtn.classList.add('active');
    } else {

    }

    if(tab === 'verify') {

        }
        else if(status === 'rejected') {

                 view.innerHTML = `<h3 style="color:#ff0000;">ACCESS DENIED</h3><div style="padding:30px; border:1px solid #ff0000; background: rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.1); text-align:center;"><p style="color:#ff0000; font-weight:bold; font-size:1.2rem;">ACCOUNT PERMANENTLY REJECTED</p></div>`;

    if(tab === 'studio') {

STEP 2: Update Firebase Embed 4 (Actions)
I updated transmitVideo to check for a Link first. If there is a link, it saves it instantly. If not, it uploads the file (with the new 500MB limit).

HTML
<script>
// --- 6. FEATURE LOGIC & HELPERS ---

window.attemptNameChange = async () => {
    const newHandle = document.getElementById('new-handle-input').value.trim();
    if(newHandle === window.currentUserDoc.handle) return window.showToast("No change detected.", "error");
    if(!newHandle) return window.showToast("Username cannot be empty.", "error");

    const changes = window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0;
    
    if(changes >= 1) {
        return alert("You have used your free name change. Please pay $5 to continue (Payment Link Placeholder).");
    }

    if(!confirm(`Change username to "${newHandle}"? This is your ONE free change.`)) return;

    try {
        const snap = await window.db.collection('users').where('handle', '==', newHandle).get();
        if(!snap.empty) return window.showToast("Username taken.", "error");

        await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).update({
            handle: newHandle,
            name_changes: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
        });

        window.showToast("Username Updated!", "success");
        window.currentUserDoc.handle = newHandle;
        window.currentUserDoc.name_changes = (window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0) + 1;
        
        document.querySelector('#dash-header-info h2').innerText = newHandle;
        window.switchDashTab('settings');

    } catch(e) {
        window.showToast("Error: " + e.message, "error");
    }
};

window.renderVerifyUpload = (view) => {
    view.innerHTML = `
        <h3>ID VERIFICATION REQUIRED</h3>
        <p style="font-size:13px; color:#888;">Upload government ID to unlock features.</p>
        <label for="id-file" class="drop-zone" id="drag-zone">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19.35 10.04C18.67 6.59 15.64 4 12 4 9.11 4 6.6 5.64 5.35 8.04 2.34 8.36 0 10.91 0 14c0 3.31 2.69 6 6 6h13c2.76 0 5-2.24 5-5 0-2.64-2.05-4.78-4.65-4.96zM14 13v4h-4v-4H7l5-5 5 5h-3z"></path></svg>
            <div class="drop-text-main" id="drop-text">SCAN CREDENTIALS</div>
        </label>
        <input type="file" id="id-file" onchange="handleManualSelect(this)">
        <button id="transmit-btn" onclick="transmitData()" class="cyber-btn" style="display:none;">TRANSMIT DATA</button>
        <div class="upload-progress-container" id="prog-container-verify"><div class="upload-progress-bar" id="prog-bar-verify"></div></div>
        <p id="upload-status-verify" style="margin-top:10px; color:#40c4ff; font-size:11px;"></p>
    `;
    setTimeout(window.setupDragDrop, 100);
}

window.retryVerify = () => {
    window.renderVerifyUpload(document.getElementById('dash-main-view'));
}

window.processLogout = () => {
    document.getElementById('disconnect-actions').style.display = 'none';
    document.getElementById('logout-sequence').style.display = 'block';
    const bar = document.getElementById('logout-bar');
    let width = 0;
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
        if(width >= 100) {
            clearInterval(interval);
            window.showToast("DISCONNECTED.", "error");
            setTimeout(() => {
                window.auth.signOut();
                window.closeAllModals();
                location.reload(); 
            }, 800);
        } else {
            width += 5;
            bar.style.width = width + '%';
        }
    }, 50);
};

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.setupVideoDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text-vid').innerText = "VIDEO STAGED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid').style.borderColor = "#b28dff";
            // Auto start logic for videos
            window.stagedFile = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
        }
    });
};

window.handleManualSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
        document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'block';
    }
};

window.handleVideoSelect = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.stagedFile = input.files[0];
        document.getElementById('drop-text-vid').innerText = "VIDEO STAGED: " + window.stagedFile.name;
        document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid').style.borderColor = "#b28dff";
    }
}

window.handleArtUpload = (input) => {
    if(input.files && input.files.length > 0) {
        window.startUpload(input.files[0], 'art_uploads');
    }
};

window.transmitData = () => {
    if(!window.stagedFile) return window.showToast("Select a file first.", "error");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'verification');
};

// --- UPDATED VIDEO TRANSMIT (LINK OR FILE) ---
window.transmitVideo = () => {
    const linkInput = document.getElementById('video-link-input');
    const linkVal = linkInput ? linkInput.value.trim() : "";

    // 1. Check for Link First
    if(linkVal.length > 5) {
        // Simple validation
        if(!linkVal.includes('http')) return window.showToast("Invalid URL. Must include http/https", "error");
        
        // Save Link directly
        window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).set({ 
             artist_status: 'pending',
             artist_proof_url: linkVal // Saving Text Link
        }, { merge: true }).then(() => {
             window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
             window.showToast("Link Submitted!", "success");
             setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
        });
        return;
    }

    // 2. Check for File
    if(!window.stagedFile) return window.showToast("Please select a video or paste a link.", "error");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'artist_proofs');
};

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    
    // --- 1. UPDATED FILE SIZE CHECK (500MB) ---
    // 500MB = 500 * 1024 * 1024 bytes
    const MAX_SIZE = 500 * 1024 * 1024; 
    
    if(file.size > MAX_SIZE) {
        return window.showToast("File too large. Max 500MB. Use a Link instead.", "error");
    }

    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uid = window.auth.currentUser.uid;
    const handle = window.currentUserDoc.handle || "UnknownUser";
    const safeHandle = handle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");
    const newFileName = `${safeHandle}_${uid}_${file.name}`;

    const metadata = { customMetadata: { 'username': handle, 'uid': uid, 'original_name': file.name } };

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${uid}/${newFileName}`).put(file, metadata);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {
            if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
            if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
            
            if(folderName === 'verification') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     verification_status: 'pending',
                     id_proof_url: downloadURL 
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
                 }).catch(err => {
                     window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     artist_status: 'pending',
                     artist_proof_url: downloadURL
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('uploads').add({
                     url: downloadURL,
                     name: newFileName,
                     uploadedAt: new Date()
                 });
                 window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
            }
        });
    });
};

                dd.style.zIndex = "2147483647";

        if(!e.target.closest('.profile-icon') && !e.target.closest('#user-dropdown')) {
            const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
            if(dd) dd.style.display='none';
        }
    });

<script>
// --- GLOBAL ADMIN VARIABLES ---
window.pendingList = [];
window.rotatorIndex = 0;

window.openAdminPanel = async () => {
    if(!window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) return window.showToast("ACCESS DENIED", "error");
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display = 'none'; 
    await loadGodData();
};

window.closeAdminPanel = () => {
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

// --- 1. LOAD DATA INTO MEMORY ---
window.loadGodData = async () => {
    const container = document.getElementById('god-rotator');
    const emptyMsg = document.getElementById('god-empty-msg');
    
    container.innerHTML = ''; 
    window.pendingList = []; 
    window.rotatorIndex = 0;

    try {
        const idSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('verification_status', '==', 'pending').get();
        const artistSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('artist_status', '==', 'pending').get();

        idSnaps.forEach(doc => window.pendingList.push({ id: doc.id, data: doc.data(), type: 'ID' }));
        artistSnaps.forEach(doc => window.pendingList.push({ id: doc.id, data: doc.data(), type: 'ARTIST' }));

        if(window.pendingList.length === 0) {
            emptyMsg.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
            emptyMsg.style.display = 'none';
            buildGodCards();
            updateGodCarousel(); 
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        window.showToast("Data Load Error", "error");
    }
};

// --- 2. BUILD CARDS (DOM CREATION) ---
window.buildGodCards = () => {
    const container = document.getElementById('god-rotator');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    const total = window.pendingList.length;

    window.pendingList.forEach((item, index) => {
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'god-card';
        card.id = `card-${index}`;
        
        // Theme Color
        const color = item.type === 'ID' ? '#40c4ff' : '#b28dff';
        card.style.borderTopColor = color;

        // Media Logic (Updated for Link Support)
        const proofUrl = (item.type === 'ID') ? item.data.id_proof_url : item.data.artist_proof_url;
        let mediaHtml = `<div style="color:#444;">NO MEDIA FOUND</div>`;
        
        if(proofUrl) {
            if(item.type === 'ID') {
                mediaHtml = `<a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank"><img src="${proofUrl}"></a>`;
            } else {
                // Check if it's a file from Firebase or an external link
                if(proofUrl.includes('firebasestorage')) {
                    mediaHtml = `<video src="${proofUrl}" controls></video>`;
                } else {
                    // External Link UI
                    mediaHtml = `
                        <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:100%; width:100%;">
                            <span style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.8rem; margin-bottom:10px; font-family:monospace;">EXTERNAL LINK</span>
                            <a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank" class="cc-btn cc-yes" style="text-decoration:none; padding:10px 20px; flex:none; background:${color}; color:#000;">OPEN LINK</a>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
            }
        }

        // Date
        let joinDate = "Unknown";
        if(item.data.created && item.data.created.toDate) joinDate = item.data.created.toDate().toLocaleDateString();

        card.innerHTML = `
            <div class="god-card-header" style="border-bottom:1px solid ${color};">
                <h3 style="color:${color}">${item.data.handle}</h3>
                <span>UID: ${item.id}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="god-card-body">
                <div class="god-media-box">${mediaHtml}</div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">TYPE</span><span class="god-val" style="color:${color}">${item.type} VERIFICATION</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">EMAIL</span><span class="god-val">${item.data.email}</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">JOINED</span><span class="god-val">${joinDate}</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">STRIKES</span><span class="god-val">${item.data.rejection_count || 0} / 5</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="god-actions">
                <button class="god-btn god-btn-reject" onclick="judgeGodUser(${index}, 'reject')">REJECT</button>
                <button class="god-btn god-btn-approve" onclick="judgeGodUser(${index}, 'approve')">APPROVE</button>
            </div>
            <div class="god-card-footer" style="color:${color};">
                QUEUE ITEM: ${index + 1} / ${total}
            </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(card);
    });
};

// --- 3. THE 3D CAROUSEL ENGINE ---
window.updateGodCarousel = () => {
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.god-card');
    
    cards.forEach((card, i) => {
        let offset = i - window.rotatorIndex;
        
        if (i < window.rotatorIndex) {
            card.style.opacity = '0';
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0)';
            card.style.zIndex = -1;
            return;
        }

        if (offset === 0) {
            // CENTER
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateZ(0px) scale(1)';
            card.style.opacity = '1'; card.style.zIndex = '10'; card.style.filter = 'none';
            card.classList.add('active');
        } else if (offset === 1) {
            // RIGHT
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(250px) translateZ(-200px) rotateY(-15deg) scale(0.8)';
            card.style.opacity = '0.5'; card.style.zIndex = '5'; card.style.filter = 'brightness(0.5)';
            card.classList.remove('active');
        } else if (offset === 2) {
            // FAR RIGHT
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(450px) translateZ(-400px) rotateY(-30deg) scale(0.6)';
            card.style.opacity = '0.2'; card.style.zIndex = '1';
            card.classList.remove('active');
        } else {
            // WAY OFF
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(1000px) scale(0)';
            card.style.opacity = '0';
        }
    });
};

// --- 4. JUDGMENT LOGIC (ANIMATION + DB) ---
// --- NEW CUSTOM CONFIRM FUNCTION ---
window.cyberConfirm = (title, msg, type) => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-overlay');
        const box = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-box');
        const txtTitle = document.getElementById('cc-title');
        const txtMsg = document.getElementById('cc-msg');
        const btnYes = document.getElementById('cc-btn-yes');
        const btnNo = document.getElementById('cc-btn-no');

        box.classList.remove('confirm-green', 'confirm-red');
        
        if(type === 'approve') {
            box.classList.add('confirm-green');
            btnYes.innerText = "AUTHORIZE";
        } else {
            box.classList.add('confirm-red');
            btnYes.innerText = "REJECT";
        }

        txtTitle.innerText = title;
        txtMsg.innerText = msg;
        modal.style.display = 'flex'; 

        const handleYes = () => { cleanup(); resolve(true); };
        const handleNo = () => { cleanup(); resolve(false); };

        function cleanup() {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            btnYes.removeEventListener('click', handleYes);
            btnNo.removeEventListener('click', handleNo);
        }

        btnYes.addEventListener('click', handleYes);
        btnNo.addEventListener('click', handleNo);
    });
};

window.judgeGodUser = async (index, verdict) => {
    const item = window.pendingList[index];
    if(!item) return;

    // 1. Confirm
    const title = verdict === 'approve' ? "AUTHORIZE USER?" : "REJECT USER?";
    const msg = verdict === 'approve' ? `Grant ${item.type} status?` : `Reject this application? Adds a strike.`;
    const confirmed = await window.cyberConfirm(title, msg, verdict);
    if(!confirmed) return;

    // 2. Animate
    const cardEl = document.getElementById(`card-${index}`);
    if(verdict === 'approve') cardEl.classList.add('phase-approve');
    else cardEl.classList.add('phase-reject');

    // 3. Move
    window.rotatorIndex++;
    updateGodCarousel();
    
    const remaining = window.pendingList.length - window.rotatorIndex;
    if(remaining <= 0) setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('god-empty-msg').style.display = 'block', 600);

    // 4. DB Update
    try {
        if(item.type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ verification_status: 'verified', verified: true });
                window.showToast(`${item.data.handle} APPROVED`, "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected', verified: false,
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast(`${item.data.handle} REJECTED`, "error");
            }
        }
        else if(item.type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected", "error");
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        window.showToast("DB ERROR: " + e.message, "error");
        console.error(e);
    }
};
</script>

HTML
<script>
// --- GLOBAL ADMIN VARIABLES ---
window.pendingList = [];
window.rotatorIndex = 0;

window.openAdminPanel = async () => {
    if(!window.currentUserDoc.isAdmin) return window.showToast("ACCESS DENIED", "error");
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'flex';
    document.getElementById('user-dropdown').style.display = 'none'; 
    await loadGodData();
};

window.closeAdminPanel = () => {
    document.getElementById('admin-ui').style.display = 'none';
};

// --- 1. LOAD DATA ---
window.loadGodData = async () => {
    const container = document.getElementById('god-rotator');
    const emptyMsg = document.getElementById('god-empty-msg');
    
    container.innerHTML = ''; 
    window.pendingList = []; 
    window.rotatorIndex = 0;

    try {
        const idSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('verification_status', '==', 'pending').get();
        const artistSnaps = await window.db.collection('users').where('artist_status', '==', 'pending').get();

        idSnaps.forEach(doc => window.pendingList.push({ id: doc.id, data: doc.data(), type: 'ID' }));
        artistSnaps.forEach(doc => window.pendingList.push({ id: doc.id, data: doc.data(), type: 'ARTIST' }));

        if(window.pendingList.length === 0) {
            emptyMsg.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
            emptyMsg.style.display = 'none';
            buildGodCards();
            updateGodCarousel(); 
        }

    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        window.showToast("Data Load Error", "error");
    }
};

// --- 2. BUILD CARDS ---
window.buildGodCards = () => {
    const container = document.getElementById('god-rotator');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    const total = window.pendingList.length;

    window.pendingList.forEach((item, index) => {
        const card = document.createElement('div');
        card.className = 'god-card';
        card.id = `card-${index}`;
        
        const color = item.type === 'ID' ? '#40c4ff' : '#b28dff';
        card.style.borderTopColor = color;

        // Media Logic
        const proofUrl = (item.type === 'ID') ? item.data.id_proof_url : item.data.artist_proof_url;
        let mediaHtml = `<div style="color:#444;">NO MEDIA FOUND</div>`;
        
        if(proofUrl) {
            if(item.type === 'ID') {
                mediaHtml = `<a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank"><img src="${proofUrl}"></a>`;
            } else {
                if(proofUrl.includes('firebasestorage')) {
                    mediaHtml = `<video src="${proofUrl}" controls></video>`;
                } else {
                    mediaHtml = `
                        <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; height:100%; width:100%;">
                            <span style="color:#aaa; font-size:0.8rem; margin-bottom:10px; font-family:monospace;">EXTERNAL LINK</span>
                            <a href="${proofUrl}" target="_blank" class="cc-btn cc-yes" style="text-decoration:none; padding:10px 20px; flex:none; background:${color}; color:#000;">OPEN LINK</a>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }
            }
        }

        let joinDate = "Unknown";
        if(item.data.created && item.data.created.toDate) joinDate = item.data.created.toDate().toLocaleDateString();

        card.innerHTML = `
            <div class="god-card-header" style="border-bottom:1px solid ${color};">
                <h3 style="color:${color}">${item.data.handle}</h3>
                <span>UID: ${item.id}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="god-card-body">
                <div class="god-media-box">${mediaHtml}</div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">TYPE</span><span class="god-val" style="color:${color}">${item.type} VERIFICATION</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">EMAIL</span><span class="god-val">${item.data.email}</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">JOINED</span><span class="god-val">${joinDate}</span></div>
                <div class="god-data-row"><span class="god-label">STRIKES</span><span class="god-val">${item.data.rejection_count || 0} / 5</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="god-actions">
                <button class="god-btn god-btn-reject" onclick="judgeGodUser(${index}, 'reject')">REJECT</button>
                <button class="god-btn god-btn-approve" onclick="judgeGodUser(${index}, 'approve')">APPROVE</button>
            </div>
            <div class="god-card-footer" style="color:${color};">
                QUEUE ITEM: ${index + 1} / ${total}
            </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(card);
    });
};

// --- 3. CAROUSEL ENGINE ---
window.updateGodCarousel = () => {
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.god-card');
    
    cards.forEach((card, i) => {
        let offset = i - window.rotatorIndex;
        
        if (i < window.rotatorIndex) {
            card.style.opacity = '0';
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0)';
            card.style.zIndex = -1;
            return;
        }

        if (offset === 0) {
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateZ(0px) scale(1)';
            card.style.opacity = '1'; card.style.zIndex = '10'; card.style.filter = 'none';
            card.classList.add('active');
        } else if (offset === 1) {
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(250px) translateZ(-200px) rotateY(-15deg) scale(0.8)';
            card.style.opacity = '0.5'; card.style.zIndex = '5'; card.style.filter = 'brightness(0.5)';
            card.classList.remove('active');
        } else if (offset === 2) {
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(450px) translateZ(-400px) rotateY(-30deg) scale(0.6)';
            card.style.opacity = '0.2'; card.style.zIndex = '1';
            card.classList.remove('active');
        } else {
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(1000px) scale(0)';
            card.style.opacity = '0';
        }
    });
};

// --- 4. CONFIRM & JUDGE LOGIC ---
window.cyberConfirm = (title, msg, type) => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-overlay');
        const box = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-box');
        const txtTitle = document.getElementById('cc-title');
        const txtMsg = document.getElementById('cc-msg');
        const btnYes = document.getElementById('cc-btn-yes');
        const btnNo = document.getElementById('cc-btn-no');

        box.classList.remove('confirm-green', 'confirm-red');
        
        if(type === 'approve') {
            box.classList.add('confirm-green');
            btnYes.innerText = "AUTHORIZE";
        } else {
            box.classList.add('confirm-red');
            btnYes.innerText = "REJECT";
        }

        txtTitle.innerText = title;
        txtMsg.innerText = msg;
        modal.style.display = 'flex'; 

        const handleYes = () => { cleanup(); resolve(true); };
        const handleNo = () => { cleanup(); resolve(false); };

        function cleanup() {
            modal.style.display = 'none';
            btnYes.removeEventListener('click', handleYes);
            btnNo.removeEventListener('click', handleNo);
        }

        btnYes.addEventListener('click', handleYes);
        btnNo.addEventListener('click', handleNo);
    });
};

window.judgeGodUser = async (index, verdict) => {
    const item = window.pendingList[index];
    if(!item) return;

    const title = verdict === 'approve' ? "AUTHORIZE USER?" : "REJECT USER?";
    const msg = verdict === 'approve' ? `Grant ${item.type} status?` : `Reject this application? Adds a strike.`;
    const confirmed = await window.cyberConfirm(title, msg, verdict);
    if(!confirmed) return;

    const cardEl = document.getElementById(`card-${index}`);
    if(verdict === 'approve') cardEl.classList.add('phase-approve');
    else cardEl.classList.add('phase-reject');

    window.rotatorIndex++;
    updateGodCarousel();
    
    const remaining = window.pendingList.length - window.rotatorIndex;
    if(remaining <= 0) setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('god-empty-msg').style.display = 'block', 600);

    try {
        if(item.type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ verification_status: 'verified', verified: true });
                window.showToast(`${item.data.handle} APPROVED`, "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected', verified: false,
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast(`${item.data.handle} REJECTED`, "error");
            }
        }
        else if(item.type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected", "error");
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        window.showToast("DB ERROR: " + e.message, "error");
    }
};
</script>

You are right to be concerned about storage. If a "Free" user uploads 500 songs or 500 videos, your Firebase bill will explode.

Here is the best way to handle limits for the different creative categories to balance "Showing off talent" vs. "Preventing abuse":

The "5-Slot" Strategy (Recommended)
Instead of complicated rules for every single genre (e.g., "3 songs but 5 paintings"), I recommend a Universal 5-Slot Limit for Free users.

Visual Artists: Can upload 5 pieces of high-res art.

Musicians: Can upload 5 songs.

Voice Actors: Can upload 5 demo reels.

Animators/Editors: Can upload 5 videos (but we keep a strict file size limit on these).

Why 5? It is enough to build a portfolio that sells a subscription ("Wow, look at these 5 things, I want to see more!"), but small enough that a scammer/bot can't flood your server with junk.

<script>
// --- 6. FEATURE LOGIC & HELPERS ---

// --- NEW: QUOTA CHECKER ---
window.checkQuota = async () => {
    // 1. If Premium/Subscribed, no limit
    if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription !== 'free') return true;

    // 2. Count existing uploads in the subcollection
    try {
        const snap = await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).collection('uploads').get();
        const count = snap.size;
        
        // 3. The Limit is 5
        if(count >= 5) {
            window.showToast("FREE LIMIT REACHED (5/5). Upgrade to upload more.", "error");
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    } catch(e) {
        console.error(e);
        return false;
    }
};

window.attemptNameChange = async () => {
    const newHandle = document.getElementById('new-handle-input').value.trim();
    if(newHandle === window.currentUserDoc.handle) return window.showToast("No change detected.", "error");
    if(!newHandle) return window.showToast("Username cannot be empty.", "error");

    const changes = window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0;
    
    if(changes >= 1) {
        return alert("You have used your free name change. Please pay $5 to continue (Payment Link Placeholder).");
    }

    if(!confirm(`Change username to "${newHandle}"? This is your ONE free change.`)) return;

    try {
        const snap = await window.db.collection('users').where('handle', '==', newHandle).get();
        if(!snap.empty) return window.showToast("Username taken.", "error");

        await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).update({
            handle: newHandle,
            name_changes: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
        });

        window.showToast("Username Updated!", "success");
        window.currentUserDoc.handle = newHandle;
        window.currentUserDoc.name_changes = (window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0) + 1;
        
        document.querySelector('#dash-header-info h2').innerText = newHandle;
        window.switchDashTab('settings');

    } catch(e) {
        window.showToast("Error: " + e.message, "error");
    }
};

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

window.setupVideoDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone-vid');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';

    const linkInput = document.getElementById('video-link-input');

    if(linkVal.length > 5) {

        window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).set({ 
             artist_status: 'pending',
             artist_proof_url: linkVal 
        }, { merge: true }).then(() => {
             window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
             window.showToast("Link Submitted!", "success");
             setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
        });
        return;
    }

    if(!window.stagedFile) return window.showToast("Please select a video or paste a link.", "error");
    window.startUpload(window.stagedFile, 'artist_proofs');

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    
    // FILE SIZE LIMITS
    // 500MB for Video Proofs
    // 50MB for Art Uploads (High Res Images/Audio)
    let MAX_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024; // Default 50MB
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') MAX_SIZE = 500 * 1024 * 1024; // 500MB

    if(file.size > MAX_SIZE) {
        return window.showToast(`File too large. Max ${MAX_SIZE/(1024*1024)}MB.`, "error");
    }

    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uid = window.auth.currentUser.uid;
    const handle = window.currentUserDoc.handle || "UnknownUser";
    const safeHandle = handle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");
    const newFileName = `${safeHandle}_${uid}_${file.name}`;

    const metadata = { customMetadata: { 'username': handle, 'uid': uid, 'original_name': file.name } };

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${uid}/${newFileName}`).put(file, metadata);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {
            if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
            if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
            
            if(folderName === 'verification') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     verification_status: 'pending',
                     id_proof_url: downloadURL 
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
                 }).catch(err => {
                     window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     artist_status: 'pending',
                     artist_proof_url: downloadURL
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('uploads').add({
                     url: downloadURL,
                     name: newFileName,
                     uploadedAt: new Date()
                 });
                 window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
            }
        });
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {
    window.openDashboard('disconnect'); 
};

            const dd = document.getElementById('user-dropdown');
            if(dd) dd.style.display='none';
        }
    });

I think there DOES need to be specific limits on all categories because as a voice actor or musician I can just add an entire album or an entire audio library of my voice acting in one "demo" "Voice Actors: Can upload 5 demo reels." <-- needs to be checked as in limited in size or even less than 5 because you didn't designate a limit - sometimes a voice actor only has one or two voices - also They may want to show a live in-person live action recording like they're in the booth and you see them in the booth so just a track is not good enough.

You are absolutely right. A 5-slot limit is useless if one "slot" is a 2-hour MP3 file containing 30 tracks. That is a bandwidth nightmare.

We need Format-Specific Limits. This allows high-quality work (a 4K painting or a lossless WAV demo) but blocks "bulk dumping" (albums, long podcasts, raw movies).

Here is the New Rule Set we will enforce in the code:

Audio (Voice/Music): Max 20MB. (Enough for a high-quality 5-minute song/demo. Blocks full albums).

Video (Reels/Booth): Max 200MB. (Enough for a crisp 1-2 minute showreel. Blocks long episodes).

Images (Art/Design): Max 20MB. (Huge limit for 8K art, but blocks zip files).

HTML
<script>
// --- 6. FEATURE LOGIC & HELPERS ---

// --- QUOTA CHECKER ---
window.checkQuota = async () => {
    if(window.currentUserDoc.subscription !== 'free') return true;
    try {
        const snap = await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).collection('uploads').get();
        if(snap.size >= 5) {
            window.showToast("FREE LIMIT REACHED (5/5). Upgrade to upload more.", "error");
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    } catch(e) { return false; }
};

window.attemptNameChange = async () => {
    const newHandle = document.getElementById('new-handle-input').value.trim();
    if(newHandle === window.currentUserDoc.handle) return window.showToast("No change detected.", "error");
    if(!newHandle) return window.showToast("Username cannot be empty.", "error");

    const changes = window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0;
    
    if(changes >= 1) return alert("You have used your free name change. Please pay $5 to continue (Payment Link Placeholder).");

    if(!confirm(`Change username to "${newHandle}"? This is your ONE free change.`)) return;

    try {
        const snap = await window.db.collection('users').where('handle', '==', newHandle).get();
        if(!snap.empty) return window.showToast("Username taken.", "error");

        await window.db.collection('users').doc(window.auth.currentUser.uid).update({
            handle: newHandle,
            name_changes: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
        });

        window.showToast("Username Updated!", "success");
        window.currentUserDoc.handle = newHandle;
        window.currentUserDoc.name_changes = (window.currentUserDoc.name_changes || 0) + 1;
        document.querySelector('#dash-header-info h2').innerText = newHandle;
        window.switchDashTab('settings');
    } catch(e) {
        window.showToast("Error: " + e.message, "error");
    }
};

window.renderVerifyUpload = (view) => {
    view.innerHTML = `
        <h3>ID VERIFICATION REQUIRED</h3>
        <p style="font-size:13px; color:#888;">Upload government ID to unlock features.</p>

// --- DRAG & DROP HANDLERS ---
window.setupDragDrop = () => {
    const dz = document.getElementById('drag-zone');
    if(!dz) return;
    ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {
        dz.addEventListener(eventName, (e) => { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); }, false);
    });
    dz.addEventListener('dragover', () => dz.style.background = '#1a1a1a');
    dz.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a');
    dz.addEventListener('drop', (e) => {
        dz.style.background = '#0a0a0a';
        if(e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
            document.getElementById('drop-text').innerText = "ACQUIRED: " + e.dataTransfer.files[0].name;
            document.getElementById('drag-zone').style.borderColor = "#40c4ff";
            window.startUpload(e.dataTransfer.files[0], 'verification');
        }
    });
};

// --- CORE UPLOAD FUNCTION WITH FILE TYPE LIMITS ---
window.startUpload = (file, folderName) => {
    
    // --- 1. DEFINE LIMITS ---
    let MAX_SIZE = 50 * 1024 * 1024; // Default 50MB
    let typeName = "File";

    // Artist Proof Video (500MB)
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
        MAX_SIZE = 500 * 1024 * 1024;
        typeName = "Proof Video";
    }
    // Portfolio Uploads (Variable)
    else if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
        if(file.type.startsWith('audio/')) {
            MAX_SIZE = 20 * 1024 * 1024; // 20MB for Audio
            typeName = "Audio";
        } else if (file.type.startsWith('video/')) {
            MAX_SIZE = 200 * 1024 * 1024; // 200MB for Portfolio Video
            typeName = "Video";
        } else {
            MAX_SIZE = 20 * 1024 * 1024; // 20MB for Images
            typeName = "Image";
        }
    }

    // --- 2. CHECK LIMITS ---
    if(file.size > MAX_SIZE) {
        return window.showToast(`${typeName} too large. Max ${MAX_SIZE/(1024*1024)}MB.`, "error");
    }

    let statusId = 'upload-status-verify';
    let progId = 'prog-bar-verify';
    let containerId = 'prog-container-verify';

    if(folderName === 'art_uploads') { statusId = 'upload-status-art'; progId = 'prog-bar-art'; containerId = 'prog-container-art'; }
    if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') { statusId = 'upload-status-vid'; progId = 'prog-bar-vid'; containerId = 'prog-container-vid'; }

    const status = document.getElementById(statusId);
    const progContainer = document.getElementById(containerId);
    const progBar = document.getElementById(progId);

    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn').style.display = 'none';
    if(document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid')) document.getElementById('transmit-btn-vid').style.display = 'none';

    if(status) status.innerText = "INITIALIZING UPLINK...";
    if(progContainer) { progContainer.style.display = "block"; progContainer.style.opacity = "1"; }
    if(progBar) progBar.style.width = "5%";

    const uid = window.auth.currentUser.uid;
    const handle = window.currentUserDoc.handle || "UnknownUser";
    const safeHandle = handle.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");
    const newFileName = `${safeHandle}_${uid}_${file.name}`;

    const metadata = { customMetadata: { 'username': handle, 'uid': uid, 'original_name': file.name } };

    const uploadTask = window.storage.ref().child(`${folderName}/${uid}/${newFileName}`).put(file, metadata);
    
    uploadTask.on('state_changed',
    (snapshot) => {
        const progress = (snapshot.bytesTransferred / snapshot.totalBytes) * 100;
        if(progBar) progBar.style.width = progress + '%';
        if(status) status.innerText = "TRANSMITTING... " + Math.floor(progress) + "%";
    },
    (error) => {
        if(status) status.innerText = window.sanitizeError(error.message);
        if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#ff4444";
        window.showToast("Upload Failed.", "error");
    },
    () => {
        uploadTask.snapshot.ref.getDownloadURL().then((downloadURL) => {
            if(status) status.innerText = "UPLOAD COMPLETE.";
            if(progBar) progBar.style.backgroundColor = "#0f0";
            
            if(folderName === 'verification') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     verification_status: 'pending',
                     id_proof_url: downloadURL 
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.verification_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('verify'); }, 1000);
                 }).catch(err => {
                     window.showToast("Database Error: " + err.message, "error");
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'artist_proofs') {
                 status.innerText = "SAVING STATUS TO DATABASE...";
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).set({ 
                     artist_status: 'pending',
                     artist_proof_url: downloadURL
                 }, { merge: true }) 
                 .then(() => {
                     window.currentUserDoc.artist_status = 'pending';
                     setTimeout(() => { window.switchDashTab('studio'); }, 1000);
                 });
            }
            
            if(folderName === 'art_uploads') {
                 window.db.collection('users').doc(uid).collection('uploads').add({
                     url: downloadURL,
                     name: newFileName,
                     uploadedAt: new Date()
                 });
                 window.showToast("Artwork Uploaded Successfully.", "success");
            }
        });
    });
};

window.doLogout = () => {

ok one little hiccup - when the artist is waiting to be authorized for freemium - I was able to upload the video fine but it's slow as shit - but also in God mode - I see it as a thing to review - but I can't actually VIEW the video. What could be causing this?

It is slow because 500MB is a massive file for a web browser to load instantly. When you upload it, it takes time (upload speed). When you view it in God Mode, the browser has to download that huge file to play it (download speed).

If the video isn't playing at all, it's likely because the browser is "choking" on the file size or the format (some browsers hate .mov files).

The Solution: We will update the Admin Panel Logic (Embed 6) to add a "Force Open" link under the video player. If the player freezes or is too slow, you can click [OPEN RAW FILE] to open it in a new tab, which forces the browser to download and play it natively.

Update Firebase Embed 6 (Admin Brains)
Delete the code in your 6th Embed (the Admin Javascript) and paste this. I updated the renderCard function to include the fallback link and better video controls.

window.loadGodData = async () => {

// --- 2. BUILD CARDS (WITH ROBUST VIDEO PLAYER) ---
window.buildGodCards = () => {
    const container = document.getElementById('god-rotator');
    container.innerHTML = '';
    const total = window.pendingList.length;

    window.pendingList.forEach((item, index) => {
        const card = document.createElement('div');

// --- 3. CAROUSEL ENGINE ---
window.updateGodCarousel = () => {
    const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.god-card');
    cards.forEach((card, i) => {
        let offset = i - window.rotatorIndex;
        if (i < window.rotatorIndex) {
            card.style.opacity = '0'; card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0)'; card.style.zIndex = -1; return;
        }
        if (offset === 0) {
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateZ(0px) scale(1)';
            card.style.opacity = '1'; card.style.zIndex = '10'; card.style.filter = 'none'; card.classList.add('active');
        } else if (offset === 1) {
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(250px) translateZ(-200px) rotateY(-15deg) scale(0.8)';
            card.style.opacity = '0.5'; card.style.zIndex = '5'; card.style.filter = 'brightness(0.5)'; card.classList.remove('active');
        } else if (offset === 2) {
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(450px) translateZ(-400px) rotateY(-30deg) scale(0.6)';
            card.style.opacity = '0.2'; card.style.zIndex = '1'; card.classList.remove('active');
        } else {
            card.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(1000px) scale(0)'; card.style.opacity = '0';
        }
    });
};

// --- 4. JUDGMENT LOGIC ---
window.cyberConfirm = (title, msg, type) => {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const modal = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-overlay');
        const box = document.getElementById('cyber-confirm-box');
        const txtTitle = document.getElementById('cc-title');
        const txtMsg = document.getElementById('cc-msg');
        const btnYes = document.getElementById('cc-btn-yes');
        const btnNo = document.getElementById('cc-btn-no');

        box.classList.remove('confirm-green', 'confirm-red');
        if(type === 'approve') { box.classList.add('confirm-green'); btnYes.innerText = "AUTHORIZE"; } 
        else { box.classList.add('confirm-red'); btnYes.innerText = "REJECT"; }

        txtTitle.innerText = title; txtMsg.innerText = msg; modal.style.display = 'flex'; 

        const handleYes = () => { cleanup(); resolve(true); };
        const handleNo = () => { cleanup(); resolve(false); };
        function cleanup() { modal.style.display = 'none'; btnYes.removeEventListener('click', handleYes); btnNo.removeEventListener('click', handleNo); }
        btnYes.addEventListener('click', handleYes); btnNo.addEventListener('click', handleNo);
    });
};

window.judgeGodUser = async (index, verdict) => {
    const item = window.pendingList[index];
    if(!item) return;

    const title = verdict === 'approve' ? "AUTHORIZE USER?" : "REJECT USER?";
    const msg = verdict === 'approve' ? `Grant ${item.type} status?` : `Reject application? Adds a strike.`;
    const confirmed = await window.cyberConfirm(title, msg, verdict);
    if(!confirmed) return;

    const cardEl = document.getElementById(`card-${index}`);
    if(verdict === 'approve') cardEl.classList.add('phase-approve');
    else cardEl.classList.add('phase-reject');

    window.rotatorIndex++;
    updateGodCarousel();
    
    const remaining = window.pendingList.length - window.rotatorIndex;
    if(remaining <= 0) setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('god-empty-msg').style.display = 'block', 600);

    try {
        if(item.type === 'ID') {
            if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ verification_status: 'verified', verified: true });
                window.showToast(`${item.data.handle} APPROVED`, "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ 
                    verification_status: 'rejected', verified: false,
                    rejection_count: firebase.firestore.FieldValue.increment(1)
                });
                window.showToast(`${item.data.handle} REJECTED`, "error");
            }
        }
        else if(item.type === 'ARTIST') {
             if(verdict === 'approve') {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ artist_status: 'verified' });
                window.showToast("Artist Approved", "success");
            } else {
                await window.db.collection('users').doc(item.id).update({ artist_status: 'rejected' });
                window.showToast("Artist Rejected", "error");
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        window.showToast("DB ERROR: " + e.message, "error");
    }
};

when I added this new code and refreshed the video is no longer there to be verified - so does that mean it got deleted? or is the file not being referenced or accessed properly? does it think just viewing the file means it was verified? if that's the case - say a server goes down or the power on the admins end goes out mid-verification - then it'd just be in limbo or disappear forever

It is extremely unlikely the file was deleted. It is almost certainly a case of the Database Status not matching the File Upload.

Here is exactly how the system works and why your "Power Outage" scenario is safe:

1. How "Pending" Actually Works
The Admin Panel does not look at the files. It looks at the Database Text.

It searches the database for: artist_status == "pending"

If it finds that text, it grabs the link and shows you the card.

If that text says "unverified" (or anything else), the card will never appear, even if the file is sitting safely in your storage bucket.

2. The "Limbo" Scenario (What happened to you)
If you uploaded the video, saw the loading bar finish, and then immediately refreshed or navigated away before the "SAVING STATUS..." step finished:

File: Successfully saved to Storage (It is sitting there right now).

Database: The command to change your status to "pending" was cut off.

Result: Your account still says "unverified". The Admin Panel ignores you because you aren't marked as "Pending".

Is it broken forever? No. The user (Artist) will just log in, see their dashboard still says "Proof Required" (instead of "Pending"), and think, "Oh, it didn't go through." They will upload it again. The new upload overwrites the old "Ghost File," the database updates, and then they appear in your list.

3. The "Power Outage" Scenario
You asked: "If the power goes out mid-verification, is it in limbo?"

No. Firestore is "Atomic."

Scenario A: You click "Approve". Your internet cuts out before the signal reaches Google.

Result: Nothing happens. When you get power back, the user is still "Pending". You just click Approve again.

Scenario B: You click "Approve". The signal reaches Google, then your power cuts out.

Result: Google updates the database. The user is verified. When you get power back, they are gone from the list because they are done.

There is no "half-verified" state. It is either done or not done.

How to check what happened (Right Now)
To confirm my theory that your status just didn't update:

Go to Firebase Console -> Firestore Database.

Find your user document.

Look at the field artist_status.

If it says unverified: The upload finished, but the database update failed (or you refreshed too fast).

If it says pending: Then it SHOULD be in the Admin Panel. If it's not, refresh the Admin Panel page (sometimes the browser caches the list).

Summary: Your system is safe. "Ghost files" take up a tiny bit of space but don't break the app. The logic handles interruptions by simply forcing the user to try again.
